# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action
Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Otherwise, treat a URL or open browser tab as context, not browser intent. Earlier Browser use does not make later semantic work browser-first. Before each semantic operation on a linked resource, you MUST query available and deferred tools for an applicable connector, API, or CLI. Reading this skill or scanning visible tools does not count. Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

## Setup Documentation
Use `await agent.documentation.get("<name>")` when one of these setup topics applies:
- `bootstrap-troubleshooting`: read when browser setup succeeds but discovery or selection fails
- `chrome-troubleshooting`: read when Chromium browser extension setup, installation, or communication fails

## Bootstrap
These setup details are internal. User-facing progress updates should be less technical in nature. Never mention `Node REPL`, `node_repl`, `REPL`, JavaScript sessions, module exports, reading documentation, or loading instructions unless a user is asking for that exact information. If setup or recovery is needed, describe it naturally as connecting to the browser or retrying the browser connection.

The `browser-client` module is the core entry point for browser use, and is available under `scripts/browser-client.mjs` in this plugin's root directory. ALWAYS import it using an absolute path. IMPORTANT: If this path cannot be found, stop and report that this plugin is missing `scripts/browser-client.mjs`. NEVER use the built in `browser-client` library.

Run browser setup code through the Node REPL `js` tool. In this environment the callable tool id typically appears as `mcp__node_repl__js`. If it is not already available, use tool discovery for `node_repl js` without setting a result limit. You need the `js` execution tool: `js_reset` only clears state, and `js_add_node_module_dir` only changes package resolution. Do not call either helper while trying to expose `js`. If `js` is still not available, search again for `node_repl js` with `limit: 10`.

CODE MODE REQUIREMENT: When you call the Node REPL `js` tool from the code-mode `exec` tool, the outer `exec` script containing the initial `documentation()` call MUST begin with `// @exec: {"max_output_tokens": 20000}`. This is a first-line pragma for the outer `exec` call, not an argument to the nested `js` tool. Keep the exact `nodeRepl.write(await <browser>.documentation());` call shown in the applicable selection scenario below and forward its complete result.

Initialize the runtime once per fresh Node session. If `agent.browsers` already exists, reuse it; do not import or initialize another browser runtime.

```js
if (globalThis.agent?.browsers == null) {
  const { setupBrowserRuntime } = await import("<plugin root>/scripts/browser-client.mjs");
  await setupBrowserRuntime({ globals: globalThis });
}
```

Once a browser connection is established, reuse its existing browser binding across later turns and do not reread this skill. Once you have read a browser's complete documentation, do not read it again unless you select a different browser.

A tab binding is separate from its browser binding. If a later turn reports that a tab is missing, stale, closed, or not part of the current browser session, discard that tab binding and obtain or create a fresh tab from the existing browser binding. An empty `browser.tabs.list()` or `browser.user.openTabs()` result is normal after tab cleanup and does not invalidate the browser binding. Never call `agent.browsers.get*` to recover a tab; only an explicit browser-disconnected error invalidates the binding.

## Browser selection
The scenarios below are for the initial browser selection only. Before calling any `agent.browsers.get*` method, reuse an existing `globalThis.browser`, `globalThis.iab`, `globalThis.chrome`, or `globalThis.edge` binding that already serves the task. A new user turn does not invalidate a browser binding or require another selection or documentation call.

Select the initial browser with exactly one of these scenarios, in the order
shown. An explicit request for the in-app browser, Chrome, or Edge always wins
over URL selection. Never call `getForUrl()` when the user names a browser.
An explicit browser request is a hard constraint: use only that browser and
never fall back to another browser surface. If its exact selector is
unavailable, report that browser as unavailable instead of calling
`getDefault()`, `getForUrl()`, or `get("extension")`.

App-provided in-app-browser context is ambient UI state, not a user instruction to select or switch browsers. Only the text of the user's request can explicitly choose a browser.

Do not inspect browser cookies, local storage, profiles, passwords, or session stores. Browser discovery must remain read-only.

When authentication blocks requested browser navigation, do not replace it with web search, a search engine, another site, or another source merely to bypass sign-in.

### The user explicitly requests a browser
A plugin mention in the user's request explicitly names its browser.
`[@Browser](plugin://browser@openai-bundled)` names the in-app browser.
Browser plugin mentions whose URL contains `browserFamily=chrome` or
`browserFamily=edge` name Chrome or Edge respectively.
`[@Chrome](plugin://chrome@openai-bundled)`,
`[@chrome-internal](plugin://chrome-internal@openai-bundled)`, and
`[@chrome-dev](plugin://chrome-dev@openai-bundled)` name Chrome. Follow the
corresponding explicit-browser scenario below.

The in-app browser is available only when the Browser skill is listed for the session. If the user explicitly requests the in-app browser and that skill is available, use a distinct persistent binding and immediately read its complete documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.iab == null) {
  globalThis.iab = await agent.browsers.get("iab");
  nodeRepl.write(await iab.documentation());
}
```

If the user explicitly requests the in-app browser but the Browser skill is not available, report that the in-app browser is unavailable instead of substituting another browser.

Chrome or Edge is available only when a Browser or Chrome skill is listed for
the session and `agent.browsers.get("chrome")` or
`agent.browsers.get("edge")` succeeds. The browser family is a stable selector;
do not list browsers first or pass an opaque browser ID for an explicit family.

For Chrome, use a separate persistent binding and immediately read its complete
documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.chrome == null) {
  globalThis.chrome = await agent.browsers.get("chrome");
  nodeRepl.write(await chrome.documentation());
}
```

For Edge, use its own persistent binding and immediately read its complete
documentation:

```js
if (globalThis.edge == null) {
  globalThis.edge = await agent.browsers.get("edge");
  nodeRepl.write(await edge.documentation());
}
```

If the user explicitly requests Chrome or Edge but that family is unavailable,
tell them that browser needs the ChatGPT browser extension and direct them to
**Settings → Computer use** to install it. Do not substitute another browser.

An explicit browser choice remains in force for the task. If authentication blocks the task in an explicitly selected browser, your next response must explicitly ask the user to sign in in that browser and tell you when it is ready, unless that browser's documentation provides a supported authentication flow to try first. Merely reporting that sign-in is required is not sufficient. Do not switch to another browser unless the user asks or approves the switch.

### The user explicitly requests an external browser without naming a family
When the user says to use their external browser, browser extension, or a
similar external-browser surface without naming Chrome or Edge, select the
first connected extension instance directly. Do not call
`agent.browsers.list()` first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.get("extension");
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

If no extension instance is available, tell the user that their external
browser needs the ChatGPT browser extension and direct them to
**Settings → Computer use** to install it. Do not substitute the in-app
browser.

### The task requires browser interaction, the user does not specify a browser, and the task has a target URL
When the user supplies a URL or the intended URL can be reasonably inferred from the request, replace the example below with that URL and let browser-client choose the browser best suited to it. Do not call `agent.browsers.list()` first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.getForUrl("https://example.com/");
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

### The user specifies neither a browser nor a target URL
Use the runtime default, which prefers the in-app browser when it is available and otherwise uses Chrome. Do not list browsers first:

```js
if (globalThis.browser == null) {
  globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.getDefault();
  nodeRepl.write(await browser.documentation());
}
```

## After setup
If setup succeeds but browser discovery or selection fails, read `await agent.documentation.get("bootstrap-troubleshooting")` before resetting the JavaScript session or trying another browser-control mechanism.

If the failure is specific to Chrome extension setup, installation, or communication, read `await agent.documentation.get("chrome-troubleshooting")` before retrying or taking another recovery action.

When the user did not explicitly choose a browser, a browser selected by the runtime is not a user constraint. Do not switch browsers based only on an assumption about authentication. If navigation shows that the selected browser lacks the required authentication, select another available browser before asking the user to sign in. You may select it without resetting the Node session. Preserve existing `iab`, `chrome`, `edge`, and `browser` bindings when they are still useful. Existing tabs remain bound to the browser that created them. After selecting a different browser, obtain a tab from that browser before continuing and read its complete documentation.

The ability to interact directly with browsers is exposed through the `browser-client` runtime via the `agent.browsers.*` API. Before trying to interact with a selected browser for the first time, you MUST emit and read the complete documentation returned by its `documentation()` call in one go. For the initial documentation read, run the exact direct `nodeRepl.write(await <browser>.documentation());` call shown in the applicable scenario above. Do not assign the documentation to a variable, inspect its length, slice it, truncate it, summarize it, or emit only an excerpt. Do not proactively split the documentation into pages or chunks. Only if the tool output itself explicitly reports that it was truncated may you emit and read smaller chunks until you have read the documentation in its entirety.

Only the Node REPL `js` tool (`mcp__node_repl__js`) can be used to control the selected browser. Do not use external MCP browser-control tools, separate browser automation servers, or other browser skills for this surface. References to Playwright mean the in-skill `tab.playwright` API after browser-client setup.

     1	/* Mythweave - core: canvas, input, audio, fx, storage */
     2	var M = {};
     3	(function () {

    18	  /* ---------- canvas ---------- */
    19	  M.resize = function () {
    20	    var cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
    21	    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    22	    var bw = Math.round(cw * dpr), bh = Math.round(ch * dpr);
    23	    var long = Math.max(bw, bh);
    24	    if (long > 960) { var k = 960 / long; bw = Math.round(bw * k); bh = Math.round(bh * k); }
    25	    bw = Math.max(1, bw); bh = Math.max(1, bh);
    26	    if (M.cv.width !== bw) M.cv.width = bw;
    27	    if (M.cv.height !== bh) M.cv.height = bh;
    28	    M.bw = bw; M.bh = bh;
    29	    M.s = Math.min(bw / M.W, bh / M.H);
    30	    M.ox = (bw - M.W * M.s) / 2;
    31	    M.oy = (bh - M.H * M.s) / 2;
    32	    M.landscape = cw > ch * 1.08;
    33	    var rot = document.getElementById('rot');
    34	    if (M.landscape && M.started) { rot.classList.add('on'); } else { rot.classList.remove('on'); }
    35	    M.paused = !!(M.landscape && M.started);
    36	    if (M.paused) M.releaseAll();
    37	  };
    38	
    39	  /* ---------- input ---------- */
    40	  function toLocal(e) {
    41	    var r = M.cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    42	    var px = (e.clientX - r.left) * (M.bw / Math.max(1, r.width));
    43	    var py = (e.clientY - r.top) * (M.bh / Math.max(1, r.height));
    44	    return { x: (px - M.ox) / M.s, y: (py - M.oy) / M.s };
    45	  }
    46	  M.hit = function (x, y, w, h, id) { M.hits.push({ x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h, id: id }); };
    47	  M.findHit = function (x, y) {
    48	    for (var i = M.lastHits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    49	      var b = M.lastHits[i];
    50	      if (x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h) return b.id;
    51	    }
    52	    return null;
    53	  };
    54	  M.isDown = function (id) {
    55	    for (var k in M.pointers) if (M.pointers[k].btn === id) return true;
    56	    return false;
    57	  };
    58	  M.beginFrame = function () { M.hits = []; };
    59	  M.endFrame = function () { M.lastHits = M.hits; };
    60	  M.takeClicks = function () { var c = M.clicks; M.clicks = []; return c; };
    61	  M.takeKeys = function () { var k = M.keyq; M.keyq = []; return k; };
    62	  M.releaseAll = function () {
    63	    for (var k in M.pointers) delete M.pointers[k];
    64	    for (var q in M.keys) delete M.keys[q];
    65	    M.keyq.length = 0; M.clicks.length = 0;
    66	  };
    67	
    68	  function down(e) {
    69	    e.preventDefault();
    70	    if (M.paused) return;
    71	    var p = toLocal(e);
    72	    var id = M.findHit(p.x, p.y);
    73	    M.pointers[e.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, btn: id };
    74	    if (id) M.sfx('tick');
    75	  }
    76	  function move(e) {
    77	    var p = M.pointers[e.pointerId]; if (!p) return;
    78	    e.preventDefault();
    79	    var q = toLocal(e); p.x = q.x; p.y = q.y;
    80	    if (p.btn && M.findHit(q.x, q.y) !== p.btn) p.btn = null;
    81	  }

   300	  M.wrap = function (c, s, x, y, w, size, col, lh, align) {
   301	    c.font = size + 'px system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif';
   302	    c.fillStyle = col; c.textAlign = align || 'left'; c.textBaseline = 'middle';
   303	    var words = String(s).split(' '), line = '', n = 0;
   304	    for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
   305	      var t = line ? line + ' ' + words[i] : words[i];
   306	      if (c.measureText(t).width > w && line) { c.fillText(line, x, y + n * lh); n++; line = words[i]; }
   307	      else line = t;
   308	    }
   309	    if (line) { c.fillText(line, x, y + n * lh); n++; }
   310	    return n;
   311	  };
   312	  M.bar = function (c, x, y, w, h, p, bg, fg) {
   313	    M.rr(c, x, y, w, h, h / 2); c.fillStyle = bg; c.fill();
   314	    p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p));
   315	    if (p > 0) { M.rr(c, x, y, Math.max(h, w * p), h, h / 2); c.fillStyle = fg; c.fill(); }
   316	  };
   317	
   318	  /* ---------- loop ---------- */
   319	  var last = 0;
   320	  M.update = null; M.draw = null;
   321	  M.step = function (dt) {
   322	    if (M.paused) dt = 0;
   323	    if (dt > 0) { tickTimers(dt); fx(dt); if (M.update) M.update(dt); }
   324	    else if (M.paused) { M.releaseAll(); }
   325	    if (M.draw) M.draw(dt);
   326	  };
   327	  function frame(ts) {
   328	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   329	    if (!last) last = ts;
   330	    var dt = Math.min(0.05, (ts - last) / 1000);
   331	    last = ts;
   332	    M.step(dt);
   333	  }
   334	  M.boot = function () {
   335	    M.cv = document.getElementById('cv');
   336	    M.ctx = M.cv.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
   337	    M.initInput();
   338	    M.resize();
   339	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);

    95	  function seq(steps, done) {
    96	    var i = 0;
    97	    function nx() {
    98	      if (!B) return;
    99	      if (B.phase === 'won' || B.phase === 'lost') { endBattle(); return; }
   100	      if (i >= steps.length) { done(); return; }
   101	      var s = steps[i++];
   102	      s.fn();
   103	      if (M.checkEnd(B)) { M.after(0.7, endBattle); return; }
   104	      M.after(s.d, nx);
   105	    }
   106	    nx();
   107	  }

   109	  function endBattle() {
   110	    M.clearTimers();
   111	    if (B.phase === 'won') {
   112	      M.sfx('win');
   113	      result = { kind: 'won', ttl: 'BATTLE WON', lines: ['Turns used: ' + B.turn, 'HP left: ' + B.hp + '/' + B.maxhp], btn: 'CONTINUE' };
   114	    } else {
   115	      M.sfx('lose');
   116	      result = { kind: 'lost', ttl: 'THE WEAVE SNAPS', lines: ['You fell on turn ' + B.turn + '.', 'Retry free - no cost, ever.'], btn: 'RETRY BATTLE' };
   117	    }
   118	    screen = 'result';
   119	  }

   121	  function doResolve() {
   122	    if (!B || B.phase !== 'pick' || B.sel.length !== 3) return;
   123	    B.phase = 'resolve';
   124	    var picks = B.sel.map(function (i) { return B.hand[i]; });
   125	    var same = picks[0].s === picks[1].s && picks[1].s === picks[2].s;
   126	    var steps = [];
   127	    if (same) {
   128	      var sp = M.SPIRITS[picks[0].s];
   129	      var ult = M.scaleCard(sp.ult, picks[0].s === 'weaver' ? 1 : (S.lv[picks[0].s] || 1));
   130	      banner = { s: 'ULTIMATE  ' + sp.ult.n.toUpperCase(), c: sp.col, l: 1.6 };
   131	      M.sfx('ult'); M.kick(12, sp.col);
   132	      M.burst(195, 200, 40, sp.col, 260, 0.9);
   133	      M.logAdd(B, sp.name.split(',')[0] + ' unleashes ' + sp.ult.n + '!');
   134	      steps.push({ d: 0.7, fn: function () { M.applyCard(B, ult, true); } });
   135	    } else {
   136	      picks.forEach(function (p) {
   137	        steps.push({
   138	          d: 0.42, fn: function () {
   139	            M.applyCard(B, p, false);
   140	            M.logAdd(B, p.n);
   141	            M.burst(195, 430, 8, M.SPIRITS[p.s].col, 120, 0.4);
   142	          }
   143	        });
   144	      });
   145	    }
   146	    /* discard played */
   147	    var played = picks.slice();
   148	    steps.push({
   149	      d: 0.45, fn: function () {
   150	        for (var i = 0; i < played.length; i++) {
   151	          var ix = B.hand.indexOf(played[i]);
   152	          if (ix >= 0) { B.pile.push(B.hand[ix]); B.hand.splice(ix, 1); }
   153	        }
   154	        B.sel.length = 0;
   155	        B.phase = 'foe';
   156	      }
   157	    });
   158	    var al = M.aliveFoes(B);
   159	    al.forEach(function (f) {
   160	      steps.push({ d: 0.6, fn: function () { if (!f.dead) M.foeAct(B, f); } });
   161	    });
   162	    steps.push({ d: 0.5, fn: function () { M.endRound(B); } });
   163	    seq(steps, function () {
   164	      if (!B) return;
   165	      if (M.checkEnd(B)) { endBattle(); return; }
   166	      M.startTurn(B);
   167	    });
   168	  }

### mythweave/battle.js
     1	/* Mythweave - battle model */
     2	(function () {
     3	  function shuffle(a) {
     4	    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
     5	      var j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1)), t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
     6	    }
     7	    return a;
     8	  }
     9	
    10	  M.makeBattle = function (chIdx, bIdx, party, lv) {
    11	    var ch = M.CHAPTERS[chIdx], def = ch.battles[bIdx];
    12	    var B = {
    13	      ch: chIdx, bi: bIdx, def: def,
    14	      party: party.slice(0, 3),
    15	      maxhp: 62 + chIdx * 10, hp: 62 + chIdx * 10,
    16	      block: 0, power: 0, frail: 0,
    17	      deck: [], pile: [], hand: [], sel: [],
    18	      foes: [], target: 0, turn: 1, phase: 'pick',
    19	      log: [], resolved: 0, ultName: null
    20	    };
    21	    /* deck */
    22	    var srcs = ['weaver'].concat(B.party);
    23	    for (var i = 0; i < srcs.length; i++) {
    24	      var sid = srcs[i], sp = M.SPIRITS[sid], l = (lv && lv[sid]) || 1;
    25	      for (var c = 0; c < sp.cards.length; c++) {
    26	        for (var k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    27	          var card = M.scaleCard(sp.cards[c], sid === 'weaver' ? 1 : l);
    28	          card.s = sid; card.lv = sid === 'weaver' ? 1 : l;
    29	          B.deck.push(card);
    30	        }
    31	      }
    32	    }
    33	    shuffle(B.deck);
    34	    /* foes */
    35	    for (var f = 0; f < def.foes.length && f < 3; f++) {
    36	      var fd = M.FOES[def.foes[f]];
    37	      B.foes.push({
    38	        d: fd, name: fd.name, hp: fd.hp, maxhp: fd.hp, block: 0, weak: 0, burn: 0,
    39	        atk: 0, mi: f % fd.moves.length, x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0, hitT: 0, dead: false
    40	      });
    41	    }
    42	    B.log.push('The weave tightens.');
    43	    M.drawHand(B);
    44	    return B;
    45	  };
    46	
    47	  M.drawHand = function (B) {
    48	    B.hand.length = 0; B.sel.length = 0;
    49	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    50	      if (!B.deck.length) { B.deck = shuffle(B.pile); B.pile = []; }
    51	      if (!B.deck.length) break;
    52	      B.hand.push(B.deck.pop());
    53	    }
    54	    if (B.pile.length > 90) B.pile.length = 90;
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  M.logAdd = function (B, s) {
    58	    B.log.push(s);
    59	    while (B.log.length > 3) B.log.shift();
    60	  };
    61	
    62	  M.aliveFoes = function (B) { return B.foes.filter(function (f) { return !f.dead; }); };
    63	
    64	  M.fixTarget = function (B) {
    65	    if (!B.foes[B.target] || B.foes[B.target].dead) {
    66	      for (var i = 0; i < B.foes.length; i++) if (!B.foes[i].dead) { B.target = i; return; }
    67	    }
    68	  };
    69	
    70	  function hurtFoe(B, f, amt, pierce) {
    71	    if (f.dead || amt <= 0) return 0;
    72	    var a = amt;
    73	    if (!pierce && f.block > 0) {
    74	      var ab = Math.min(f.block, a); f.block -= ab; a -= ab;
    75	      if (ab > 0) M.float(f.x + f.w / 2 - 16, f.y + 22, '-' + ab + ' blk', '#9fd4ff');
    76	    }
    77	    if (a > 0) {
    78	      f.hp -= a; f.hitT = 0.28;
    79	      M.float(f.x + f.w / 2 + (Math.random() * 20 - 10), f.y + 40, '-' + a, '#ffd36b');
    80	      M.burst(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + f.h / 2, 8, f.d.col, 150, 0.45);
    81	      M.kick(5);
    82	      M.sfx('hit');
    83	    }
    84	    if (f.hp <= 0) {
    85	      f.hp = 0; f.dead = true;
    86	      M.burst(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + f.h / 2, 26, '#fff', 220, 0.7);
    87	      M.kick(9, '#ffffff');
    88	      M.sfx('big');
    89	      M.logAdd(B, f.name + ' unravels.');
    90	    }
    91	    return a;
    92	  }
    93	  M.hurtFoe = hurtFoe;
    94	
    95	  function healP(B, v) {
    96	    if (v <= 0) return;
    97	    B.hp = Math.min(B.maxhp, B.hp + v);
    98	    M.float(195, 336, '+' + v, '#7fe6a0'); M.sfx('heal');
    99	    M.burst(195, 345, 10, '#7fe6a0', 90, 0.5);
   100	  }
   101	
   102	  /* apply one card. returns nothing; fx immediate */
   103	  M.applyCard = function (B, c, isUlt) {
   104	    var t = B.foes[B.target];
   105	    if (!t || t.dead) { M.fixTarget(B); t = B.foes[B.target]; }
   106	    var pw = B.power, i;
   107	    var alive = M.aliveFoes(B);
   108	    if (c.b) { B.block += c.b; M.sfx('block'); M.float(195, 320, '+' + c.b + ' blk', '#9fd4ff'); }
   109	    if (c.p) { B.power += c.p; M.float(230, 320, '+' + c.p + ' pow', '#ffb0e0'); }
   110	    if (c.h) healP(B, c.h);
   111	    if (c.sd) { B.hp = Math.max(1, B.hp - c.sd); M.float(160, 336, '-' + c.sd, '#ff8080'); }
   112	    if (c.d && t) {
   113	      var hits = c.hits || 1;
   114	      var base = c.d + pw + (c.chain ? c.chain * B.resolved : 0);
   115	      for (i = 0; i < hits; i++) hurtFoe(B, t, base, c.ig);
   116	    }
   117	    if (c.dr && t) {
   118	      var got = hurtFoe(B, t, c.dr + pw, false);
   119	      healP(B, got);
   120	    }
   121	    if (c.ad) {
   122	      for (i = 0; i < alive.length; i++) hurtFoe(B, alive[i], c.ad + pw, c.ig);
   123	    }
   124	    if (c.bu) {
   125	      if (isUlt || c.wa) { for (i = 0; i < alive.length; i++) { alive[i].burn += c.bu; } }
   126	      else if (t) t.burn += c.bu;
   127	      M.sfx('block');
   128	    }
   129	    if (c.w && t) { t.weak += c.w; M.float(t.x + t.w / 2, t.y + 60, 'WEAK', '#c9a9ff'); }
   130	    if (c.wa) { for (i = 0; i < alive.length; i++) alive[i].weak += 1; }
   131	    B.resolved++;
   132	  };
   133	
   134	  M.checkEnd = function (B) {
   135	    if (M.aliveFoes(B).length === 0) { B.phase = 'won'; return 'won'; }
   136	    if (B.hp <= 0) { B.hp = 0; B.phase = 'lost'; return 'lost'; }
   137	    return null;
   138	  };
   139	
   140	  /* enemy single action */
   141	  M.foeAct = function (B, f) {
   142	    if (f.dead) return;
   143	    f.block = 0;
   144	    var mv = f.d.moves[f.mi % f.d.moves.length];
   145	    f.mi = (f.mi + 1) % f.d.moves.length;
   146	    var mul = f.weak > 0 ? 0.6 : 1;
   147	    if (mv.t === 'grd') {
   148	      f.block += mv.v; M.float(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + 30, '+' + mv.v + ' blk', '#9fd4ff'); M.sfx('block');
   149	    } else if (mv.t === 'buf') {
   150	      f.atk += mv.v; M.float(f.x + f.w / 2, f.y + 30, 'RAGE', '#ff6b6b'); M.sfx('block');
   151	    } else if (mv.t === 'hex') {
   152	      B.frail += mv.v; B.power = Math.max(0, B.power - 2);
   153	      M.float(195, 320, 'FRAYED', '#ff8fd0'); M.sfx('hurt');
   154	      M.logAdd(B, f.name + ' frays your thread.');
   155	    } else {
   156	      var n = mv.t === 'atk2' ? 2 : 1;
   157	      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   158	        var dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round((mv.v + f.atk) * mul * (B.frail > 0 ? 1.3 : 1)));
   159	        if (B.block > 0) {
   160	          var ab = Math.min(B.block, dmg); B.block -= ab; dmg -= ab;
   161	          M.float(170, 320, '-' + ab + ' blk', '#9fd4ff');
   162	        }
   163	        if (dmg > 0) {
   164	          B.hp -= dmg;
   165	          M.float(195, 336, '-' + dmg, '#ff6b6b');
   166	          M.kick(8, '#ff3b3b'); M.sfx('hurt');
   167	          M.burst(195, 345, 12, '#ff6b6b', 160, 0.5);
   168	        } else { M.sfx('block'); }
   169	      }
   170	    }
   171	  };
   172	
   173	  M.endRound = function (B) {
   174	    var al = M.aliveFoes(B);
   175	    for (var i = 0; i < al.length; i++) {
   176	      var f = al[i];
   177	      if (f.burn > 0) {
   178	        hurtFoe(B, f, f.burn, true);
   179	        f.burn = Math.max(0, f.burn - 1);
   180	      }
   181	      if (f.weak > 0) f.weak--;
   182	    }
   183	    if (B.frail > 0) B.frail--;
   184	  };
   185	
   186	  M.startTurn = function (B) {
   187	    B.block = 0;
   188	    B.power = Math.max(0, B.power - 1);
   189	    B.resolved = 0;
   190	    B.turn++;
   191	    for (var i = 0; i < B.hand.length; i++) B.pile.push(B.hand[i]);
   192	    M.drawHand(B);
   193	    M.fixTarget(B);
   194	    B.phase = 'pick';
   195	  };
   196	
   197	  M.intentOf = function (f) {
   198	    var mv = f.d.moves[f.mi % f.d.moves.length];
   199	    var mul = f.weak > 0 ? 0.6 : 1;
   200	    if (mv.t === 'grd') return { s: 'GUARD ' + mv.v, c: '#9fd4ff' };
   201	    if (mv.t === 'buf') return { s: 'ENRAGE', c: '#ff9a45' };
   202	    if (mv.t === 'hex') return { s: 'FRAY', c: '#ff8fd0' };
   203	    var v = Math.max(1, Math.round((mv.v + f.atk) * mul));
   204	    return { s: (mv.t === 'atk2' ? v + ' x2' : 'HIT ' + v), c: '#ff8080' };
   205	  };

   180	  function handle(id) {
   181	    if (screen === 'story') { story.i++; if (story.i >= story.pages.length) { var f = story.then; story = null; f(); } return; }
   182	    if (screen === 'result') {
   183	      if (id === 'ok') {
   184	        if (result.kind === 'won') { result = null; afterWin(); }
   185	        else { result = null; startBattle(pending.ch, pending.bi); }
   186	      } else if (id === 'party') { result = null; partyFrom = 'result'; partySel = S.party.slice(); screen = 'party'; }
   187	      return;
   188	    }
   189	    if (screen === 'end') {
   190	      if (id === 'again') { var best = S.best; M.wipe(); S = fresh(); S.best = best; persist(); battleIntro(0, 0); }
   191	      return;
   192	    }
   193	    if (screen === 'map') {
   194	      if (id && id.indexOf('node') === 0) {
   195	        var b = +id.slice(4);
   196	        if (unlocked(S.ch, b)) battleIntro(S.ch, b);
   197	      } else if (id === 'party') { partyFrom = 'map'; partySel = S.party.slice(); screen = 'party'; }
   198	      else if (id === 'reset') { var bb = S.best; M.wipe(); S = fresh(); S.best = bb; persist(); battleIntro(0, 0); }
   199	      return;
   200	    }
   201	    if (screen === 'party') {
   202	      if (id && id.indexOf('sp') === 0) {
   203	        var sid = id.slice(2);
   204	        inspect = sid;
   205	        var ix = partySel.indexOf(sid);
   206	        if (ix >= 0) partySel.splice(ix, 1);
   207	        else if (partySel.length < 3) partySel.push(sid);
   208	        M.sfx('pick');
   209	      } else if (id === 'done') {
   210	        if (!partySel.length) return;
   211	        S.party = partySel.slice(0, 3); persist();
   212	        if (partyFrom === 'result') startBattle(pending.ch, pending.bi);
   213	        else screen = 'map';
   214	      }
   215	      return;
   216	    }

   218	      if (id && id.indexOf('card') === 0) toggleCard(+id.slice(4));
   219	      else if (id === 'resolve') doResolve();
   220	      else if (id && id.indexOf('foe') === 0) {
   221	        var fi = +id.slice(3);
   222	        if (B.foes[fi] && !B.foes[fi].dead) { B.target = fi; M.sfx('pick'); }
   223	      }
   224	    }

   227	  function handleKey(k) {
   228	    if (screen === 'story' || screen === 'result' || screen === 'end') {
   229	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'r' || k === 'R') handle(screen === 'end' ? 'again' : 'ok');
   230	      return;
   231	    }
   232	    if (screen === 'battle') {
   233	      if (k >= '1' && k <= '5') toggleCard(+k - 1);
   234	      else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') doResolve();
   235	      else if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight') {
   236	        var al = [];

   238	        if (al.length) {
   239	          var p = al.indexOf(B.target);
   240	          p = (p + (k === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : al.length - 1) + al.length) % al.length;
   241	          B.target = al[p]; M.sfx('pick');
   242	        }
   243	      }
   244	      return;
   245	    }
   246	    if (screen === 'map' && k >= '1' && k <= '4') handle('node' + (+k - 1));
   247	    if (screen === 'party' && (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ')) handle('done');
   248	  }

    23	  function isInt(n) { return typeof n === 'number' && isFinite(n) && Math.floor(n) === n; }
    24	  function clampInt(n, lo, hi, dflt) {
    25	    if (!isInt(n)) return dflt;
    26	    return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, n));

    28	  function load() {
    29	    var raw = null;
    30	    try { raw = root.localStorage.getItem(KEY); } catch (e) { raw = null; }
    31	    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string') return defSave();
    32	    var o = null;
    33	    try { o = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e2) { o = null; }
    34	    if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || Array.isArray(o)) return defSave();
    35	    var s = defSave();
    36	    s.rank = clampInt(o.rank, 0, D.LADDER.length, 0);
    37	    s.wins = clampInt(o.wins, 0, 999999, 0);
    38	    s.credits = clampInt(o.credits, 0, 9999, 0);
    39	    s.packs = clampInt(o.packs, 0, 99, 0);

    41	      var col = {};

    46	        if (v > 0) col[id] = v;
    47	      }

    49	    }
    50	    // a collection too small to field a legal deck gets topped up with the starter set

    53	    if (total < 24) {

    75	  function autoDeck(s) {
    76	    var own = function (id) { return Math.min(2, s.col[id] || 0); };
    77	    var deck = [], i, k;
    78	    // score elements
    79	    var esc = [0, 0, 0];
    80	    for (i = 0; i < D.SET_SIZE; i++) {
    81	      var c = C[i];
    82	      if (c.t !== 'c') continue;
    83	      esc[c.e] += own(i) * c.s * c.s;
    84	    }
    85	    var el = esc.indexOf(Math.max(esc[0], esc[1], esc[2]));
    86	    // group into lines
    87	    var lines = {};
    88	    for (i = 0; i < D.SET_SIZE; i++) {
    89	      var cc = C[i];
    90	      if (cc.t !== 'c' || cc.e !== el) continue;
    91	      (lines[cc.line] = lines[cc.line] || []).push(i);
    92	    }
    93	    var arr = [];
    94	    for (k in lines) {
    95	      var ids = lines[k].sort(function (a, b) { return C[a].s - C[b].s; });
    96	      var sc = 0;
    97	      for (i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) sc += own(ids[i]) * (C[ids[i]].s === 1 ? 1 : C[ids[i]].s * 2);
    98	      if (own(ids[0]) === 0) sc = 0;
    99	      arr.push({ ids: ids, sc: sc });
   100	    }
   101	    arr.sort(function (a, b) { return b.sc - a.sc; });
   102	    var push = function (id, n) {
   103	      for (var q = 0; q < n && deck.length < 20; q++) deck.push(id);
   104	    };
   105	    for (i = 0; i < arr.length && i < 3; i++) {
   106	      var L = arr[i].ids;
   107	      if (!arr[i].sc) continue;
   108	      push(L[0], own(L[0]));
   109	      if (L[1]) push(L[1], own(L[1]));
   110	      if (L[2]) push(L[2], own(L[2]));
   111	    }
   112	    // handlers (max 6)
   113	    var hcount = 0;
   114	    var pref = ['DRAW2', 'EXTRA_E', 'HEAL30', 'SEARCH', 'BOOST20', 'SCOUT', 'DRAW3', 'HEAL60', 'QUICKEVO', 'GUST'];
   115	    for (var p = 0; p < pref.length && hcount < 6 && deck.length < 20; p++) {
   116	      for (i = 0; i < D.SET_SIZE; i++) {
   117	        if (C[i].t === 'h' && C[i].fx === pref[p] && own(i) > 0) {
   118	          var n = Math.min(own(i), 6 - hcount, 20 - deck.length);
   119	          push(i, n); hcount += n;
   120	        }
   121	      }
   122	    }
   123	    // fill with any owned basics first, then anything
   124	    var counts = {};
   125	    for (i = 0; i < deck.length; i++) counts[deck[i]] = (counts[deck[i]] || 0) + 1;
   126	    var fill = function (test) {
   127	      for (var q = 0; q < D.SET_SIZE && deck.length < 20; q++) {
   128	        if (!test(C[q])) continue;
   129	        var room = own(q) - (counts[q] || 0);
   130	        while (room-- > 0 && deck.length < 20) { deck.push(q); counts[q] = (counts[q] || 0) + 1; }
   131	      }
   132	    };
   133	    fill(function (c) { return c.t === 'c' && c.s === 1 && c.e === el; });
   134	    fill(function (c) { return c.t === 'c' && c.s === 1; });
   135	    fill(function (c) { return c.t === 'h'; });
   136	    fill(function () { return true; });
   137	    // guarantee enough starters
   138	    var basics = deck.filter(function (id) { return C[id].t === 'c' && C[id].s === 1; }).length;
   139	    if (basics < 7) {
   140	      for (i = 0; i < D.SET_SIZE && basics < 7; i++) {
   141	        if (!(C[i].t === 'c' && C[i].s === 1)) continue;
   142	        var have = deck.filter(function (x) { return x === i; }).length;
   143	        while (have < own(i) && basics < 7) {
   144	          // swap out a non-basic
   145	          for (var j = deck.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   146	            if (!(C[deck[j]].t === 'c' && C[deck[j]].s === 1)) { deck.splice(j, 1); break; }
   147	          }
   148	          deck.push(i); have++; basics++;
   149	        }
   150	      }
   151	    }
   152	    return deck.slice(0, 20);
   153	  }

   155	  // ------------------------------------------------------------- packs
   156	  function rollRarity(slot) {
   157	    if (slot < 3) return 0;
   158	    var r = Math.random();
   159	    if (slot === 3) return r < 0.75 ? 1 : 2;
   160	    return r < 0.50 ? 0 : (r < 0.82 ? 1 : 2);
   161	  }
   162	  function openPack() {
   163	    var p = { cards: [], isNew: [], dupe: [], rev: 0 };
   164	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   165	      var rar = rollRarity(i);
   166	      var pool = D.BY_RAR[rar];
   167	      var id = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
   168	      var have = A.save.col[id] || 0;
   169	      p.cards.push(id);
   170	      if (have >= 2) { p.dupe.push(true); p.isNew.push(false); A.save.credits = Math.min(9999, A.save.credits + 1); }
   171	      else { p.dupe.push(false); p.isNew.push(have === 0); A.save.col[id] = have + 1; }
   172	    }
   173	    A.save.packs = Math.max(0, A.save.packs - 1);
   174	    A.pack = p;
   175	    A.screen = 'pack';
   176	    save();
   177	    sfx('pack');
   178	  }

   181	  var actx = null, master = null;
   182	  function audioInit() {
   183	    if (actx) return;
   184	    try {
   185	      var AC = root.AudioContext || root.webkitAudioContext;
   186	      if (!AC) return;
   187	      actx = new AC();
   188	      master = actx.createGain();
   189	      master.gain.value = 0.22;
   190	      master.connect(actx.destination);
   191	    } catch (e) { actx = null; }
   192	  }
   193	  function tone(f, dur, type, vol, slide) {
   194	    if (!actx || actx.state !== 'running') return;
   195	    try {
   196	      var o = actx.createOscillator(), g = actx.createGain();
   197	      o.type = type || 'square';
   198	      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, actx.currentTime);
   199	      if (slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, slide), actx.currentTime + dur);
   200	      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, actx.currentTime);
   201	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.3, actx.currentTime + 0.012);
   202	      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, actx.currentTime + dur);
   203	      o.connect(g); g.connect(master);
   204	      o.start(); o.stop(actx.currentTime + dur + 0.02);
   205	    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
   206	  }
   207	  function noise(dur, vol) {
   208	    if (!actx || actx.state !== 'running') return;
   209	    try {
   210	      var len = Math.floor(actx.sampleRate * dur);
   211	      var buf = actx.createBuffer(1, len, actx.sampleRate);
   212	      var dta = buf.getChannelData(0);
   213	      for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) dta[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / len);
   214	      var src = actx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
   215	      var g = actx.createGain(); g.gain.value = vol || 0.25;
   216	      src.connect(g); g.connect(master); src.start();
   217	    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
   218	  }
   219	  // pending audio timers, all cancellable on restart/quit
   220	  var timers = [];
   221	  function arp(notes, gap, dur, type) {
   222	    for (var i = 0; i < notes.length; i++) {
   223	      (function (f, i2) {
   224	        var id = root.setTimeout(function () {
   225	          var p = timers.indexOf(id); if (p >= 0) timers.splice(p, 1);
   226	          tone(f, dur, type, 0.26);
   227	        }, i2 * gap);
   228	        timers.push(id);
   229	      })(notes[i], i);
   230	    }
   231	    while (timers.length > 24) root.clearTimeout(timers.shift());
   232	  }
   233	  function clearTimers() {
   234	    for (var i = 0; i < timers.length; i++) root.clearTimeout(timers[i]);
   235	    timers.length = 0;
   236	  }
   237	  function sfx(k) {
   238	    switch (k) {
   239	      case 'tap': tone(520, 0.05, 'square', 0.16); break;
   240	      case 'place': tone(300, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.25, 460); break;
   241	      case 'energy': tone(660, 0.08, 'sine', 0.3, 990); break;
   242	      case 'hit': noise(0.18, 0.3); tone(140, 0.14, 'sawtooth', 0.25, 60); break;
   243	      case 'ko': noise(0.4, 0.35); tone(200, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.3, 45); break;
   244	      case 'evolve': tone(420, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.25, 700); tone(700, 0.14, 'sine', 0.2, 1000); break;
   245	      case 'heal': tone(700, 0.12, 'sine', 0.22, 1150); break;
   246	      case 'bad': tone(180, 0.12, 'square', 0.2, 110); break;
   247	      case 'win': arp([523, 659, 784, 1046], 110, 0.2, 'triangle'); break;
   248	      case 'lose': arp([400, 330, 262, 196], 130, 0.24, 'sawtooth'); break;
   249	      case 'pack': arp([440, 660, 880], 80, 0.16, 'sine'); break;
   250	    }
   251	  }

   254	  function burst(x, y, n, col, spd) {
   255	    for (var i = 0; i < n && A.parts.length < MAXP; i++) {
   256	      var a = Math.random() * 6.283, s = (0.4 + Math.random()) * (spd || 140);
   257	      A.parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40, l: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4, L: 0.9, c: col, s: 2 + Math.random() * 4 });
   258	    }
   259	    while (A.parts.length > MAXP) A.parts.shift();
   260	  }

   267	    }

   325	  function doAction(id, data) {
   326	    var G = A.G, S = G ? G.p : null;
   327	    switch (id) {
   328	      case 'back':
   329	        if (A.screen === 'deck') { if (A.save.deck.length !== 20) A.save.deck = autoDeck(A.save); save(); }

   331	      case 'fight': startBattle(data); sfx('tap'); return;
   332	      case 'deck': A.screen = 'deck'; A.scroll = 0; A.focus = -1; sfx('tap'); return;
   333	      case 'coll': A.screen = 'coll'; A.scroll = 0; A.focus = -1; sfx('tap'); return;
   334	      case 'openpack': if (A.save.packs > 0) openPack(); return;
   335	      case 'quit': A.screen = 'map'; A.G = null; clearInput(); sfx('tap'); return;
   336	
   337	      // ---- pack
   338	      case 'reveal':
   339	        if (A.pack.rev <= data) { A.pack.rev = data + 1; sfx('place'); burst(W / 2, 300, 12, '#ffd98a', 160); }
   340	        return;
   341	      case 'revealall': A.pack.rev = 5; sfx('pack'); burst(W / 2, 300, 24, '#ffd98a', 200); return;
   342	      case 'packdone':
   343	        if (A.save.packs > 0) { openPack(); }
   344	        else { A.screen = 'map'; A.pack = null; A.G = null; sfx('tap'); }
   345	        return;
   346	
   347	      // ---- collection
   348	      case 'claim':
   349	        if (A.save.credits >= D.CLAIM_COST && !(A.save.col[data] > 0)) {
   350	          A.save.credits -= D.CLAIM_COST; A.save.col[data] = 1; save();
   351	          A.hint = 'Claimed ' + C[data].n + '.';
   352	          sfx('evolve'); burst(W / 2, H / 2, 16, '#ffd98a', 180);
   353	        }
   354	        return;
   355	
   356	      // ---- deck builder
   357	      case 'dplus': {
   358	        var have = Math.min(2, A.save.col[data] || 0);
   359	        var inD = A.save.deck.filter(function (x) { return x === data; }).length;
   360	        if (inD < have && A.save.deck.length < 20) { A.save.deck.push(data); sfx('tap'); }
   361	        return;
   362	      }
   363	      case 'dminus': {
   364	        var idx = A.save.deck.lastIndexOf(data);
   365	        if (idx >= 0) { A.save.deck.splice(idx, 1); sfx('tap'); }
   366	        return;
   367	      }
   368	      case 'autodeck': A.save.deck = autoDeck(A.save); sfx('pack'); return;
   369	      case 'deckdone': save(); A.screen = 'map'; A.focus = -1; sfx('tap'); return;
   370	
   371	      // ---- battle
   372	      case 'hand': {
   373	        if (!G || G.over) return;
   374	        var cid = S.hand[data];
   375	        if (cid === undefined) return;
   376	        if (!G.started) {
   377	          // setup: only placing the active matters
   378	          A.sel = (A.sel === data ? null : data); sfx('tap'); return;
   379	        }
   380	        if (G.who !== 'p' || G.await) { sfx('bad'); return; }
### main 380-620
   380	        if (G.who !== 'p' || G.await) { sfx('bad'); return; }
   381	        if (C[cid].t === 'h' && !E.handlerNeedsTarget(C[cid].fx)) {
   382	          if (E.playHandler(G, S, data)) { A.sel = null; A.mode = null; }
   383	          else sfx('bad');
   384	          return;
   385	        }
   386	        A.sel = (A.sel === data ? null : data);
   387	        A.mode = A.sel === null ? null : 'sel';
   388	        sfx('tap');

   390	      }
   391	      case 'pact': slotTap(-1); return;
   392	      case 'pslot': slotTap(data); return;
   393	      case 'atk':

   395	          A.sel = null; A.mode = null;

   397	          A.aiTimer = 0.75;
   398	        } else sfx('bad');

   400	      case 'energy':

   402	      case 'retreat':

   404	      case 'end':

   406	          A.sel = null; A.mode = null; E.endTurn(G); A.aiTimer = 0.7; sfx('tap');
   407	        }
   408	        return;
   409	      case 'again':

   414	          if (G.rung + 1 <= A.save.rank && G.rung + 1 < D.LADDER.length) startBattle(next);
   415	          else { A.screen = 'map'; A.G = null; }

   422	        return;

   426	  function slotTap(slot) {
   427	    var G = A.G;
   428	    if (!G || G.over) return;
   429	    var S = G.p, cr = E.evoTarget(S, slot);
   430	
   431	    if (G.await === 'promote') {
   432	      if (slot >= 0 && S.bench[slot]) {
   433	        E.promote(G, slot);
   434	        if (G.pendingEnd) { G.pendingEnd = false; E.endTurn(G); A.aiTimer = 0.7; }
   435	        sfx('place');
   436	      } else sfx('bad');
   437	      return;
   438	    }
   439	    if (!G.started) {
   440	      if (slot === -1 && A.sel !== null && E.placeActive(G, S, A.sel)) {
   441	        A.sel = null;
   442	        // auto-open: player may bench more before the first turn begins
   443	        E.beginBattle(G);
   444	        G.hint = 'Tap ENERGY then your creature, then tap an attack';
   445	      } else sfx('bad');
   446	      return;
   447	    }
   448	    if (G.who !== 'p') { sfx('bad'); return; }
   449	    if (A.mode === 'energy') {
   450	      if (E.attachEnergy(G, S, slot)) { A.mode = null; } else sfx('bad');
   451	      return;
   452	    }
   453	    if (A.mode === 'retreat') {
   454	      if (slot >= 0 && E.retreat(G, S, slot, false)) { A.mode = null; } else sfx('bad');
   455	      return;
   456	    }
   457	    if (A.sel !== null) {
   458	      var cid = S.hand[A.sel];
   459	      if (cid === undefined) { A.sel = null; return; }
   460	      var ok = false;
   461	      if (C[cid].t === 'h') {
   462	        ok = E.playHandler(G, S, A.sel, slot);
   463	      } else if (cr) {
   464	        ok = E.evolve(G, S, A.sel, slot);
   465	      } else if (slot === -1) {
   466	        ok = E.placeActive(G, S, A.sel);
   467	      } else {
   468	        ok = E.placeBench(G, S, A.sel, slot);
   469	      }
   470	      if (ok) { A.sel = null; A.mode = null; } else sfx('bad');
   471	      return;
   472	    }
   473	    sfx('tap');
   474	  }

   477	  function toLocal(cx, cy) {
   478	    var r = A.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   479	    return { x: (cx - r.left) / A.sc, y: (cy - r.top) / A.sc };
   480	  }
   481	  function hit(x, y) {
   482	    var R = U.regions();
   483	    for (var i = R.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   484	      var g = R[i];
   485	      if (g.dis) continue;
   486	      if (x >= g.x && x <= g.x + g.w && y >= g.y && y <= g.y + g.h) return g;
   487	    }
   488	    return null;
   489	  }

   491	  function onDown(e) {
   492	    if (A.paused) return;
   493	    audioUnlock();
   494	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   495	    var p = toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   496	    var g = hit(p.x, p.y);
   497	    A.ptr[pid] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, g: g, moved: false, scroll: false, s0: A.scroll };
   498	    if (!g && (A.screen === 'coll' || A.screen === 'deck')) A.ptr[pid].scroll = true;
   499	    if (g && g.id === 'deckrow') A.ptr[pid].scroll = true;
   500	    if (Object.keys(A.ptr).length > 8) { // cap pointer map
   501	      var ks = Object.keys(A.ptr);
   502	      delete A.ptr[ks[0]];
   503	    }
   504	  }
   505	  function onMove(e) {
   506	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   507	    var st = A.ptr[pid];
   508	    if (!st) return;
   509	    var p = toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   510	    var dx = p.x - st.sx, dy = p.y - st.sy;
   511	    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 8) st.moved = true;
   512	    st.x = p.x; st.y = p.y;
   513	    if (st.scroll) {
   514	      A.scroll = Math.max(0, Math.min(U.scrollMax(), st.s0 - (p.y - st.sy)));
   515	      return;
   516	    }
   517	    if (st.g && st.g.id === 'hand' && st.moved && A.screen === 'battle') {
   518	      if (!A.drag) { A.drag = { idx: st.g.data, x: p.x, y: p.y, pid: pid }; A.sel = st.g.data; A.mode = 'sel'; }
   519	    }
   520	    if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) { A.drag.x = p.x; A.drag.y = p.y; }
   521	  }
   522	  function onUp(e) {
   523	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   524	    var st = A.ptr[pid];
   525	    delete A.ptr[pid];
   526	    if (!st || A.paused) { if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) A.drag = null; return; }
   527	    if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) {
   528	      var g = hit(A.drag.x, A.drag.y);
   529	      A.drag = null;
   530	      if (g && (g.id === 'pslot' || g.id === 'pact')) {
   531	        A.sel = st.g.data;
   532	        slotTap(g.id === 'pact' ? -1 : g.data);
   533	      } else if (g && g.id === 'atk') {
   534	        A.sel = null; A.mode = null; doAction('atk', g.data);
   535	      } else { A.sel = null; A.mode = null; }
   536	      return;
   537	    }
   538	    if (st.scroll || st.moved) return;
   539	    var g2 = hit(st.x, st.y);
   540	    if (g2 && st.g && g2.id === st.g.id) doAction(g2.id, g2.data);
   541	    else if (g2) doAction(g2.id, g2.data);
   542	  }
   543	  function onCancel(e) {
   544	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   545	    if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) A.drag = null;
   546	    delete A.ptr[pid];
   547	  }

   550	  function focusables() {
   551	    var R = U.regions(), out = [];
   552	    for (var i = 0; i < R.length; i++) if (!R[i].dis) out.push(i);
   553	    return out;
   554	  }
   555	  function moveFocus(dx, dy) {
   556	    var R = U.regions(), f = focusables();
   557	    if (!f.length) return;
   558	    if (A.focus < 0 || A.focus >= R.length || R[A.focus].dis) { A.focus = f[0]; return; }
   559	    var cur = R[A.focus];
   560	    var cx = cur.x + cur.w / 2, cy = cur.y + cur.h / 2;
   561	    var best = -1, bd = 1e9;
   562	    for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) {
   563	      var g = R[f[i]];
   564	      if (f[i] === A.focus) continue;
   565	      var gx = g.x + g.w / 2, gy = g.y + g.h / 2;
   566	      var vx = gx - cx, vy = gy - cy;
   567	      if (dx && Math.sign(vx) !== Math.sign(dx)) continue;
   568	      if (dy && Math.sign(vy) !== Math.sign(dy)) continue;
   569	      if (dx && Math.abs(vx) < 4) continue;
   570	      if (dy && Math.abs(vy) < 4) continue;
   571	      var d = dx ? Math.abs(vx) + Math.abs(vy) * 3 : Math.abs(vy) + Math.abs(vx) * 3;
   572	      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = f[i]; }
   573	    }
   574	    if (best >= 0) A.focus = best;
   575	    else if (dy && U.scrollMax() > 0) A.scroll = Math.max(0, Math.min(U.scrollMax(), A.scroll + dy * 70));
   576	  }
   577	  function onKey(e) {
   578	    if (A.keys[e.key]) { /* held */ }
   579	    A.keys[e.key] = 1;
   580	    audioUnlock();
   581	    A.kb = true;
   582	    var k = e.key;
   583	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') { moveFocus(-1, 0); e.preventDefault(); }
   584	    else if (k === 'ArrowRight') { moveFocus(1, 0); e.preventDefault(); }
   585	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp') { moveFocus(0, -1); e.preventDefault(); }
   586	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown') { moveFocus(0, 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   587	    else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   588	      e.preventDefault();
   589	      var R = U.regions();
   590	      if (A.focus >= 0 && A.focus < R.length && !R[A.focus].dis) doAction(R[A.focus].id, R[A.focus].data);
   591	    } else if (k === 'Escape') {
   592	      e.preventDefault();
   593	      if (A.screen === 'battle') doAction('quit');
   594	      else if (A.screen !== 'map') doAction('back');
   595	    }
   596	  }
   597	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete A.keys[e.key]; }

   599	  function onBlur() {
   600	    A.ptr = {}; A.drag = null; A.keys = {};
   601	    clearTimers();
   602	  }

   607	    root.requestAnimationFrame(frame);

   620	      if (p.l <= 0) A.parts.splice(i, 1);
   621	    }

   623	
   624	    var G = A.G;
   625	    if (A.screen === 'battle' && G) {
   626	      consumeFx();

   642	  }

   644	  function render() {
   645	    var c = A.ctx;
   646	    c.setTransform(A.dpr * A.sc0, 0, 0, A.dpr * A.sc0, 0, 0);
   647	    c.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
   648	    U.draw(A);
   649	  }
   650	
   651	  // ------------------------------------------------------------- resize
   652	  function resize() {
   653	    var cw = root.innerWidth, ch = root.innerHeight;
   654	    var sc = Math.min(cw / W, ch / H);
   655	    A.sc = sc;
   656	    var dpr = Math.min(root.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   657	    // cap backing store long axis at ~960
   658	    var backH = H * sc * dpr;
   659	    if (backH > 960) dpr = Math.max(0.25, dpr * (960 / backH));
   660	    A.dpr = dpr;
   661	    A.sc0 = sc;
   662	    A.canvas.width = Math.round(W * sc * dpr);
   663	    A.canvas.height = Math.round(H * sc * dpr);
   664	    A.canvas.style.width = (W * sc) + 'px';
   665	    A.canvas.style.height = (H * sc) + 'px';
   666	    checkOrient();
   667	  }
   668	
   669	  function checkOrient() {
   670	    var land = root.innerWidth > root.innerHeight && root.innerHeight < 520;
   671	    var el = document.getElementById('rotate');
   672	    if (!el) return;
   673	    el.style.display = land ? 'flex' : 'none';
   674	    A.paused = land;
   675	    if (land) { A.ptr = {}; A.drag = null; A.keys = {}; }
   676	    else last = 0;
   677	  }

   681	  function audioUnlock() {
   682	    if (unlocked) return;
   683	    unlocked = true;
   684	    audioInit();
   685	    if (actx && actx.state === 'suspended') { try { actx.resume(); } catch (e) { } }
   686	  }
   687	
   688	  function boot() {
   689	    A.canvas = document.getElementById('game');
   690	    A.ctx = A.canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
   691	    A.sc0 = 1;
   692	    A.save = load();
   693	    A.screen = 'map';
   694	    resize();
   695	
   696	    var cv = A.canvas;
   697	    cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onDown(e); }, { passive: false });
   698	    cv.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); onMove(e); }, { passive: false });
   699	    root.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { onUp(e); }, { passive: false });
   700	    cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel);
   701	    cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   702	    cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   703	    cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   704	    root.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
   705	    root.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
   706	    root.addEventListener('blur', onBlur);
   707	    root.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   708	    root.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { setTimeout(resize, 120); });
   709	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) onBlur(); else last = 0; });
   710	
   711	    var start = document.getElementById('start');
   712	    var go = function () {
   713	      audioUnlock();
   714	      if (start && start.parentNode) start.parentNode.removeChild(start);
   715	      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', go);
   716	      document.removeEventListener('keydown', go);
   717	    };
   718	    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', go);
   719	    document.addEventListener('keydown', go);
   720	
   721	    root.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   722	  }
   723	
   724	  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
   725	  else boot();

   245	  function drawBattle(A) {
   246	    var G = A.G;
   247	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e15'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   248	    // arena backdrop
   249	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.03)';
   250	    ctx.fillRect(0, 96, W, 250);
   251	
   252	    // top bar
   253	    fillRR(0, 0, W, 40, 0, '#141a24');
   254	    btn('quit', 6, 4, 44, 32, 'X', null, '', null);
   255	    t(clip(G.foe.n, 12, 150, true), 56, 14, 12, '#f2f7fc', 'left', true);
   256	    t(G.foe.arch + ' · ' + clip(G.foe.tell, 8, 210), 56, 29, 8, '#8fa2b5');
   257	    // prize markers
   258	    for (var i = 0; i < E.PRIZES; i++) {
   259	      ctx.fillStyle = i < G.p.prizes ? '#ffd98a' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)';

   261	      ctx.fillStyle = i < G.o.prizes ? '#e0603c' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)';
   262	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W - 16 - i * 13, 28, 5, 0, 6.3); ctx.fill();
   263	    }
   264	
   265	    var mode = A.mode;
   266	    // ---- opponent bench
   267	    var bw = (W - 24 - 2 * 8) / 3;
   268	    for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) {
   269	      var x = 12 + i * (bw + 8);
   270	      if (G.o.bench[i]) drawCr(x, LAY.obench.y, bw, LAY.obench.h, G.o.bench[i]);
   271	      else emptySlot(x, LAY.obench.y, bw, LAY.obench.h, '');
   272	    }
   273	    // ---- opponent active
   274	    var ox = (W - LAY.oact.w) / 2;
   275	    if (G.o.active) drawCr(ox, LAY.oact.y, LAY.oact.w, LAY.oact.h, G.o.active, { hl: false });
   276	    else emptySlot(ox, LAY.oact.y, LAY.oact.w, LAY.oact.h, 'no active');
   277	    t('DECK ' + G.o.deck.length, W - 12, LAY.oact.y + 12, 9, '#7b8b9b', 'right');
   278

   280	    var last = G.log.length ? G.log[G.log.length - 1] : '';
   281	    fillRR(10, LAY.logy, W - 20, 22, 6, 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)');
   282	    t(clip(last, 10, W - 34), W / 2, LAY.logy + 11, 10, '#c8d6e3', 'center');
   283	
   284	    // ---- player active
   285	    var px = (W - LAY.pact.w) / 2;
   286	    var canTargetActive = (mode === 'energy') || (mode === 'sel' && A.sel !== null);
   287	    if (G.p.active) drawCr(px, LAY.pact.y, LAY.pact.w, LAY.pact.h, G.p.active, { hl: canTargetActive });
   288	    else emptySlot(px, LAY.pact.y, LAY.pact.w, LAY.pact.h, G.await === 'promote' ? 'promote from bench' : 'drag a creature here', canTargetActive || G.await === 'promote');
   289	    reg('pact', px, LAY.pact.y, LAY.pact.w, LAY.pact.h, -1);
   290	    t('DECK ' + G.p.deck.length, W - 12, LAY.pact.y + 12, 9, '#7b8b9b', 'right');
   291	    t('HAND ' + G.p.hand.length, 12, LAY.pact.y + 12, 9, '#7b8b9b', 'left');
   292	
   293	    // ---- player bench
   294	    for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) {
   295	      var bx = 12 + i * (bw + 8);
   296	      var hl = (mode === 'energy' || mode === 'retreat' || (mode === 'sel' && A.sel !== null) || G.await === 'promote');
   297	      if (G.p.bench[i]) drawCr(bx, LAY.pbench.y, bw, LAY.pbench.h, G.p.bench[i], { hl: hl });
   298	      else emptySlot(bx, LAY.pbench.y, bw, LAY.pbench.h, 'bench', mode === 'sel' && A.sel !== null);
   299	      reg('pslot', bx, LAY.pbench.y, bw, LAY.pbench.h, i);
   300	    }
   301	
   302	    // ---- attack buttons
   303	    var yourTurn = G.who === 'p' && !G.over && G.started && !G.await;
   304	    var A0 = G.p.active;
   305	    for (i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
   306	      var y = LAY.atk + i * 52;
   307	      var atk = A0 ? C[A0.c].a[i] : null;
   308	      if (!atk) {
   309	        fillRR(12, y, W - 24, 48, 8, 'rgba(255,255,255,.04)');
   310	        if (i === 0 && !A0) t(G.await === 'promote' ? 'Tap a benched creature to promote it' : 'Place a creature in your Active slot',
   311	          W / 2, y + 24, 10, '#6d7c8b', 'center');
   312	        continue;
   313	      }
   314	      var ok = yourTurn && E.canAttack(G, G.p, i);
   315	      var dmg = (A0 && G.o.active) ? E.damageOf(G, G.p, G.o, atk) : atk.d;
   316	      fillRR(12, y, W - 24, 48, 8, ok ? 'rgba(224,96,60,.32)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.06)');

   318	      t(clip(atk.n, 13, 200, true), 22, y + 17, 13, ok ? '#fff1e6' : '#75818e', 'left', true);
   319	      pips(26, y + 35, atk.c, atk.m, C[A0.c].e);
   320	      var mult = (G.o.active && D.WEAK_TO[C[G.o.active.c].e] === C[A0.c].e);
   321	      t(String(dmg), W - 24, y + 20, 20, ok ? '#ffd98a' : '#65707d', 'right', true);
   322	      t(mult ? 'WEAKNESS x2' : (atk.x ? atk.x.replace(':', ' ') : ''), W - 24, y + 37, 9, mult ? '#ff9f7a' : '#8b97a4', 'right', true);
   323	      reg('atk', 12, y, W - 24, 48, i, !ok);
   324	    }
   325	
   326	    // ---- action row
   327	    var rw = (W - 30) / 3;
   328	    btn('energy', 12, LAY.row, rw, 48, 'ENERGY', G.p.energyLeft + ' left',
   329	      A.mode === 'energy' ? 'on' : '', null, !yourTurn || G.p.energyLeft <= 0);
   330	    btn('retreat', 18 + rw, LAY.row, rw, 48, 'RETREAT',
   331	      A0 ? 'cost ' + E.retreatCost(A0) : '-', A.mode === 'retreat' ? 'on' : '', null,
   332	      !yourTurn || !A0 || E.countCr(G.p) < 2 || A0.e.length < E.retreatCost(A0));
   333	    btn('end', 24 + rw * 2, LAY.row, rw, 48, 'END TURN', yourTurn ? 'pass' : 'waiting', '', null, !yourTurn);
   334

   336	    drawHand(A, G);
   337	
   338	    // hint
   339	    t(clip(G.hint || (yourTurn ? '' : G.foe.n + ' is thinking...'), 10, W - 20), W / 2, H - 12, 10, '#8fa2b5', 'center');

   345	  function drawHand(A, G) {
   346	    var hand = G.p.hand, n = hand.length;
   347	    var rows = n > 5 ? 2 : 1;
   348	    var cw = rows === 1 ? 72 : 66, ch = rows === 1 ? 104 : 78;
   349	    var hy = rows === 1 ? LAY.hand + 8 : LAY.hand - 6;
   350	    var perRow = Math.ceil(n / rows);
   351	    var panelTop = hy - 8, panelH = rows * (ch + 6) + 10;
   352	    fillRR(6, panelTop, W - 12, panelH, 8, 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)');
   353	    if (!n) { t('hand empty', W / 2, LAY.hand + 40, 10, '#6d7c8b', 'center'); return; }
   354	    var span = Math.min(cw + 6, (W - 22 - cw) / Math.max(1, perRow - 1));
   355	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   356	      var r = Math.floor(i / perRow), col = i % perRow;
   357	      var cnt = Math.min(perRow, n - r * perRow);
   358	      var total = cw + span * (cnt - 1);
   359	      var x = (W - total) / 2 + col * span;
   360	      var selected = (A.sel === i);
   361	      var y = hy + r * (ch + 6) + (selected ? -10 : 0);
   362	      if (A.drag && A.drag.idx === i) continue;
   363	      drawCardFace(x, y, cw, ch, hand[i], { hl: selected });
   364	      reg('hand', x, y, col === cnt - 1 ? cw : Math.min(span, cw), ch, i);
   365	    }
   366	    if (A.drag) {
   367	      var dx = A.drag.x - cw / 2, dy = A.drag.y - ch / 2;
   368	      ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
   369	      drawCardFace(dx, dy, 72, 104, hand[A.drag.idx], { hl: true });
   370	      ctx.restore();
   371	    }
   372	  }

   374	  function drawResult(A, G) {
   375	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(4,7,12,.88)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   376	    var win = G.over === 1;
   377	    fillRR(26, 218, W - 52, 158, 12, 'rgba(20,26,36,.96)');
   378	    strokeRR(26, 218, W - 52, 158, 12, win ? 'rgba(255,217,138,.5)' : 'rgba(224,96,60,.5)', 2);
   379	    t(win ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEATED', W / 2, 250, 34, win ? '#ffd98a' : '#e0603c', 'center', true);
   380	    t(win ? 'Rank ' + (G.rung + 1) + ' cleared' : G.foe.n + ' held the line', W / 2, 284, 12, '#c8d6e3', 'center');
   381	    if (win && G.rung === D.LADDER.length - 1) t('You are the Beastbind Champion.', W / 2, 306, 12, '#7ddc9a', 'center', true);
   382	    var lines = [];
   383	    if (win) {
   384	      lines.push('Wins: ' + A.save.wins);
   385	      lines.push(A.save.wins % 2 === 0 ? 'Pack earned!' : 'Next pack in 1 win');
   386	    }
   387	    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) t(lines[i], W / 2, 336 + i * 18, 11, '#a9bccd', 'center');
   388	    btn('again', 40, 400, W - 80, 54, win ? 'CONTINUE' : 'REMATCH', null, 'on');
   389	    btn('tomap', 40, 464, W - 80, 48, 'LADDER');
   390	  }

   393	  function drawPack(A) {
   394	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e15'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   395	    header(A, 'PACK OPENING', A.save.packs + ' packs left');
   396	    var p = A.pack;
   397	    var cw = 104, ch = 148;
   398	    var xs = [(W - cw * 2 - 12) / 2, (W - cw * 2 - 12) / 2 + cw + 12];
   399	    var revealedAll = p.rev >= 5;
   400	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   401	      var col = i % 2, row = Math.floor(i / 2);
   402	      var x = i === 4 ? (W - cw) / 2 : xs[col];
   403	      var y = 60 + row * (ch + 10);
   404	      if (i < p.rev) {
   405	        drawCardFace(x, y, cw, ch, p.cards[i], {});
   406	        var tagd = p.dupe[i];
   407	        fillRR(x, y + ch - 18, cw, 18, 5, tagd ? 'rgba(224,179,74,.85)' : 'rgba(93,214,122,.85)');
   408	        t(tagd ? '3rd copy -> +1 credit' : (p.isNew[i] ? 'NEW CARD' : 'copy 2/2'), x + cw / 2, y + ch - 9, 8.5, '#10151c', 'center', true);
   409	      } else {
   410	        drawBack(x, y, cw, ch);
   411	      }
   412	      reg('reveal', x, y, cw, ch, i);
   413	    }
   414	    var by = 60 + 2 * (ch + 10) + ch + 10;
   415	    t('PULL RATES (posted)', W / 2, by + 10, 10, '#ffd98a', 'center', true);
   416	    var ry = by + 26;
   417	    for (i = 0; i < D.PACK_RATES.slots.length; i++) {
   418	      var s = D.PACK_RATES.slots[i];
   419	      var str = s.rows.map(function (r) { return r[0] + ' ' + r[1] + '%'; }).join('   ');
   420	      t(s.label, 40, ry, 9.5, '#93a3b4');
   421	      t(str, W - 40, ry, 9.5, '#c8d6e3', 'right');
   422	      ry += 13;
   423	    }
   424	    t('Max 2 copies kept. 3rd copy = +1 credit; ' + D.CLAIM_COST + ' credits claim ANY card.', W / 2, ry + 4, 9, '#7ddc9a', 'center');
   425	    btn(revealedAll ? 'packdone' : 'revealall', 40, H - 62, W - 80, 50,
   426	      revealedAll ? (A.save.packs ? 'OPEN NEXT' : 'DONE') : 'REVEAL ALL', null, 'on');
   427	  }

   430	  function drawColl(A) {
   431	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e15'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   432	    var cols = 4, cw = 88, chh = 122, gap = 6;
   433	    var gx = (W - (cols * cw + (cols - 1) * gap)) / 2;
   434	    var rows = Math.ceil(D.SET_SIZE / cols);
   435	    scrollMax = Math.max(0, 48 + rows * (chh + gap) + 40 - H);
   436	    var off = A.scroll;
   437	    ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, 44, W, H - 44); ctx.clip();
   438	    for (var i = 0; i < D.SET_SIZE; i++) {
   439	      var r = Math.floor(i / cols), c2 = i % cols;
   440	      var x = gx + c2 * (cw + gap), y = 52 + r * (chh + gap) - off;
   441	      if (y > H || y + chh < 40) continue;
   442	      var owned = A.save.col[i] || 0;
   443	      if (owned > 0) {
   444	        drawCardFace(x, y, cw, chh, i, {});
   445	        fillRR(x + 3, y + chh - 16, 22, 13, 4, 'rgba(0,0,0,.75)');
   446	        t('x' + owned, x + 14, y + chh - 9, 8.5, '#ffd98a', 'center', true);
   447	      } else {
   448	        fillRR(x, y, cw, chh, 7, 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)');
   449	        var afford = A.save.credits >= D.CLAIM_COST;
   450	        strokeRR(x, y, cw, chh, 7, afford ? 'rgba(224,179,74,.6)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.12)', 1.4);
   451	        t('#' + (i + 1), x + cw / 2, y + chh / 2 - 14, 11, '#5c6773', 'center', true);
   452	        t(clip(C[i].n, 8.5, cw - 8), x + cw / 2, y + chh / 2 + 2, 8.5, '#4e5866', 'center');
   453	        t(D.RAR[C[i].r], x + cw / 2, y + chh / 2 + 16, 8, D.RAR_COL[C[i].r], 'center');
   454	        t(afford ? 'claim · ' + D.CLAIM_COST + ' cr' : D.CLAIM_COST + ' credits', x + cw / 2, y + chh - 12, 8,
   455	          afford ? '#ffd98a' : '#5c6773', 'center', true);
   456	        reg('claim', x, y, cw, chh, i, !afford);
   457	      }
   458	    }
   459	    ctx.restore();
   460	    fillRR(0, H - 22, W, 22, 0, 'rgba(10,14,21,.92)');
   461	    header(A, 'COLLECTION', collCount(A) + '/' + D.SET_SIZE + '  ·  ' + A.save.credits + ' credits');
   462	    t(A.hint || ('Scroll to browse. ' + D.CLAIM_COST + ' credits claims any missing card.'), W / 2, H - 10, 9.5, '#8fa2b5', 'center');
   463	  }

   472	  function drawDeck(A) {
   473	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e15'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   474	    var ids = [];
   475	    for (var k = 0; k < D.SET_SIZE; k++) if ((A.save.col[k] || 0) > 0) ids.push(k);
   476	    var rowh = 52;
   477	    scrollMax = Math.max(0, 54 + ids.length * (rowh + 4) + 80 - H);
   478	    ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, 44, W, H - 44 - 68); ctx.clip();
   479	    var counts = deckCounts(A);
   480	    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
   481	      var id = ids[i], y = 54 + i * (rowh + 4) - A.scroll;
   482	      if (y > H - 68 || y + rowh < 40) continue;
   483	      var c = C[id], inDeck = counts[id] || 0;
   484	      fillRR(10, y, W - 20, rowh, 7, inDeck ? 'rgba(60,110,175,.22)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)');
   485	      strokeRR(10, y, W - 20, rowh, 7, inDeck ? '#5f9fd8' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.1)', 1.2);
   486	      ctx.fillStyle = c.t === 'h' ? '#6a5aa0' : D.EL_COL[c.e];
   487	      fillRR(14, y + 6, 5, rowh - 12, 2, ctx.fillStyle);
   488	      t(clip(c.n, 12, 170, true), 26, y + 17, 12, '#eef4fa', 'left', true);
   489	      var meta = c.t === 'h' ? 'Handler · ' + D.RAR[c.r] : ('Stage ' + c.s + ' · ' + D.EL[c.e] + ' · HP ' + c.hp);
   490	      t(meta, 26, y + 34, 9, '#93a3b4');
   491	      t('own ' + A.save.col[id], 232, y + 26, 9.5, '#8fa2b5', 'right');
   492	      btn('dminus', 238, y + 4, 44, 44, '-', null, '', id, inDeck <= 0);
   493	      t(String(inDeck), 294, y + 26, 14, inDeck ? '#ffd98a' : '#5c6773', 'center', true);
   494	      btn('dplus', 314, y + 4, 44, 44, '+', null, '', id, inDeck >= Math.min(2, A.save.col[id]) || A.save.deck.length >= 20);
   495	      reg('deckrow', 10, y, W - 20, rowh, id, true);
   496	    }
   497	    ctx.restore();
   498	    header(A, 'DECK', 'max 2 copies per card');
   499	    fillRR(0, H - 68, W, 68, 0, '#141a24');
   500	    var full = A.save.deck.length === 20;
   501	    t(A.save.deck.length + ' / 20', 16, H - 46, 16, full ? '#7ddc9a' : '#e0b34a', 'left', true);
   502	    t(basicCount(A) + ' Stage 1 · ' + (A.save.deck.length - basicCount(A)) + ' other', 16, H - 26, 9.5, '#93a3b4');
   503	    btn('autodeck', 150, H - 58, 108, 48, 'AUTO', 'best owned', '', null);
   504	    btn('deckdone', 266, H - 58, 112, 48, 'SAVE', full ? 'ready' : 'need 20', full ? 'on' : 'warn', null, !full);
   505	  }

   507	  function deckCounts(A) {
   508	    var m = {};
   509	    for (var i = 0; i < A.save.deck.length; i++) m[A.save.deck[i]] = (m[A.save.deck[i]] || 0) + 1;
   510	    return m;
   511	  }
   512	  function basicCount(A) {
   513	    var n = 0;
   514	    for (var i = 0; i < A.save.deck.length; i++) { var c = C[A.save.deck[i]]; if (c.t === 'c' && c.s === 1) n++; }
   515	    return n;
   516	  }

   519	  function drawParticles(A) {
   520	    for (var i = 0; i < A.parts.length; i++) {
   521	      var p = A.parts[i];
   522	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.l / p.L);
   523	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   524	      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.s / 2, p.y - p.s / 2, p.s, p.s);
   525	    }
   526	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   527	  }
   528	
   529	  function draw(A) {
   530	    R.length = 0;
   531	    ctx = A.ctx;
   532	    ctx.save();
   533	    if (A.shake > 0) {
   534	      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * A.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * A.shake);
   535	    }
   536	    switch (A.screen) {
   537	      case 'battle': drawBattle(A); break;
   538	      case 'pack': drawPack(A); break;
   539	      case 'coll': drawColl(A); break;
   540	      case 'deck': drawDeck(A); break;
   541	      default: drawMap(A); scrollMax = 0; break;
   542	    }
   543	    drawParticles(A);
   544	    ctx.restore();
   545	    if (A.flash > 0) {
   546	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + Math.min(0.5, A.flash) + ')';
   547	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   548	    }
   549	    // keyboard focus ring
   550	    if (A.kb && A.focus >= 0 && A.focus < R.length) {
   551	      var f = R[A.focus];
   552	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe89a'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   553	      rr(f.x - 2, f.y - 2, f.w + 4, f.h + 4, 9); ctx.stroke();
   554	    }
   555	    return R;
   556	  }

   160	  function playHandler(G, S, handIdx, arg) {
   161	    var id = S.hand[handIdx];
   162	    if (id === undefined || C[id].t !== 'h') return false;
   163	    var f = C[id].fx, O = (S === G.p) ? G.o : G.p, i, n;
   164	    var did = true;
   165	    switch (f) {
   166	      case 'DRAW2': draw(G, S, 2); break;
   167	      case 'DRAW3': draw(G, S, 3); break;
   168	      case 'HEAL30': did = heal(G, S, 30); break;
   169	      case 'HEAL60': did = heal(G, S, 60); break;
   170	      case 'SCOUT': draw(G, S, 1); heal(G, S, 20); break;
   171	      case 'EXTRA_E': S.energyLeft++; break;
   172	      case 'BOOST20': S.boost += 20; break;
   173	      case 'BOOST40':
   174	        if (!S.active || S.active.e.length < 1) { did = false; break; }
   175	        S.active.e.pop(); S.boost += 40; break;
   176	      case 'SHIELD20': if (!S.active) { did = false; break; } S.active.sh += 20; break;
   177	      case 'QUICKEVO': S.quick = true; break;
   178	      case 'GUST':
   179	        did = false;
   180	        var opts = [];
   181	        for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (O.bench[i]) opts.push(i);
   182	        if (opts.length) { forceSwap(G, O, opts[rnd(opts.length)]); did = true; }
   183	        break;
   184	      case 'SWAPSELF':
   185	        did = retreat(G, S, (arg === undefined ? firstBench(S) : arg), true); break;
   186	      case 'SEARCH':
   187	        did = false;
   188	        for (i = 0; i < S.deck.length; i++) {
   189	          if (C[S.deck[i]].t === 'c' && C[S.deck[i]].s === 1) {
   190	            S.hand.push(S.deck.splice(i, 1)[0]); shuffle(S.deck); did = true; break;
   191	          }
   192	        }
   193	        break;
   194	      case 'RECYCLE':
   195	        n = 0;
   196	        while (S.disc.length && n < 2) { S.deck.push(S.disc.pop()); n++; }
   197	        shuffle(S.deck); did = n > 0; break;
   198	      case 'REBIND':
   199	        did = rebind(G, S, arg); break;
   200	      default: did = false;
   201	    }
   202	    if (!did) return false;
   203	    S.hand.splice(handIdx, 1);
   204	    S.disc.push(id);
   205	    log(G, (S.isAI ? G.foe.n : 'You') + ' played ' + C[id].n);
   206	    fx(G, 'handler', S.isAI ? 'o' : 'p', -1);
   207	    return true;
   208	  }

   212	  function rebind(G, S, slot) {
   213	    // move one energy from a benched creature to the active (or vice-versa if active is full)
   214	    var src = null, i;
   215	    if (slot !== undefined && slot !== null && slot >= 0 && S.bench[slot] && S.bench[slot].e.length) src = S.bench[slot];
   216	    if (!src) for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (S.bench[i] && S.bench[i].e.length) { src = S.bench[i]; break; }
   217	    if (!src || !S.active || S.active.e.length >= 6) return false;
   218	    S.active.e.push(src.e.pop());
   219	    return true;
   220	  }

   248	  function damageOf(G, S, O, atk) {
   249	    var A = S.active, Dn = O.active;
   250	    var dmg = atk.d;
   251	    if (dmg <= 0) return 0;
   252	    dmg += S.boost;
   253	    if (D.WEAK_TO[C[Dn.c].e] === C[A.c].e) dmg *= 2;
   254	    dmg -= Dn.sh;

   258	  function canAttack(G, S, idx) {
   259	    var O = (S === G.p) ? G.o : G.p;
   260	    if (!S.active || !O.active || G.over) return false;
   261	    if (S.active.fzn) return false;
   262	    var atk = C[S.active.c].a[idx];
   263	    if (!atk) return false;
   264	    return energyPay(S.active, atk);
   265	  }

   267	  function attack(G, S, idx) {
   268	    if (!canAttack(G, S, idx)) return false;
   269	    var O = (S === G.p) ? G.o : G.p;
   270	    var A = S.active, atk = C[A.c].a[idx];
   271	    var side = S === G.p ? 'p' : 'o';
   272	    var dmg = damageOf(G, S, O, atk);
   273	    log(G, C[A.c].n + ' used ' + atk.n + (dmg ? ' for ' + dmg : ''));
   274	    if (dmg > 0) {
   275	      O.active.d += dmg;
   276	      fx(G, 'hit', side === 'p' ? 'o' : 'p', dmg);
   277	    }
   278	    // effects
   279	    if (atk.x) {
   280	      var p = atk.x.split(':'), v = parseInt(p[1], 10) || 0;
   281	      if (p[0] === 'recoil') { A.d += v; fx(G, 'hit', side, v); }
   282	      else if (p[0] === 'heal') { A.d = Math.max(0, A.d - v); fx(G, 'heal', side, -1); }
   283	      else if (p[0] === 'drain') { A.d = Math.max(0, A.d - Math.min(v, dmg)); fx(G, 'heal', side, -1); }
   284	      else if (p[0] === 'draw') { draw(G, S, 1); }
   285	      else if (p[0] === 'shield') { A.sh += v; }
   286	      else if (p[0] === 'stall') {
   287	        if (O.active) {
   288	          if (O.active.imm) log(G, C[O.active.c].n + ' shrugs off the bind');
   289	          else { O.active.fz = true; log(G, C[O.active.c].n + ' is bound'); }
   290	        }
   291	      }
   292	      else if (p[0] === 'bench') {
   293	        for (var i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (O.bench[i]) O.bench[i].d += v;
   294	        fx(G, 'benchhit', side === 'p' ? 'o' : 'p', v);
   295	      }
   296	      else if (p[0] === 'gust') {
   297	        var opts = [];
   298	        for (var k = 0; k < BENCH; k++) if (O.bench[k]) opts.push(k);
   299	        if (opts.length) forceSwap(G, O, opts[rnd(opts.length)]);
   300	      }
   301	    }
   302	    resolveKOs(G);
   303	    if (!G.over) endTurn(G);
   304	    return true;
   305	  }
   306	
   307	  function resolveKOs(G) {
   308	    ['p', 'o'].forEach(function (k) {
   309	      var S = G[k], O = G[k === 'p' ? 'o' : 'p'], i;
   310	      for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) {
   311	        if (S.bench[i] && curHp(S.bench[i]) <= 0) {
   312	          discardCr(S, S.bench[i]); S.bench[i] = null;
   313	          O.prizes++; fx(G, 'ko', k, i);
   314	          log(G, (S.isAI ? G.foe.n : 'You') + ' lost a benched creature');
   315	        }
   316	      }
   317	      if (S.active && curHp(S.active) <= 0) {
   318	        log(G, C[S.active.c].n + ' was knocked out');
   319	        discardCr(S, S.active); S.active = null;
   320	        O.prizes++; fx(G, 'ko', k, -1);
   321	      }
   322	    });
   323	    // promote
   324	    ['p', 'o'].forEach(function (k) {
   325	      var S = G[k];
   326	      if (!S.active) {
   327	        var b = firstBench(S);
   328	        if (b >= 0) {
   329	          if (S.isAI) { S.active = S.bench[b]; S.bench[b] = null; S.active.fzn = false; log(G, G.foe.n + ' promoted ' + C[S.active.c].n); }
   330	          else if (countCr(S) > 0) { G.await = 'promote'; }
   331	        }
   332	      }
   333	    });
   334	    checkOver(G);
   335	  }
   336	
   337	  function promote(G, slot) {
   338	    var S = G.p;
   339	    if (S.active || !S.bench[slot]) return false;
   340	    S.active = S.bench[slot]; S.bench[slot] = null; S.active.fzn = false;
   341	    G.await = null;
   342	    log(G, 'You promoted ' + C[S.active.c].n);
   343	    checkOver(G);
   344	    return true;
   345	  }

   347	  function countCr(S) {
   348	    var n = S.active ? 1 : 0;
   349	    for (var i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (S.bench[i]) n++;
   350	    return n;
   351	  }

   353	  function discardCr(S, cr) {
   354	    S.disc.push(cr.c);
   355	    while (S.disc.length > 80) S.disc.shift();
   356	  }
