   358	  function checkOver(G) {
   359	    if (G.over) return;
   360	    if (G.p.prizes >= PRIZES) { G.over = 1; log(G, 'You take the third prize marker. WIN!'); return; }
   361	    if (G.o.prizes >= PRIZES) { G.over = 2; log(G, G.foe.n + ' takes the third marker.'); return; }
   362	    if (!G.o.active && countCr(G.o) === 0) { G.over = 1; log(G, G.foe.n + ' has nothing left. WIN!'); return; }
   363	    if (!G.p.active && countCr(G.p) === 0) { G.over = 2; log(G, 'You have nothing left to send out.'); return; }
   364	  }

   367	  function beginBattle(G) {
   368	    if (G.started) return;
   369	    G.started = true;
   370	    G.who = 'p';
   371	    G.turn = 1;
   372	    startTurn(G, G.p, true);

   375	  function startTurn(G, S, first) {
   376	    var all = allCr(S), i;
   377	    for (i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
   378	      all[i].sh = 0;
   379	      all[i].fzn = all[i].fz;
   380	      all[i].fz = false;
   381	      all[i].imm = all[i].fzn; // cannot be bound on back-to-back turns
   382	    }
   383	    S.energyLeft = 1; S.boost = 0; S.quick = false;
   384	    if (!first) {
   385	      if (!S.deck.length) {
   386	        G.over = (S === G.p) ? 2 : 1;
   387	        log(G, (S === G.p ? 'Your' : G.foe.n + "'s") + ' deck is empty.');
   388	        return;
   389	      }
   390	      draw(G, S, 1);
   391	    }
   392	    G.hint = (S === G.p) ? 'Tap ENERGY then a creature, then tap an attack' : '';
   393	  }

   395	  function allCr(S) {
   396	    var a = [];
   397	    if (S.active) a.push(S.active);
   398	    for (var i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (S.bench[i]) a.push(S.bench[i]);
   399	    return a;
   400	  }
   401	
   402	  function endTurn(G) {
   403	    if (G.over) return;
   404	    resolveKOs(G);
   405	    if (G.over) return;
   406	    if (G.await === 'promote') { G.pendingEnd = true; return; }
   407	    G.who = (G.who === 'p') ? 'o' : 'p';
   408	    G.turn++;
   409	    startTurn(G, G[G.who], false);
   410	    checkOver(G);
   411	  }

   413	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- AI
   414	  function aiSetup(G, S) {
   415	    // active = best basic (highest hp), then fill bench
   416	    var order = S.hand.map(function (id, i) { return { id: id, i: i }; })
   417	      .filter(function (x) { return C[x.id].t === 'c' && C[x.id].s === 1; })
   418	      .sort(function (a, b) { return C[b.id].hp - C[a.id].hp; });
   419	    if (!order.length) return;
   420	    placeActive(G, S, order[0].i);
   421	    var n = 0;
   422	    for (var guard = 0; guard < 6 && n < BENCH; guard++) {
   423	      var idx = -1;
   424	      for (var i = 0; i < S.hand.length; i++) if (C[S.hand[i]].t === 'c' && C[S.hand[i]].s === 1) { idx = i; break; }
   425	      if (idx < 0) break;
   426	      if (!placeBench(G, S, idx, n)) break;
   427	      n++;
   428	    }
   429	    S.setupDone = true;
   430	  }
   431	
   432	  // one discrete AI action per call; returns false when the turn should end
   433	  function aiStep(G) {
   434	    var S = G.o, O = G.p, w = S.w, i, k;
   435	    if (G.over || G.who !== 'o') return false;
   436	
   437	    // 1. promote if needed
   438	    if (!S.active) {
   439	      var b = bestBenchIdx(S);
   440	      if (b >= 0) { S.active = S.bench[b]; S.bench[b] = null; S.active.fzn = false; log(G, G.foe.n + ' promoted ' + C[S.active.c].n); return true; }
   441	      checkOver(G); return false;
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    // 2. evolve (front first)
   445	    for (k = -1; k < BENCH; k++) {
   446	      var cr = evoTarget(S, k);
   447	      if (!cr) continue;
   448	      for (i = 0; i < S.hand.length; i++) {
   449	        if (canEvolve(G, S, S.hand[i], cr)) {
   450	          if (Math.random() < 0.15 + 0.6 * w.evolve) { evolve(G, S, i, k); return true; }
   451	        }
   452	      }
   453	    }
   454	    // 2b. quick-evolve handler
   455	    if (!S.quick && w.evolve > 1.4) {
   456	      for (i = 0; i < S.hand.length; i++) {
   457	        if (C[S.hand[i]].t === 'h' && C[S.hand[i]].fx === 'QUICKEVO') {
   458	          for (k = -1; k < BENCH; k++) {
   459	            var cr2 = evoTarget(S, k);
   460	            if (!cr2) continue;
   461	            for (var q = 0; q < S.hand.length; q++) {
   462	              if (q !== i && C[S.hand[q]].t === 'c' && C[S.hand[q]].ev === cr2.c) {
   463	                if (playHandler(G, S, i)) return true;
   464	              }
   465	            }
   466	          }
   467	        }
   468	      }
   469	    }
   470	
   471	    // 3. bench basics
   472	    var open = -1;
   473	    for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (!S.bench[i]) { open = i; break; }
   474	    if (open >= 0) {
   475	      for (i = 0; i < S.hand.length; i++) {
   476	        if (C[S.hand[i]].t === 'c' && C[S.hand[i]].s === 1) {
   477	          if (Math.random() < 0.3 + 0.5 * w.bench) { placeBench(G, S, i, open); return true; }
   478	        }
   479	      }
   480	    }
   481	
   482	    // 4. handlers
   483	    for (i = 0; i < S.hand.length; i++) {
   484	      var h = C[S.hand[i]];
   485	      if (h.t !== 'h') continue;
   486	      var want = false;
   487	      switch (h.fx) {
   488	        case 'DRAW2': case 'DRAW3': want = S.hand.length <= 5; break;
   489	        case 'SCOUT': want = S.hand.length <= 6; break;
   490	        case 'HEAL30': want = S.active.d >= 30; break;
   491	        case 'HEAL60': want = S.active.d >= 50; break;
   492	        case 'EXTRA_E': want = true; break;
   493	        case 'BOOST20': want = koReachable(G, S, O, 20); break;
   494	        case 'BOOST40': want = S.active.e.length > bestAtkCost(S) && koReachable(G, S, O, 40); break;
   495	        case 'SHIELD20': want = O.active && S.active.d > 0 && w.retreat > 0.4; break;
   496	        case 'GUST': want = countCr(O) > 1 && w.bench > 1.1; break;
   497	        case 'SEARCH': want = !hasBasic(S.hand) && open >= 0; break;
   498	        case 'RECYCLE': want = S.deck.length < 5 && S.disc.length >= 2; break;
   499	        case 'SWAPSELF': want = S.active.d > maxHp(S.active) * 0.7 && firstBench(S) >= 0; break;
   500	        case 'REBIND': want = S.active.e.length < bestAtkCost(S); break;
   501	        case 'QUICKEVO': want = false; break;
   502	      }
   503	      if (want && playHandler(G, S, i)) return true;
   504	    }
   505	
   506	    // 5. energy - to active unless it is doomed and a bench threat exists
   507	    if (S.energyLeft > 0) {
   508	      var target = -1;
   509	      if (w.big > 1.3) {
   510	        // bomb decks charge the biggest thing they have
   511	        var bestSlot = -1, bestVal = valueOf(S.active) - (S.active.d / 10);
   512	        for (i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (S.bench[i] && valueOf(S.bench[i]) > bestVal + 2) { bestVal = valueOf(S.bench[i]); bestSlot = i; }
   513	        target = bestSlot;
   514	      }
   515	      attachEnergy(G, S, target, C[evoTarget(S, target) ? evoTarget(S, target).c : S.active.c].e);
   516	      return true;
   517	    }
   518	
   519	    // 6. retreat a doomed active
   520	    if (S.active.d > maxHp(S.active) * 0.72 && Math.random() < w.retreat) {
   521	      var bb = bestBenchIdx(S);
   522	      if (bb >= 0 && S.active.e.length >= retreatCost(S.active)) { retreat(G, S, bb, false); return true; }
   523	    }
   524	
   525	    // 7. attack
   526	    var atks = C[S.active.c].a, choice = -1, bestScore = -1;
   527	    for (i = 0; i < atks.length; i++) {
   528	      if (!canAttack(G, S, i)) continue;
   529	      var dm = damageOf(G, S, O, atks[i]);
   530	      var sc = dm;
   531	      if (O.active && dm >= curHp(O.active)) sc += 500;
   532	      if (i === atks.length - 1) sc *= (0.8 + 0.2 * w.big);
   533	      if (sc > bestScore) { bestScore = sc; choice = i; }
   534	    }
   535	    if (choice >= 0) {
   536	      // bomb archetypes may hold for the bigger attack
   537	      if (w.big > 1.6 && choice === 0 && atks.length > 1 && S.active.e.length === atks[1].c - 1 && Math.random() < 0.5) {
   538	        endTurn(G); return false;
   539	      }
   540	      attack(G, S, choice);
   541	      return false;
   542	    }
   543	    endTurn(G);
   544	    return false;
   545	  }
   546	
   547	  function bestAtkCost(S) {
   548	    var a = C[S.active.c].a;
   549	    return a.length ? a[a.length - 1].c : 1;
   550	  }
   551	  function valueOf(cr) { return C[cr.c].hp / 10 + C[cr.c].s * 3; }
   552	  function bestBenchIdx(S) {
   553	    var b = -1, v = -1;
   554	    for (var i = 0; i < BENCH; i++) if (S.bench[i]) {
   555	      var val = valueOf(S.bench[i]) - S.bench[i].d / 20 + S.bench[i].e.length;
   556	      if (val > v) { v = val; b = i; }
   557	    }
   558	    return b;
   559	  }
   560	  function koReachable(G, S, O, bonus) {
   561	    if (!O.active || !S.active) return false;
   562	    var a = C[S.active.c].a;
   563	    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
   564	      if (!energyPay(S.active, a[i])) continue;
   565	      var d = damageOf(G, S, O, a[i]) + bonus;
   566	      if (d >= curHp(O.active) && damageOf(G, S, O, a[i]) < curHp(O.active)) return true;
   567	    }
   568	    return false;
   569	  }
   570	
   571	  root.BB_ENGINE = {
   572	    BENCH: BENCH, PRIZES: PRIZES,
   573	    create: create, beginBattle: beginBattle,
   574	    placeActive: placeActive, placeBench: placeBench, evolve: evolve, canEvolve: canEvolve,
   575	    canPlaceBasic: canPlaceBasic, attachEnergy: attachEnergy, retreat: retreat,
   576	    playHandler: playHandler, handlerNeedsTarget: handlerNeedsTarget,
   577	    attack: attack, canAttack: canAttack, damageOf: damageOf, energyPay: energyPay,
   578	    endTurn: endTurn, aiStep: aiStep, promote: promote, evoTarget: evoTarget,
   579	    curHp: curHp, maxHp: maxHp, countCr: countCr, allCr: allCr, shuffle: shuffle,
   580	    retreatCost: retreatCost, log: log
   581	  };
   582	})(window);

    12	  function shuffle(a) {
    13	    for (var i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) { var j = rnd(i + 1); var t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t; }

   275	    flash(route.color);
   276	    mode = 'text';
   277	    startNode(c.go);
   278	  }

   280	  function finish(rid) {
   281	    var t = D.TIERS, idx = aff >= t[0] ? 2 : (aff >= t[1] ? 1 : 0);
   282	    curEnding = ENDINGS[rid][idx];
   283	    save.endings[curEnding.id] = 1;
   284	    save.log[rid] = choiceLog.slice(0, 16);
   285	    if (!save.best[rid] || aff > save.best[rid]) save.best[rid] = aff;
   286	    persist();
   287	    screen = 'ending'; endPage = 0;
   288	    A.ending(); flash('#fff'); shake(6);
   289	    emit(195, 260, 26, curEnding === ENDINGS[rid][2] ? '#ffd9ec' : route.color, 'heart');
   290	  }

   292	  /* ---------- rhythm ---------- */
   293	  function startRhythm() {
   294	    mode = 'rhythm';
   295	    rh = { i: 0, p: 0, gap: 0.8, active: false, hits: 0, fb: '', fbT: 0, done: false, name: node.rhythm.name, results: [] };
   296	  }
   297	  var TRAVEL = 1.15, TR = 46, WIN = 26, PERF = 10;
   298	
   299	  function rhythmTap() {
   300	    if (!rh || !rh.active) return;
   301	    var r = 150 - 104 * rh.p, err = Math.abs(r - TR);
   302	    rh.active = false; rh.gap = 0.42;
   303	    if (err <= PERF) { rh.hits++; aff += 1; rh.fb = 'PERFECT'; rh.fbT = 0.7; rh.results.push(2); A.perfect(); emit(195, 470, 14, '#ffe9a8'); flash('#ffffff'); shake(4); }
   304	    else if (err <= WIN) { rh.hits++; aff += 1; rh.fb = 'GOOD'; rh.fbT = 0.7; rh.results.push(1); A.hit(rh.i); emit(195, 470, 8, route.color); shake(2); }
   305	    else { rh.fb = 'OFF-BEAT'; rh.fbT = 0.7; rh.results.push(0); A.miss(); }
   306	    rh.i++;
   307	  }
   308	
   309	  function updRhythm(dt) {
   310	    if (rh.fbT > 0) rh.fbT -= dt;
   311	    if (rh.done) { rh.gap -= dt; if (rh.gap <= 0) { mode = 'text'; node._rdone = true; rh = null; nextFrom(); } return; }
   312	    if (rh.active) {
   313	      rh.p += dt / TRAVEL;
   314	      if (rh.p > 1 + (WIN / 104)) { rh.active = false; rh.gap = 0.42; rh.fb = 'MISSED'; rh.fbT = 0.7; rh.results.push(0); rh.i++; A.miss(); }
   315	      return;
   316	    }
   317	    rh.gap -= dt;
   318	    if (rh.gap <= 0) {
   319	      if (rh.i >= 3) { rh.done = true; rh.gap = 0.9; if (rh.hits === 3) { flash('#ffd9ec'); emit(195, 300, 18, '#ffd9ec', 'heart'); A.heart(); } }
   320	      else { rh.active = true; rh.p = 0; A.blip(rh.i); }
   321	    }
   322	  }

   324	  /* ---------- text util ---------- */
   325	  var wrapCache = {};
   326	  function wrap(text, font, maxw) {
   327	    var key = font + '|' + maxw + '|' + text;
   328	    if (wrapCache[key]) return wrapCache[key];
   329	    ctx.font = font;
   330	    var words = text.split(' '), out = [], cur = '';
   331	    for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
   332	      var t = cur ? cur + ' ' + words[i] : words[i];
   333	      if (ctx.measureText(t).width > maxw && cur) { out.push(cur); cur = words[i]; }
   334	      else cur = t;
   335	    }
   336	    if (cur) out.push(cur);
   337	    var keys = Object.keys(wrapCache);
   338	    if (keys.length > 400) delete wrapCache[keys[0]];
   339	    wrapCache[key] = out;
   340	    return out;
   341	  }

   354	    ctx.lineWidth = foc ? 2.5 : 1.2;

   357	    ctx.restore();
   358	  }

   360	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
   361	    ctx.beginPath();
   362	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   363	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   364	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   365	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   366	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   367	    ctx.closePath();
   368	  }

   446	  function drawChar(r, cx, cy, s, speaking) {
   447	    var bob = Math.sin(time * 1.6) * 4;
   448	    var talk = speaking ? Math.sin(time * 14) * 1.5 : 0;
   449	    ctx.save();
   450	    ctx.translate(cx, cy + bob);
   451	    ctx.scale(s, s);
   452	    // glow
   453	    var gr = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 150);
   454	    gr.addColorStop(0, r.color + '33'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
   455	    ctx.fillStyle = gr; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 20, 150, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   456	    // body
   457	    ctx.fillStyle = r.accent;
   458	    ctx.beginPath();
   459	    ctx.moveTo(-58, 150); ctx.lineTo(-36, 26); ctx.lineTo(36, 26); ctx.lineTo(58, 150);
   460	    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   461	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.10)';
   462	    ctx.fillRect(-10, 26, 20, 124);
   463	    // shoulders / role accent
   464	    ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
   465	    if (r.shape === 'hex') { ctx.fillRect(-44, 30, 88, 10); ctx.fillRect(-40, 66, 26, 8); }
   466	    else if (r.shape === 'leaf') {
   467	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-40, 52, 22, 10, -0.6, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   468	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(40, 52, 22, 10, 0.6, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   469	    } else {
   470	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-38, 30); ctx.lineTo(-84, 62); ctx.lineTo(-34, 56); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   471	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(38, 30); ctx.lineTo(84, 62); ctx.lineTo(34, 56); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   472	    }
   473	    // neck + head
   474	    ctx.fillStyle = r.accent; ctx.fillRect(-9, 6, 18, 24);
   475	    ctx.fillStyle = r.color;
   476	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -22 + talk * 0.3, 30, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   477	    // headgear per role
   478	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)';
   479	    if (r.shape === 'hex') ctx.fillRect(-32, -40, 64, 9);
   480	    else if (r.shape === 'leaf') { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(18, -48, 18, 8, -0.7, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill(); }
   481	    else { ctx.fillRect(-34, -30, 68, 11); }
   482	    // eyes
   483	    ctx.fillStyle = '#08101c';
   484	    ctx.fillRect(-15, -26, 8, speaking ? 5 : 4);
   485	    ctx.fillRect(7, -26, 8, speaking ? 5 : 4);
   486	    ctx.fillRect(-6 + talk, -12, 12, 3 + Math.abs(talk));
   487	    ctx.restore();
   488	  }

   794	  /* ---------- main loop ---------- */
   795	  var last = 0;
   796	  function frame(ts) {
   797	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   798	    if (!last) last = ts;
   799	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   800	    last = ts;
   801	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   802	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   803	
   804	    fitIfNeeded();
   805	
   806	    if (landscape) {
   807	      if (!paused) { paused = true; releaseAll(); queuedTap = false; }
   808	      time += dt * 0.5;
   809	      drawRotate();
   810	      return;
   811	    }
   812	    if (paused) { paused = false; queuedTap = false; }
   813	
   814	    time += dt;
   815	    update(dt);
   816	    render();
   817	  }
   818	
   819	  var lastW = -1, lastH = -1;
   820	  function fitIfNeeded() {
   821	    if (window.innerWidth !== lastW || window.innerHeight !== lastH) {
   822	      lastW = window.innerWidth; lastH = window.innerHeight; fit();
   823	    }
   824	  }
   825	
   826	  function update(dt) {
   827	    updParts(dt);
   828	    if (shakeT > 0) { shakeT -= dt; if (shakeT <= 0) shakeM = 0; }
   829	    if (flashT > 0) flashT -= dt;
   830	
   831	    // build interactive buttons for this frame
   832	    btns = [];
   833	    if (screen === 'title') buildTitle();
   834	    else if (screen === 'select') buildSelect();
   835	    else if (screen === 'story') buildStory();
   836	    else if (screen === 'ending') buildEnding();
   837	    else if (screen === 'map') buildMap();
   838	    navBtns = [];
   839	    for (var bi = 0; bi < btns.length; bi++) { btns[bi].foc = false; if (btns[bi].k !== 'mute') navBtns.push(btns[bi]); }
   840	    if (focusIdx >= navBtns.length) focusIdx = 0;
   841	    if (navBtns.length && navBtns[focusIdx]) navBtns[focusIdx].foc = true;
   842	
   843	    if (screen === 'story') {
   844	      if (mode === 'rhythm' && rh) {
   845	        if (queuedTap) { queuedTap = false; rhythmTap(); }
   846	        updRhythm(dt);
   847	      } else if (mode === 'text') {
   848	        var full = lines[li] ? lines[li][1].length : 0;
   849	        if (typed < full) {
   850	          typed += dt * 62;
   851	          if (Math.floor(typed) % 3 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.35) A.blip(li);
   852	          if (typed > full) typed = full;
   853	        }
   854	        if (queuedTap) { queuedTap = false; A.tap(); advance(); }
   855	      } else { queuedTap = false; }
   856	    } else if (screen === 'ending') {
   857	      if (queuedTap) {
   858	        queuedTap = false;
   859	        if (endPage < curEnding.text.length) { endPage++; A.tap(); if (endPage === curEnding.text.length) { emit(195, 190, 14, '#ffd9ec', 'heart'); focusIdx = 0; } }
   860	      }
   861	    } else queuedTap = false;
   862	  }
   863	
   864	  function render() {
   865	    ctx.setTransform(bs, 0, 0, bs, 0, 0);
   866	    ctx.fillStyle = '#05060f'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);
   867	    var sx = 0, sy = 0;
   868	    if (shakeT > 0) { sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeM * 2; sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * shakeM * 2; }
   869	    ctx.setTransform(bs * sc, 0, 0, bs * sc, bs * (offX + sx), bs * (offY + sy));
   870	    ctx.save();
   871	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(0, 0, W, H); ctx.clip();
   872	    ctx.fillStyle = '#04050c'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   873	
   874	    if (screen === 'title') drawTitle();
   875	    else if (screen === 'select') drawSelect();
   876	    else if (screen === 'story') drawStory();
   877	    else if (screen === 'ending') drawEnding();
   878	    else if (screen === 'map') drawMap();
   879	
   880	    if (flashT > 0) {
   881	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, flashT / 0.22) * 0.35;
   882	      ctx.fillStyle = flashC; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   883	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   884	    }
   885	    ctx.restore();
   886	  }

    86	      var r = d.res[k], cells = [], x;
    87	      for (x = r.x0; x <= r.x1; x++) if (G.st.pins[r.py * S.W + x] === r.id) cells.push(x);
    88	      if (!cells.length) continue;
    89	      G.pins.push({
    90	        id: r.id, py: r.py, anchor: r.anchor, mat: r.mat,
    91	        lo: Math.min.apply(null, cells), hi: Math.max.apply(null, cells),
    92	        out: 0, t: 0
    93	      });
    94	    }
    95	    G.pins.sort(function (a, b) { return a.py - b.py || a.anchor - b.anchor; });
    96	    G.sel = 0;
    97	    G.screen = 'play';
    98	    var wing = (i / 10) | 0;
    99	    G.hint = i === 0
   100	      ? 'Drag a key out: treasure to Rell, lava to the side pits.'
   101	      : wing === 0 ? 'Order matters. A wrong key loses the treasure.'
   102	        : wing === 1 ? 'Water freezes lava into stone. Time it.'
   103	          : 'Marshgas turns to fire the moment lava touches it.';
   104	  }
   105	
   106	  function nextUnsolved() {
   107	    for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) if (!save.done[i]) return i;
   108	    return 29;
   109	  }
   110	  function unlocked(i) { return i === 0 || !!save.done[i - 1]; }
   111	
   112	  // ---------- particles ----------
   113	  function spark(x, y, n, col, spd, life) {
   114	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   115	      if (G.parts.length >= 220) break;
   116	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = spd * (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8);
   117	      G.parts.push({
   118	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - spd * 0.3,
   119	        l: life * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.6), m: life, c: col, r: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2
   120	      });
   121	    }
   122	  }
   123	  function cellPx(x, y) { return [BX + (x + 0.5) * CELL, BY + (y + 0.5) * CELL]; }
   124	
   125	  function handleEvents(st) {
   126	    var e = st.events, i;
   127	    if (!e || !e.length) return;
   128	    for (i = 0; i < e.length; i += 3) {
   129	      var t = e[i], p = cellPx(e[i + 1], e[i + 2]);
   130	      if (t === 1) { spark(p[0], p[1], 6, '#ffd34d', 90, 0.5); AU.play('coin', st.collected); G.flash = Math.max(G.flash, 0.18); }
   131	      else if (t === 2) { spark(p[0], p[1], 8, '#cfe8ff', 70, 0.6); AU.play('sizzle'); G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 3); }
   132	      else if (t === 3) { spark(p[0], p[1], 7, '#ff8c2b', 130, 0.5); AU.play('ignite'); G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 6); G.flash = Math.max(G.flash, 0.3); }
   133	      else if (t === 4) { spark(p[0], p[1], 20, '#ff4b3a', 150, 0.8); G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 12); }
   134	      else if (t === 6) { spark(p[0], p[1], 5, '#ff9a3c', 60, 0.4); AU.play('burn'); }
   135	      else if (t === 7) { spark(p[0], p[1], 16, '#c07bff', 120, 0.7); AU.play('slay'); G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 7); }
   136	    }
   137	    e.length = 0;
   138	  }
   139	
   140	  // ---------- outcome ----------
   141	  function checkOutcome() {
   142	    var st = G.st;
   143	    if (G.over) return;
   144	    if (!st.dead && st.monsters === 0 && st.collected >= G.target) return win();
   145	    if (st.dead) return fail('The chamber claimed him.');
   146	    if (!G.settled) return;
   147	    var goldLeft = S.countMat(st.grid, S.GOLD);
   148	    var lava = S.countMat(st.grid, S.LAVA) + S.countMat(st.grid, S.GAS);
   149	    var pinsLeft = 0;
   150	    for (var i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) if (!G.pins[i].out) pinsLeft++;
   151	    if (st.collected + goldLeft < G.target) return fail('Treasure lost to the fire.');
   152	    if (st.monsters > 0 && lava === 0) return fail('Nothing left to slay the beasts.');
   153	    if (pinsLeft === 0) return fail('Out of keys.');
   154	    // once per settle: is the chamber still winnable with the keys that remain?
   155	    if (G.checked) return;
   156	    G.checked = true;
   157	    if (pinsLeft > 4) return;
   158	    var rem = [];
   159	    for (i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) if (!G.pins[i].out) rem.push(G.pins[i].id);
   160	    var probe = S.clone(st);
   161	    var an = GEN.analyze(probe, rem, 200, true, G.target);
   162	    if (!an || an.best < G.target) fail('No path left to the vault.');
   163	  }
   164	
   165	  function win() {
   166	    G.over = 'win'; G.overT = 0;
   167	    G.flash = 0.5; G.shake = 6;
   168	    save.done[G.level] = 1;
   169	    if (!save.best[G.level] || G.pulls < save.best[G.level]) save.best[G.level] = G.pulls;
   170	    writeSave();
   171	    var all = true;
   172	    for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) if (!save.done[i]) all = false;
   173	    if (all) { G.over = 'crown'; AU.play('crown'); } else AU.play('win');
   174	    for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) spark(DW / 2, BY + BH - 60, 1, '#ffd34d', 200, 1.2);
   175	  }
   176	  function fail(msg) {
   177	    G.over = 'fail'; G.overT = 0; G.banner = msg;
   178	    G.shake = 14; AU.play('fail');
   179	  }
   180	
   181	  // ---------- input state ----------
   182	  function resetInput() {
   183	    for (var k in pointers) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(pointers, k)) delete pointers[k];
   184	    for (var q in keys) if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(keys, q)) delete keys[q];
   185	  }
   186	
   187	  function pullPin(p) {
   188	    if (!p || p.out || G.over || G.paused) return;
   189	    p.out = 1; p.t = 0;
   190	    G.st.events = G.st.events || [];
   191	    for (var k = 0; k < 8; k++) G.st.hist[k] = 0;   // cycle detection is per-pull, as in the solver
   192	    G.st.hi = 0;
   193	    S.pull(G.st, p.id);
   194	    G.pulls++;
   195	    G.settled = false;
   196	    G.checked = false;
   197	    AU.play('pull');
   198	    G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, 4);
   199	  }
   200	
   201	  function handleAt(px, py) {
   202	    for (var i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) {
   203	      var p = G.pins[i];
   204	      if (p.out) continue;
   205	      var h = handlePos(p);
   206	      var dx = px - h[0], dy = py - h[1];
   207	      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 34 * 34) return i;
   208	    }
   209	    return -1;
   210	  }
   211	  function handlePos(p) {
   212	    var y = BY + (p.py + 0.5) * CELL;
   213	    return [p.anchor < 0 ? BX - 24 : BX + BW + 24, y];
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  // buttons: rect list rebuilt per frame-ish (static per screen)
   217	  function buttons() {
   218	    if (G.screen === 'play') {
   219	      return [
   220	        { id: 'retry', x: 24, y: 634, w: 156, h: 52, t: 'Retry' },
### game 220-520
   220	        { id: 'retry', x: 24, y: 634, w: 156, h: 52, t: 'Retry' },
   221	        { id: 'kingdom', x: 210, y: 634, w: 156, h: 52, t: 'Kingdom' }
   222	      ];
   223	    }
   224	    if (G.screen === 'kingdom') {
   225	      var b = [{ id: 'play', x: 45, y: 620, w: 300, h: 58, t: 'Enter chamber ' + (nextUnsolved() + 1) }];
   226	      for (var i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
   227	        var c = i % 6, r = (i / 6) | 0;
   228	        b.push({ id: 'lv' + i, x: 30 + c * 56, y: 340 + r * 54, w: 48, h: 48, t: '', lv: i });
   229	      }
   230	      return b;
   231	    }
   232	    return [];
   233	  }
   234	  function hitBtn(px, py) {
   235	    var bs = buttons();
   236	    for (var i = 0; i < bs.length; i++) {
   237	      var b = bs[i];
   238	      if (px >= b.x - 4 && px <= b.x + b.w + 4 && py >= b.y - 4 && py <= b.y + b.h + 4) return b;
   239	    }
   240	    return null;
   241	  }
   242	
   243	  function pressBtn(b) {
   244	    AU.play('tap');
   245	    if (b.id === 'retry') startLevel(G.level);
   246	    else if (b.id === 'kingdom') { G.screen = 'kingdom'; G.over = null; resetInput(); }
   247	    else if (b.id === 'play') startLevel(nextUnsolved());
   248	    else if (b.lv != null) { if (unlocked(b.lv)) startLevel(b.lv); }
   249	  }

   251	  // ---------- pointer plumbing ----------
   252	  function toDesign(ev) {
   253	    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   254	    return [(ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width * DW, (ev.clientY - r.top) / r.height * DH];
   255	  }
   256	
   257	  function onDown(ev) {
   258	    ev.preventDefault();
   259	    AU.unlock();
   260	    if (G.rotate) return;
   261	    var p = toDesign(ev), px = p[0], py = p[1];
   262	    if (G.screen === 'boot') { G.screen = 'play'; startLevel(nextUnsolved()); return; }
   263	    if (G.over === 'win' || G.over === 'crown') {
   264	      if (G.overT > 0.35) { if (G.over === 'crown') { G.screen = 'kingdom'; G.over = 'crown'; } else { G.screen = 'kingdom'; G.over = null; } }
   265	      return;
   266	    }
   267	    if (G.over === 'fail') { if (G.overT > 0.25) startLevel(G.level); return; }
   268	    var b = hitBtn(px, py);
   269	    if (b) { pointers[ev.pointerId] = { kind: 'btn', b: b }; return; }
   270	    if (G.screen === 'play') {
   271	      var i = handleAt(px, py);
   272	      if (i >= 0) { G.sel = i; pointers[ev.pointerId] = { kind: 'pin', i: i, x0: px, y0: py, moved: 0 }; }
   273	    }
   274	  }
   275	  function onMove(ev) {
   276	    var d = pointers[ev.pointerId];
   277	    if (!d) return;
   278	    ev.preventDefault();
   279	    if (d.kind !== 'pin') return;
   280	    var p = toDesign(ev), dx = p[0] - d.x0, dy = p[1] - d.y0;
   281	    d.moved = Math.max(d.moved, Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy));
   282	    var pin = G.pins[d.i];
   283	    if (!pin || pin.out) { delete pointers[ev.pointerId]; return; }
   284	    if (dx * pin.anchor > 16) { pullPin(pin); delete pointers[ev.pointerId]; }
   285	  }
   286	  function onUp(ev) {
   287	    var d = pointers[ev.pointerId];
   288	    delete pointers[ev.pointerId];
   289	    if (!d) return;
   290	    ev.preventDefault();
   291	    if (d.kind === 'btn') {
   292	      var p = toDesign(ev);
   293	      var b = hitBtn(p[0], p[1]);
   294	      if (b && b.id === d.b.id) pressBtn(b);
   295	    } else if (d.kind === 'pin' && d.moved < 14) {
   296	      pullPin(G.pins[d.i]);   // forgiving tap
   297	    }
   298	  }
   299	  function onCancel(ev) { delete pointers[ev.pointerId]; }
   300	
   301	  function onKey(ev) {
   302	    var k = ev.key;
   303	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight') ev.preventDefault();
   304	    if (ev.repeat) return;
   305	    keys[k] = 1;
   306	    AU.unlock();
   307	    if (G.rotate) return;
   308	    if (G.screen === 'boot') { startLevel(nextUnsolved()); return; }
   309	    if (G.over === 'fail') { if (G.overT > 0.25) startLevel(G.level); return; }
   310	    if (G.over === 'win' || G.over === 'crown') { if (G.overT > 0.35) { G.screen = 'kingdom'; if (G.over === 'win') G.over = null; } return; }
   311	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { startLevel(G.level); return; }
   312	    if (k === 'Escape') { G.screen = G.screen === 'kingdom' ? 'play' : 'kingdom'; resetInput(); return; }
   313	    if (G.screen === 'kingdom') {
   314	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { AU.play('tap'); startLevel(nextUnsolved()); }
   315	      return;
   316	    }
   317	    var live = [];
   318	    for (var i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) if (!G.pins[i].out) live.push(i);
   319	    if (!live.length) return;
   320	    if (live.indexOf(G.sel) < 0) G.sel = live[0];
   321	    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowRight') G.sel = live[(live.indexOf(G.sel) + 1) % live.length];
   322	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowLeft') G.sel = live[(live.indexOf(G.sel) + live.length - 1) % live.length];
   323	    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') pullPin(G.pins[G.sel]);
   324	  }
   325	  function onKeyUp(ev) { delete keys[ev.key]; }
   326	  function onBlur() { resetInput(); }
   327	
   328	  // ---------- drawing ----------
   329	  function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {
   330	    ctx.beginPath();
   331	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   332	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   333	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   334	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   335	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   336	    ctx.closePath();
   337	  }
   338	  function text(t, x, y, size, col, align, weight) {
   339	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   340	    ctx.font = (weight || '600') + ' ' + size + 'px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';
   341	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'center';
   342	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   343	    ctx.fillText(t, x, y);
   344	  }

   346	  function drawCells() {
   347	    var g = G.st.grid, x, y, i, c, px, py, t = G.time;
   348	    for (y = 0; y < S.H; y++) {
   349	      for (x = 0; x < S.W; x++) {
   350	        i = y * S.W + x; c = g[i];
   351	        if (c === S.EMPTY) continue;
   352	        px = BX + x * CELL; py = BY + y * CELL;
   353	        if (c === S.WALL) { ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3247'; ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL); ctx.fillStyle = '#353d55'; ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, 3); }
   354	        else if (c === S.STONE) { ctx.fillStyle = '#5b6478'; rr(px + 1, py + 1, CELL - 2, CELL - 2, 4); ctx.fill(); }
   355	        else if (c === S.CUP) { ctx.fillStyle = '#141a2a'; ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL); }
   356	        else if (c === S.PIN) {
   357	          ctx.fillStyle = '#d9ab4c'; rr(px, py + 4, CELL, CELL - 8, 3); ctx.fill();
   358	          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,238,190,.45)'; ctx.fillRect(px, py + 5, CELL, 2);
   359	        } else if (c === S.GOLD) {
   360	          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd34d';
   361	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + CELL / 2, py + CELL / 2, CELL * 0.38, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   362	          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff2b8';
   363	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + CELL * 0.4, py + CELL * 0.38, CELL * 0.12, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   364	        } else if (c === S.LAVA) {
   365	          var f = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 5 + (x * 3 + y * 7));
   366	          ctx.fillStyle = f > 0.6 ? '#ff8a30' : '#f0521f';
   367	          ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
   368	          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,214,120,' + (0.15 + 0.25 * f) + ')';
   369	          ctx.fillRect(px + 2, py + 2, CELL - 4, CELL * 0.35);
   370	        } else if (c === S.WATER) {
   371	          ctx.fillStyle = '#2f86e0'; ctx.fillRect(px, py, CELL, CELL);
   372	          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,220,255,.35)';
   373	          ctx.fillRect(px, py + 3 + Math.sin(t * 4 + x) * 2, CELL, 3);
   374	        } else if (c === S.GAS) {
   375	          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,235,140,.55)';
   376	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + CELL / 2, py + CELL / 2 + Math.sin(t * 3 + x) * 2, CELL * 0.44, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   377	        } else if (c === S.MONSTER) {
   378	          ctx.fillStyle = '#a94bd8';
   379	          rr(px + 1, py + 2, CELL - 2, CELL - 3, 7); ctx.fill();
   380	          ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe9a8';
   381	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + CELL * 0.34, py + CELL * 0.45, 2.6, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   382	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + CELL * 0.66, py + CELL * 0.45, 2.6, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   383	          ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a1150'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
   384	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px + 5, py + CELL - 5); ctx.lineTo(px + CELL - 5, py + CELL - 5); ctx.stroke();
   385	        } else if (c === S.HERO) {
   386	          var bob = Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 1.4;
   387	          ctx.fillStyle = G.st.dead ? '#7d8598' : '#3fe3c4';
   388	          rr(px + 3, py + 3 + bob, CELL - 6, CELL - 6, 5); ctx.fill();
   389	          ctx.fillStyle = '#08222c';
   390	          ctx.fillRect(px + 6, py + 8 + bob, 3, 3);
   391	          ctx.fillRect(px + CELL - 9, py + 8 + bob, 3, 3);
   392	          ctx.fillStyle = '#d9ab4c';
   393	          ctx.fillRect(px + 4, py + CELL - 8 + bob, CELL - 8, 3);
   394	        }
   395	      }
   396	    }
   397	  }

   399	  function drawPins() {
   400	    for (var i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) {
   401	      var p = G.pins[i];
   402	      var y = BY + p.py * CELL, h = handlePos(p);
   403	      var off = p.out ? Math.min(1, p.t / 0.22) * 90 * p.anchor : 0;
   404	      if (p.out && p.t > 0.5) continue;
   405	      var x0 = BX + p.lo * CELL, x1 = BX + (p.hi + 1) * CELL;
   406	      var rodA = p.anchor < 0 ? h[0] : x1, rodB = p.anchor < 0 ? x0 : h[0];
   407	      ctx.save();
   408	      ctx.globalAlpha = p.out ? Math.max(0, 1 - p.t / 0.5) : 1;
   409	      // rod
   410	      ctx.fillStyle = '#b9903c';
   411	      ctx.fillRect(Math.min(rodA, rodB) + off, y + CELL * 0.34, Math.abs(rodB - rodA), CELL * 0.32);
   412	      if (p.out) { ctx.fillStyle = '#d9ab4c'; rr(x0 + off, y + 4, x1 - x0, CELL - 8, 3); ctx.fill(); }
   413	      // handle (48px+ target)
   414	      var sel = (!p.out && i === G.sel);
   415	      ctx.fillStyle = sel ? '#ffe08a' : '#d9ab4c';
   416	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(h[0] + off, h[1], 15, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   417	      ctx.strokeStyle = sel ? '#fff6d5' : 'rgba(255,240,200,.5)';
   418	      ctx.lineWidth = sel ? 3 : 2;
   419	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(h[0] + off, h[1], sel ? 20 : 17, 0, 6.284); ctx.stroke();
   420	      ctx.fillStyle = '#2a2110';
   421	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(h[0] + off, h[1], 5, 0, 6.284); ctx.fill();
   422	      ctx.restore();
   423	    }
   424	  }

   461	  function drawKingdom() {

   574	  function frame(now) {
   575	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   576	    var dt = last ? Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000) : 0;
   577	    last = now;
   578	
   579	    var rot = root.innerWidth > root.innerHeight * 1.12;
   580	    if (rot !== G.rotate) { G.rotate = rot; if (rot) resetInput(); G.acc = 0; }
   581	    G.paused = G.rotate;
   582	
   583	    if (!G.paused) {
   584	      G.time += dt;
   585	      G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 40);
   586	      G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 2.2);
   587	      var i;
   588	      for (i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   589	        var p = G.parts[i];
   590	        p.l -= dt;
   591	        if (p.l <= 0) { G.parts[i] = G.parts[G.parts.length - 1]; G.parts.pop(); continue; }
   592	        p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 260 * dt;
   593	      }
   594	      if (G.parts.length > 220) G.parts.length = 220;
   595	
   596	      if (G.screen === 'play' && G.st) {
   597	        for (i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) if (G.pins[i].out) G.pins[i].t += dt;
   598	        if (G.over) G.overT += dt;
   599	        else {
   600	          G.acc += dt;
   601	          var stepDt = 1 / 16, guard = 0;
   602	          while (G.acc >= stepDt && guard < 4) {
   603	            G.acc -= stepDt; guard++;
   604	            if (!G.settled) {
   605	              var ch = S.step(G.st);
   606	              handleEvents(G.st);
   607	              if (!ch) G.settled = true;
   608	              else {
   609	                var h = S.hash(G.st.grid), rep = 0, k;
   610	                for (k = 0; k < 8; k++) if (G.st.hist[k] === h) rep = 1;
   611	                G.st.hist[G.st.hi] = h; G.st.hi = (G.st.hi + 1) & 7;
   612	                if (rep) G.settled = true;
   613	              }
   614	            }
   615	            checkOutcome();
   616	            if (G.over) break;
   617	          }
   618	          if (G.acc > 0.4) G.acc = 0;
   619	        }
   620	      }
   621	    }
   622	    render();
   623	  }

   636	    canvas.width = bw; canvas.height = bh;
   637	    view.s = bw / DW;

     1	/* Dominion Keys - deterministic chamber simulation */
     2	(function (root) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	
     5	  var W = 13, H = 22, N = W * H;
     6	  var EMPTY = 0, WALL = 1, GOLD = 2, LAVA = 3, WATER = 4, GAS = 5,
     7	      STONE = 6, MONSTER = 7, DRAIN = 8, PIN = 9, HERO = 10, CUP = 11;
     8	
     9	  function makeState(grid, pinIds) {
    10	    return {
    11	      grid: grid,
    12	      pins: pinIds,           // Uint8Array, 0 = not a pin cell
    13	      moved: new Uint8Array(N),
    14	      tick: 0,
    15	      collected: 0,
    16	      lost: 0,
    17	      monsters: 0,
    18	      dead: 0,
    19	      pulled: 0,              // bitmask of pulled pin ids (1..8)
    20	      events: null,           // optional array for fx (nulled in solver)
    21	      hist: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    22	      hi: 0
    23	    };
    24	  }
    25	
    26	  function clone(s) {
    27	    var c = makeState(s.grid.slice(0), s.pins);
    28	    c.tick = s.tick; c.collected = s.collected; c.lost = s.lost;
    29	    c.monsters = s.monsters; c.dead = s.dead; c.pulled = s.pulled;
    30	    return c;
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  function countMonsters(g) {
    34	    var n = 0;
    35	    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) if (g[i] === MONSTER) n++;
    36	    return n;
    37	  }
    38	
    39	  function countMat(g, m) {
    40	    var n = 0;
    41	    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) if (g[i] === m) n++;
    42	    return n;
    43	  }
    44	
    45	  function pull(s, id) {
    46	    if (s.pulled & (1 << id)) return false;
    47	    s.pulled |= (1 << id);
    48	    var g = s.grid, p = s.pins;
    49	    for (var i = 0; i < N; i++) if (p[i] === id && g[i] === PIN) g[i] = EMPTY;
    50	    return true;
    51	  }
    52	
    53	  function ev(s, type, x, y) {
    54	    if (s.events && s.events.length < 64) s.events.push(type, x, y);
    55	  }
    56	
    57	  // can material m enter cell value t (target)
    58	  function canEnter(m, t) {
    59	    if (t === DRAIN) return m !== MONSTER;
    60	    if (t === EMPTY || t === CUP) return true;
    61	    if (t === GAS && m !== GAS) return true;
    62	    if (t === WATER && (m === GOLD || m === MONSTER)) return true;
    63	    return false;
    64	  }
    65	
    66	  // no corner cutting: a diagonal needs the side OR the vertical neighbour open
    67	  function diagOK(m, g, i, d, vertOpen) {
    68	    return vertOpen || canEnter(m, g[i + d]);
    69	  }
    70	
    71	  // returns 1 if moved
    72	  function moveTo(s, i, j, m) {
    73	    var g = s.grid, t = g[j];
    74	    if (t === DRAIN) {
    75	      g[i] = EMPTY;
    76	      if (m === GOLD) s.lost++;
    77	      ev(s, 5, j % W, (j / W) | 0);
    78	    } else if (t === CUP) {
    79	      g[i] = EMPTY;
    80	      if (m === GOLD) { s.collected++; ev(s, 1, j % W, (j / W) | 0); }
    81	      else if (m === LAVA || m === MONSTER) { s.dead = 1; ev(s, 4, j % W, (j / W) | 0); }
    82	    } else if (t === EMPTY) {
    83	      g[j] = m; g[i] = EMPTY;
    84	    } else {
    85	      g[j] = m; g[i] = t; // swap with lighter fluid
    86	      s.moved[i] = 1;
    87	    }
    88	    s.moved[j] = 1;
    89	    return 1;
    90	  }
    91	
    92	  function step(s) {
    93	    var g = s.grid, mv = s.moved, i, x, y, c, changed = 0;
    94	    mv.fill(0);
    95	    var d0 = (s.tick & 1) ? 1 : -1;
    96	
    97	    // ---- reactions ----
    98	    for (y = 1; y < H - 1; y++) {
    99	      for (x = 1; x < W - 1; x++) {
   100	        i = y * W + x; c = g[i];
   101	        if (c === LAVA) {
   102	          var ns0 = i - W, ns1 = i + W, ns2 = i - 1, ns3 = i + 1, k, n, t;
   103	          for (k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   104	            n = k === 0 ? ns0 : k === 1 ? ns1 : k === 2 ? ns2 : ns3;
   105	            t = g[n];
   106	            if (t === WATER) {
   107	              g[i] = STONE; g[n] = EMPTY; changed = 1;
   108	              ev(s, 2, x, y);
   109	              break;
   110	            } else if (t === GAS) {
   111	              g[n] = LAVA; changed = 1; ev(s, 3, n % W, (n / W) | 0);
   112	            } else if (t === GOLD) {
   113	              g[n] = EMPTY; s.lost++; changed = 1; ev(s, 6, n % W, (n / W) | 0);
   114	            } else if (t === MONSTER) {
   115	              g[n] = EMPTY; s.monsters--; changed = 1; ev(s, 7, n % W, (n / W) | 0);
   116	            } else if (t === HERO) {
   117	              s.dead = 1;
   118	            }
   119	          }
   120	        } else if (c === MONSTER) {
   121	          if (g[i - 1] === HERO || g[i + 1] === HERO || g[i - W] === HERO || g[i + W] === HERO) s.dead = 1;
   122	        }
   123	      }
   124	    }
   125	
   126	    // ---- movement (bottom-up) ----
   127	    for (y = H - 2; y >= 1; y--) {
   128	      for (var q = 0; q < W - 2; q++) {
   129	        x = d0 > 0 ? 1 + q : (W - 2 - q);
   130	        i = y * W + x;
   131	        if (mv[i]) continue;
   132	        c = g[i];
   133	        var dn = canEnter(c, g[i + W]), up = canEnter(c, g[i - W]);
   134	        if (c === GOLD || c === MONSTER) {
   135	          if (c === MONSTER && g[i + W] === LAVA) { g[i] = EMPTY; s.monsters--; changed = 1; ev(s, 7, x, y); continue; }
   136	          if (dn) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + W, c); continue; }
   137	          if (c === GOLD) {
   138	            if (diagOK(c, g, i, d0, dn) && canEnter(c, g[i + W + d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + W + d0, c); continue; }
   139	            if (diagOK(c, g, i, -d0, dn) && canEnter(c, g[i + W - d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + W - d0, c); continue; }
   140	          }
   141	        } else if (c === LAVA || c === WATER) {
   142	          if (dn) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + W, c); continue; }
   143	          if (diagOK(c, g, i, d0, dn) && canEnter(c, g[i + W + d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + W + d0, c); continue; }
   144	          if (diagOK(c, g, i, -d0, dn) && canEnter(c, g[i + W - d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + W - d0, c); continue; }
   145	          if (canEnter(c, g[i + d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + d0, c); continue; }
   146	          if (c === WATER && canEnter(c, g[i - d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i - d0, c); continue; }
   147	        } else if (c === GAS) {
   148	          if (up) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i - W, c); continue; }
   149	          if (diagOK(c, g, i, d0, up) && canEnter(c, g[i - W + d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i - W + d0, c); continue; }
   150	          if (diagOK(c, g, i, -d0, up) && canEnter(c, g[i - W - d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i - W - d0, c); continue; }
   151	          if (canEnter(c, g[i + d0])) { changed |= moveTo(s, i, i + d0, c); continue; }
   152	        }
   153	      }
   154	    }
   155	    s.tick++;
   156	    return changed;
   157	  }
   158	
   159	  function hash(g) {
   160	    var h = 2166136261, i;
   161	    for (i = 0; i < N; i++) { h ^= g[i]; h = (h * 16777619) >>> 0; }
   162	    return h;
   163	  }
   164	
   165	  // run until settled / cycling / budget. returns ticks used
   166	  function settle(s, budget) {
   167	    var t = 0;
   168	    while (t < budget) {
   169	      var ch = step(s); t++;
   170	      if (s.dead) break;
   171	      if (!ch) break;
   172	      var h = hash(s.grid), j, rep = 0;
   173	      for (j = 0; j < 8; j++) if (s.hist[j] === h) { rep = 1; break; }
   174	      s.hist[s.hi] = h; s.hi = (s.hi + 1) & 7;
   175	      if (rep) break;
   176	    }
   177	    return t;
   178	  }

   189	var MAXP = 260, MAXF = 36;
   190	var FX = {
   191	  parts: [], floats: [], shake: 0, flash: 0, flashCol: '#fff',
   192	  burst: function (x, y, col, n, spd) {
   193	    n = Math.min(n, 26);
   194	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   195	      if (this.parts.length >= MAXP) this.parts.shift();
   196	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = rnd(0.4, 1) * (spd || 150);
   197	      this.parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: rnd(0.3, 0.7), t: 0, col: col, r: rnd(2, 4.5) });
   198	    }
   199	  },
   200	  float: function (x, y, text, col, size) {
   201	    if (this.floats.length >= MAXF) this.floats.shift();
   202	    this.floats.push({ x: x, y: y, text: text, col: col || '#fff', t: 0, life: 1.1, size: size || 15 });
   203	  },
   204	  hit: function (mag) { this.shake = Math.min(14, this.shake + mag); },
   205	  bang: function (col, amt) { this.flash = Math.min(1, this.flash + (amt || 0.5)); this.flashCol = col || '#fff'; },
   206	  clear: function () { this.parts.length = 0; this.floats.length = 0; this.shake = 0; this.flash = 0; },
   207	  update: function (dt) {
   208	    var i, p;
   209	    for (i = this.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   210	      p = this.parts[i]; p.t += dt;
   211	      if (p.t >= p.life) { this.parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   212	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 320 * dt; p.vx *= 0.98;
   213	    }
   214	    for (i = this.floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   215	      p = this.floats[i]; p.t += dt;
   216	      if (p.t >= p.life) { this.floats.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   217	      p.y -= 26 * dt;
   218	    }
   219	    this.shake *= Math.pow(0.0016, dt);
   220	    if (this.shake < 0.05) this.shake = 0;
   221	    this.flash -= dt * 2.6; if (this.flash < 0) this.flash = 0;
   222	  },
   223	  draw: function (ctx) {
   224	    var i, p;
   225	    for (i = 0; i < this.parts.length; i++) {
   226	      p = this.parts[i];
   227	      var a = 1 - p.t / p.life;
   228	      ctx.globalAlpha = a;
   229	      ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
   230	      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.r / 2, p.y - p.r / 2, p.r, p.r);
   231	    }
   232	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   233	    for (i = 0; i < this.floats.length; i++) {
   234	      p = this.floats[i];
   235	      var k = p.t / p.life;
   236	      ctx.globalAlpha = k < 0.75 ? 1 : (1 - k) / 0.25;
   237	      ctx.font = '700 ' + p.size + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   238	      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   239	      ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)';
   240	      ctx.strokeText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
### core 240-520
   240	      ctx.strokeText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
   241	      ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
   242	      ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
   243	    }
   244	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   245	  }
   246	};
   247	
   248	/* ---------- dt-driven timer scheduler (no setTimeout in sim; clearable) ---------- */
   249	var Timers = {
   250	  list: [],
   251	  after: function (t, fn) {
   252	    if (this.list.length > 64) this.list.length = 0;
   253	    this.list.push({ t: t, fn: fn });
   254	  },
   255	  clear: function () { this.list.length = 0; },
   256	  update: function (dt) {
   257	    for (var i = this.list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   258	      var e = this.list[i];
   259	      e.t -= dt;
   260	      if (e.t <= 0) { this.list.splice(i, 1); e.fn(); }
   261	    }
   262	  }
   263	};
   264	
   265	/* ---------- drawing helpers ---------- */
   266	function rrect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
   267	  r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   268	  ctx.beginPath();
   269	  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   270	  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   271	  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   272	  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   273	  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   274	  ctx.closePath();
   275	}
   276	function txt(ctx, s, x, y, size, col, align, weight) {
   277	  ctx.font = (weight || 600) + ' ' + size + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   278	  ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.textAlign = align || 'left'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   279	  ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
   280	}
   281	function bar(ctx, x, y, w, h, pct, col, bg) {
   282	  ctx.fillStyle = bg || '#161c2b'; rrect(ctx, x, y, w, h, h / 2); ctx.fill();
   283	  var p = clamp(pct, 0, 1);
   284	  if (p > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = col; rrect(ctx, x, y, Math.max(h, w * p), h, h / 2); ctx.fill(); }
   285	}

    64	function newPlan(foe) {
    65	  var alive = [];

    67	  var t = alive.length ? pick(alive) : 0;

    71	function startRound(r) {
    72	  Timers.clear();
    73	  FX.clear();
    74	  Input.reset();
    75	  Board.init();
    76	  G.round = r;
    77	  G.turn = 1;
    78	  G.sub = 'trace';
    79	  G.overlay = null;
    80	  G.target = 0;
    81	  G.pendingRuns = []; G.attackQueue = []; G.clash = null; G.strike = null;
    82	  G.team = [];
    83	  for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) G.team.push(makeFighter(G.teamIds[i]));
    84	  G.foes = [];
    85	  var L = LADDER[r - 1];
    86	  for (var j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
    87	    var hp = Math.round(foeHP(r) * [0.9, 1.0, 1.15][j]);
    88	    var foe = {
    89	      name: L.foes[j][0], type: L.foes[j][1], maxhp: hp, hp: hp,
    90	      atk: foeATK(r) * [0.95, 1.0, 1.1][j], speed: foeSpeed(r),
    91	      cd: 2 + (j % 2), plan: null, flash: 0
    92	    };
    93	    newPlan(foe);
    94	    G.foes.push(foe);
    95	  }
    96	  G.status = 'ROUND ' + r + ' / 8 - ' + L.name;
    97	  persist();
    98	}

   108	/* ---------------- trace -> chains ---------------- */
   109	function commitTrace() {
   110	  if (G.sub !== 'trace') return;
   111	  var runs = Board.runs();
   112	  if (!runs.length) {
   113	    if (Board.path.length > 1) { FX.float(VW / 2, BY - 14, 'NO CHAIN (need 3+ same)', '#ff8b96', 14); Snd.miss(); }
   114	    Board.clearTrace();
   115	    return;
   116	  }
   117	  G.pendingRuns = runs;
   118	  G.runIdx = 0;
   119	  G.turnDmg = 0;
   120	  G.sub = 'resolve';
   121	  Board.tracing = false;
   122	  Timers.after(0.05, stepRun);
   123	}
   124	
   125	function stepRun() {
   126	  if (G.runIdx >= G.pendingRuns.length) {
   127	    Board.collapse();
   128	    Board.clearTrace();
   129	    Timers.after(0.4, checkAttacks);
   130	    return;
   131	  }
   132	  var run = G.pendingRuns[G.runIdx];
   133	  var combo = 1 + M.comboStep * G.runIdx;
   134	  var L = run.cells.length;
   135	  var amt = Math.round((L * M.chargePerOrb + Math.max(0, L - M.minRun) * M.chargeBonusPerExtra) * combo);
   136	  var mid = run.cells[(L / 2) | 0];
   137	  var mx = Board.cx(mid.c), my = Board.cy(mid.r);
   138	  var col = ORBS[run.t].col;
   139	  Snd.chain(G.runIdx);
   140	  FX.burst(mx, my, col, 8 + L * 2, 150);
   141	
   142	  if (run.t === 3) {
   143	    var heal = Math.round(L * M.healPerOrb * combo);
   144	    for (var i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) {
   145	      var f = G.team[i];
   146	      if (f.hp <= 0) continue;
   147	      f.hp = Math.min(f.maxhp, f.hp + heal);
   148	      FX.float(cardX(i) + LY.cardW / 2, LY.ownY + 30, '+' + heal, HEART.col, 16);
   149	      if (f.id === 5) { f.charge = Math.min(overcapFor(f), f.charge + heal); } // TALO WREN
   150	    }
   151	    FX.float(mx, my - 22, 'x' + L + ' HEART  x' + combo.toFixed(2), HEART.col, 14);
   152	  } else {
   153	    var any = false;
   154	    for (var k = 0; k < G.team.length; k++) {
   155	      var g = G.team[k];
   156	      if (g.hp <= 0) continue;
   157	      var gain = 0;
   158	      if (g.type === run.t) gain = amt;
   159	      else if (g.id === 7 && L >= 4) gain = Math.round(amt * 0.4); // KAIDE RHO
   160	      if (gain > 0) {
   161	        g.charge = Math.min(overcapFor(g), g.charge + gain);
   162	        g.flash = 0.4;
   163	        FX.float(cardX(k) + LY.cardW / 2, LY.ownY + 84, '+' + gain, col, 15);
   164	        any = true;
   165	      }
   166	    }
   167	    FX.float(mx, my - 22, 'x' + L + ' ' + KI[run.t].short + (any ? '' : ' (no user)') + '  x' + combo.toFixed(2), col, 14);
   168	  }
   169	  Board.markDead(run.cells);
   170	  G.runIdx++;
   171	  Timers.after(0.3, stepRun);
   172	}

   175	function aliveFoes() { var a = []; for (var i = 0; i < G.foes.length; i++) if (G.foes[i].hp > 0) a.push(i); return a; }
   176	function aliveTeam() { var a = []; for (var i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) if (G.team[i].hp > 0) a.push(i); return a; }

   178	function checkAttacks() {
   179	  G.attackQueue = [];
   180	  for (var i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) {
   181	    var f = G.team[i];
   182	    if (f.hp > 0 && f.charge >= M.fullCharge) G.attackQueue.push(i);
   183	  }
   184	  if (!G.attackQueue.length) { enemyPhase(); return; }
   185	  nextAttack();
   186	}
   187	
   188	function nextAttack() {
   189	  if (!aliveFoes().length) { roundWon(); return; }
   190	  if (!G.attackQueue.length) { enemyPhase(); return; }
   191	  var idx = G.attackQueue.shift();
   192	  var f = G.team[idx];
   193	  if (!f || f.hp <= 0 || f.charge < M.fullCharge) { nextAttack(); return; }
   194	  if (aliveFoes().indexOf(G.target) < 0) G.target = aliveFoes()[0];
   195	  G.sub = 'clash';
   196	  G.clash = { t: 0, fi: idx, taken: false, perfW: f.id === 2 ? 0.15 : 0.09 };
   197	  Snd.blip(660, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.2);
   198	}

   200	function clashTap() {
   201	  if (G.sub !== 'clash' || !G.clash || G.clash.taken) return;
   202	  var c = G.clash;
   203	  c.taken = true;
   204	  var p = c.t / M.clashWindow;
   205	  var center = 0.66, d = Math.abs(p - center);
   206	  var mult, label, col;
   207	  if (d <= c.perfW) { mult = M.clashPerfect; label = 'PERFECT CLASH'; col = '#ffd166'; Snd.perfect(); }
   208	  else if (d <= c.perfW + 0.16) { mult = M.clashGood; label = 'GOOD CLASH'; col = '#54d98c'; Snd.blip(520, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.25); }
   209	  else { mult = 1.0; label = 'CLASH'; col = '#9fb4d4'; Snd.blip(300, 0.09, 'square', 0.2); }
   210	  doStrike(mult, label, col);
   211	}
   212	
   213	function clashTimeout() {
   214	  if (G.sub !== 'clash' || !G.clash || G.clash.taken) return;
   215	  G.clash.taken = true;
   216	  Snd.miss();
   217	  doStrike(M.clashLate, 'NO CLASH', '#ff8b96');
   218	}

   220	function doStrike(mult, label, col) {
   221	  var f = G.team[G.clash.fi];
   222	  var av = aliveFoes();
   223	  if (!av.length) { roundWon(); return; }
   224	  if (av.indexOf(G.target) < 0) G.target = av[0];
   225	  var foe = G.foes[G.target];
   226	  var chargeM = Math.min(f.charge, overcapFor(f)) / M.fullCharge;
   227	  var typeM = kiMult(f.type, foe.type);
   228	  if (f.id === 8 && typeM < 1) typeM = 1; // MIRA DELUNE
   229	  var base = f.atk * chargeM;
   230	  var dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * typeM * mult));
   231	  foe.hp -= dmg;
   232	  foe.flash = 0.5;
   233	  f.charge = 0;
   234	  G.sub = 'strike';
   235	  G.clash = null;
   236	
   237	  var fx = cardX(G.target) + LY.cardW / 2, fy = LY.foeY + 46;
   238	  FX.hit(7 + Math.min(6, dmg / 40));
   239	  FX.bang(col, 0.35);
   240	  FX.burst(fx, fy, col, 16, 200);
   241	  Snd.hit();
   242	  FX.float(fx, fy - 6, '-' + dmg, '#ffffff', 26);
   243	  FX.float(fx, fy + 16, label, col, 13);
   244	  FX.float(VW / 2, BY - 26,
   245	    f.atk + ' ATK x' + chargeM.toFixed(2) + ' CHG x' + typeM.toFixed(2) + ' ' + kiLabel(f.type, foe.type) + ' x' + mult.toFixed(2) + ' = ' + dmg,
   246	    '#c9d8f0', 13);
   247	  G.turnDmg += dmg;
   248	
   249	  if (foe.hp <= 0) {
   250	    foe.hp = 0;
   251	    Snd.ko();
   252	    FX.burst(fx, fy, '#ffffff', 22, 260);
   253	    FX.float(fx, fy - 30, 'DOWN', '#ffd166', 18);
   254	    FX.hit(10);
   255	    var nx = aliveFoes();
   256	    if (!nx.length) { Timers.after(0.7, roundWon); return; }
   257	    G.target = nx[0];
   258	  }
   259	  Timers.after(0.62, function () { G.sub = 'resolve'; nextAttack(); });
   260	}

   262	/* ---------------- enemy phase ---------------- */
   263	function enemyPhase() {
   264	  G.sub = 'enemy';
   265	  var order = [];
   266	  for (var i = 0; i < G.foes.length; i++) {
   267	    var f = G.foes[i];
   268	    if (f.hp <= 0) continue;
   269	    f.cd--;
   270	    if (f.cd <= 0) order.push(i);
   271	  }
   272	  runEnemy(order, 0);
   273	}
   274	
   275	function runEnemy(order, k) {
   276	  if (k >= order.length) {
   277	    if (!aliveTeam().length) { roundLost(); return; }
   278	    G.turn++;
   279	    G.sub = 'trace';
   280	    Board.clearTrace();
   281	    return;
   282	  }
   283	  var foe = G.foes[order[k]];
   284	  if (foe.hp <= 0) { runEnemy(order, k + 1); return; }
   285	  var av = aliveTeam();
   286	  if (!av.length) { roundLost(); return; }
   287	  var ti = av.indexOf(foe.plan.target) >= 0 ? foe.plan.target : av[0];
   288	  var tgt = G.team[ti];
   289	  var typeM = kiMult(foe.type, tgt.type);
   290	  var dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(foe.plan.dmg * typeM));
   291	  tgt.hp = Math.max(0, tgt.hp - dmg);
   292	  tgt.hitT = 0.4;
   293	  var tx = cardX(ti) + LY.cardW / 2, ty = LY.ownY + 44;
   294	  FX.hit(6);
   295	  FX.bang('#ff5c6e', 0.28);
   296	  FX.burst(tx, ty, KI[foe.type].col, 14, 170);
   297	  Snd.hit();
   298	  FX.float(tx, ty, '-' + dmg, '#ff8b96', 22);
   299	  FX.float(VW / 2, BY - 26, foe.name + ': ' + foe.plan.dmg + ' x' + typeM.toFixed(2) + ' ' + kiLabel(foe.type, tgt.type) + ' = ' + dmg, '#ffb0b8', 13);
   300	  if (tgt.hp <= 0) { FX.float(tx, ty - 26, 'KO', '#ff5c6e', 18); Snd.ko(); }
   301	  foe.cd = foe.speed;
   302	  newPlan(foe);
   303	  Timers.after(0.6, function () { runEnemy(order, k + 1); });
   304	}

   306	/* ---------------- round end ---------------- */
   307	function roundWon() {
   308	  G.sub = 'over';
   309	  Board.clearTrace();
   310	  Timers.clear();
   311	  Snd.win();
   312	  FX.bang('#ffd166', 0.6);
   313	  var unlockedNames = [];
   314	  if (G.round === 2 || G.round === 4 || G.round === 6) {
   315	    var tier = G.round / 2;
   316	    for (var i = 0; i < FIGHTERS.length; i++) {
   317	      if (FIGHTERS[i].tier === tier && G.unlocked.indexOf(i) < 0) { G.unlocked.push(i); unlockedNames.push(FIGHTERS[i].name); }
   318	    }
   319	  }
   320	  G.newUnlocks = unlockedNames;
   321	  G.overlay = (G.round >= 8) ? 'crown' : 'win';
   322	  if (G.round >= 8) { save.wins = (save.wins | 0) + 1; }
   323	  save.unlocked = G.unlocked.slice(0);
   324	  save.team = G.teamIds.slice(0);
   325	  save.round = G.round >= 8 ? 1 : G.round + 1;
   326	  save.best = Math.max(save.best | 0, G.round);
   327	  Store.write(save);
   328	}
   329	function roundLost() {
   330	  G.sub = 'over';
   331	  Board.clearTrace();
   332	  Timers.clear();
   333	  Snd.ko();
   334	  FX.bang('#ff5c6e', 0.6);
   335	  G.overlay = 'lose';
   336	}

   338	/* ---------------- update ---------------- */
   339	function update(dt) {
   340	  FX.update(dt);
   341	  Board.update(dt);
   342	  if (G.overlay) return;
   343	  Timers.update(dt);
   344	
   345	  var i;
   346	  for (i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) {
   347	    var f = G.team[i];
   348	    if (f.flash > 0) f.flash -= dt;
   349	    if (f.hitT > 0) f.hitT -= dt;
   350	  }
   351	  for (i = 0; i < G.foes.length; i++) if (G.foes[i].flash > 0) G.foes[i].flash -= dt;
   352	
   353	  if (G.sub === 'trace' && Board.tracing) {
   354	    Board.traceT -= dt;
   355	    if (Board.traceT <= 0) { Board.traceT = 0; commitTrace(); }
   356	  }
   357	  if (G.sub === 'clash' && G.clash && !G.clash.taken) {
   358	    G.clash.t += dt;
   359	    if (G.clash.t >= M.clashWindow) clashTimeout();
   360	  }
   361	}

   371	function drawFoe(i) {
   372	  var f = G.foes[i], x = cardX(i), y = LY.foeY, w = LY.cardW, h = LY.foeH;
   373	  var dead = f.hp <= 0;
   374	  ctx.globalAlpha = dead ? 0.32 : 1;
   375	  ctx.fillStyle = f.flash > 0 ? '#3a2430' : '#141a27';
   376	  rrect(ctx, x, y, w, h, 10); ctx.fill();
   377	  ctx.strokeStyle = (G.target === i && !dead) ? '#ffffff' : KI[f.type].dim;
   378	  ctx.lineWidth = (G.target === i && !dead) ? 2.5 : 1.5;
   379	  rrect(ctx, x, y, w, h, 10); ctx.stroke();
   380	
   381	  // greybox portrait

   108	/* ---------------- trace -> chains ---------------- */
   109	function commitTrace() {
   110	  if (G.sub !== 'trace') return;
   111	  var runs = Board.runs();
   112	  if (!runs.length) {
   113	    if (Board.path.length > 1) { FX.float(VW / 2, BY - 14, 'NO CHAIN (need 3+ same)', '#ff8b96', 14); Snd.miss(); }
   114	    Board.clearTrace();
   115	    return;
   116	  }
   117	  G.pendingRuns = runs;
   118	  G.runIdx = 0;
   119	  G.turnDmg = 0;
   120	  G.sub = 'resolve';
   121	  Board.tracing = false;
   122	  Timers.after(0.05, stepRun);
   123	}
   124	
   125	function stepRun() {
   126	  if (G.runIdx >= G.pendingRuns.length) {
   127	    Board.collapse();
   128	    Board.clearTrace();
   129	    Timers.after(0.4, checkAttacks);
   130	    return;
   131	  }
   132	  var run = G.pendingRuns[G.runIdx];
   133	  var combo = 1 + M.comboStep * G.runIdx;
   134	  var L = run.cells.length;
   135	  var amt = Math.round((L * M.chargePerOrb + Math.max(0, L - M.minRun) * M.chargeBonusPerExtra) * combo);
   136	  var mid = run.cells[(L / 2) | 0];
   137	  var mx = Board.cx(mid.c), my = Board.cy(mid.r);
   138	  var col = ORBS[run.t].col;
   139	  Snd.chain(G.runIdx);
   140	  FX.burst(mx, my, col, 8 + L * 2, 150);
   141	
   142	  if (run.t === 3) {
   143	    var heal = Math.round(L * M.healPerOrb * combo);
   144	    for (var i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) {
   145	      var f = G.team[i];
   146	      if (f.hp <= 0) continue;
   147	      f.hp = Math.min(f.maxhp, f.hp + heal);
   148	      FX.float(cardX(i) + LY.cardW / 2, LY.ownY + 30, '+' + heal, HEART.col, 16);
   149	      if (f.id === 5) { f.charge = Math.min(overcapFor(f), f.charge + heal); } // TALO WREN
   150	    }
   151	    FX.float(mx, my - 22, 'x' + L + ' HEART  x' + combo.toFixed(2), HEART.col, 14);
   152	  } else {
   153	    var any = false;
   154	    for (var k = 0; k < G.team.length; k++) {
   155	      var g = G.team[k];
   156	      if (g.hp <= 0) continue;
   157	      var gain = 0;
   158	      if (g.type === run.t) gain = amt;
   159	      else if (g.id === 7 && L >= 4) gain = Math.round(amt * 0.4); // KAIDE RHO
   160	      if (gain > 0) {
   161	        g.charge = Math.min(overcapFor(g), g.charge + gain);
   162	        g.flash = 0.4;
   163	        FX.float(cardX(k) + LY.cardW / 2, LY.ownY + 84, '+' + gain, col, 15);
   164	        any = true;
   165	      }
   166	    }
   167	    FX.float(mx, my - 22, 'x' + L + ' ' + KI[run.t].short + (any ? '' : ' (no user)') + '  x' + combo.toFixed(2), col, 14);
   168	  }
   169	  Board.markDead(run.cells);
   170	  G.runIdx++;
   171	  Timers.after(0.3, stepRun);
   172	}

   175	function aliveFoes() { var a = []; for (var i = 0; i < G.foes.length; i++) if (G.foes[i].hp > 0) a.push(i); return a; }
   176	function aliveTeam() { var a = []; for (var i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) if (G.team[i].hp > 0) a.push(i); return a; }
   177	
   178	function checkAttacks() {
   179	  G.attackQueue = [];
   180	  for (var i = 0; i < G.team.length; i++) {
   181	    var f = G.team[i];
   182	    if (f.hp > 0 && f.charge >= M.fullCharge) G.attackQueue.push(i);
   183	  }
   184	  if (!G.attackQueue.length) { enemyPhase(); return; }
   185	  nextAttack();
   186	}
   187	
   188	function nextAttack() {
   189	  if (!aliveFoes().length) { roundWon(); return; }
   190	  if (!G.attackQueue.length) { enemyPhase(); return; }
   191	  var idx = G.attackQueue.shift();
   192	  var f = G.team[idx];
   193	  if (!f || f.hp <= 0 || f.charge < M.fullCharge) { nextAttack(); return; }
   194	  if (aliveFoes().indexOf(G.target) < 0) G.target = aliveFoes()[0];
   195	  G.sub = 'clash';
   196	  G.clash = { t: 0, fi: idx, taken: false, perfW: f.id === 2 ? 0.15 : 0.09 };
   197	  Snd.blip(660, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.2);
   198	}
   199	
   200	function clashTap() {
   201	  if (G.sub !== 'clash' || !G.clash || G.clash.taken) return;
   202	  var c = G.clash;
   203	  c.taken = true;
   204	  var p = c.t / M.clashWindow;
   205	  var center = 0.66, d = Math.abs(p - center);
   206	  var mult, label, col;
   207	  if (d <= c.perfW) { mult = M.clashPerfect; label = 'PERFECT CLASH'; col = '#ffd166'; Snd.perfect(); }
   208	  else if (d <= c.perfW + 0.16) { mult = M.clashGood; label = 'GOOD CLASH'; col = '#54d98c'; Snd.blip(520, 0.1, 'triangle', 0.25); }
   209	  else { mult = 1.0; label = 'CLASH'; col = '#9fb4d4'; Snd.blip(300, 0.09, 'square', 0.2); }
   210	  doStrike(mult, label, col);
   211	}

   213	function clashTimeout() {
   214	  if (G.sub !== 'clash' || !G.clash || G.clash.taken) return;
   215	  G.clash.taken = true;
   216	  Snd.miss();
   217	  doStrike(M.clashLate, 'NO CLASH', '#ff8b96');

   711	function doBtn(id) {
   712	  if (!id) return false;
   713	  Snd.ui();
   714	  if (id === 'math') { G.overlay = 'math'; Board.clearTrace(); return true; }
   715	  if (id === 'close') { G.overlay = null; return true; }
   716	  if (id === 'team') {
   717	    // from a cleared-round screen, advance first so CONFIRM restarts the right round
   718	    if (G.overlay === 'win') { Timers.clear(); Input.reset(); startRound(Math.min(8, G.round + 1)); }
   719	    else if (G.overlay === 'crown') { save.round = 1; Store.write(save); Timers.clear(); Input.reset(); startRound(1); }
   720	    openRoster();
   721	    return true;
   722	  }
   723	  if (id === 'retry') { Timers.clear(); Input.reset(); startRound(G.round); return true; }
   724	  if (id === 'next') { Timers.clear(); Input.reset(); startRound(Math.min(8, G.round + 1)); return true; }
   725	  if (id === 'newrun') { save.round = 1; Store.write(save); Timers.clear(); Input.reset(); startRound(1); return true; }
   726	  if (id === 'confirmteam') {
   727	    if (G.rosterSel.length !== 3) return true;
   728	    G.teamIds = G.rosterSel.slice(0);
   729	    persist();
   730	    Timers.clear(); Input.reset();
   731	    startRound(G.round);
   732	    return true;
   733	  }
   734	  if (id.indexOf('pick') === 0) {
   735	    var fid = parseInt(id.slice(4), 10);
   736	    var at = G.rosterSel.indexOf(fid);
   737	    if (at >= 0) G.rosterSel.splice(at, 1);
   738	    else if (G.rosterSel.length < 3) G.rosterSel.push(fid);
   739	    else { G.rosterSel.shift(); G.rosterSel.push(fid); }
   740	    return true;
   741	  }
   742	  return false;
   743	}

   762	Input.onMove = function (x, y, id) {
   763	  if (!started || paused || G.overlay) return;
   764	  if (G.sub !== 'trace' || !Board.tracing || Board.traceId !== id) return;
   765	  var c = Board.cellAt(x, y);
   766	  if (!c) return;
   767	  // require pointer near the cell centre for deliberate links
   768	  var dx = x - Board.cx(c.c), dy = y - (Board.cy(c.r) - Board.g[c.r][c.c].oy);
   769	  if (dx * dx + dy * dy > (CELL * 0.46) * (CELL * 0.46)) return;
   770	  if (Board.extend(c.c, c.r)) { Board.cursor.c = c.c; Board.cursor.r = c.r; }
   771	};
   772	Input.onUp = function (x, y, id) {

   775	};

   796	      else if (G.overlay === 'lose') doBtn('retry');

   801	  }

   804	  if (k === 'r') { doBtn('retry'); return; }

   811	  if (G.sub !== 'trace') return;
   812	  var d = null;

   814	  else if (k === 'ArrowRight') d = [1, 0];
   815	  else if (k === 'ArrowUp') d = [0, -1];
   816	  else if (k === 'ArrowDown') d = [0, 1];

   825	    else commitTrace();

   831	function resize() {
   832	  var w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
   833	  var landscape = w > h * 1.05;
   834	  if (landscape) {
   835	    rotEl.classList.add('on');
   836	    paused = true;
   837	  } else {
   838	    rotEl.classList.remove('on');
   839	    if (paused) { paused = false; last = 0; Input.reset(); }
   840	  }
   841	  var scale = Math.min(w / VW, h / VH);
   842	  var cssW = Math.max(80, Math.floor(VW * scale)), cssH = Math.max(140, Math.floor(VH * scale));
   843	  var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   844	  dpr = Math.min(dpr, 960 / cssH);   // cap backing store long axis ~960
   845	  cv.style.width = cssW + 'px';
   846	  cv.style.height = cssH + 'px';
   847	  cv.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
   848	  cv.height = Math.round(cssH * dpr);
   849	  ctx.setTransform(cv.width / VW, 0, 0, cv.height / VH, 0, 0);
   850	  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   851	}

   856	var last = 0;
   857	function frame(ts) {
   858	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   859	  if (!last) { last = ts; return; }
   860	  var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;

     1	/* Kinetic Burst - orb board, trace path, chain resolution */
     2	'use strict';
     3	
     4	var COLS = 6, ROWS = 5, CELL = 56, BX = 27, BY = 334;
     5	
     6	var Board = {
     7	  g: [],            // g[r][c] = {t, oy, pop, dead}
     8	  path: [],         // [{c,r}]
     9	  tracing: false,
    10	  traceT: 0,
    11	  traceId: null,
    12	  cursor: { c: 2, r: 2 },
    13	  kbTrace: false,
    14	
    15	  init: function () {
    16	    this.g = [];
    17	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    18	      var row = [];
    19	      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) row.push(this.newOrb(0));
    20	      this.g.push(row);
    21	    }
    22	    this.clearTrace();
    23	    this.cursor.c = 2; this.cursor.r = 2;
    24	  },
    25	  newOrb: function (oy) {
    26	    // 4 orb types; hearts slightly rarer (rates shown in MATH panel)
    27	    var t, roll = Math.random();
    28	    if (roll < 0.19) t = 3; else t = (Math.random() * 3) | 0;
    29	    return { t: t, oy: oy || 0, pop: 0, dead: false };
    30	  },
    31	  clearTrace: function () {
    32	    this.path.length = 0;
    33	    this.tracing = false;
    34	    this.traceT = 0;
    35	    this.traceId = null;
    36	    this.kbTrace = false;
    37	  },
    38	  cx: function (c) { return BX + c * CELL + CELL / 2; },
    39	  cy: function (r) { return BY + r * CELL + CELL / 2; },
    40	  cellAt: function (px, py) {
    41	    var c = Math.floor((px - BX) / CELL), r = Math.floor((py - BY) / CELL);
    42	    if (c < 0 || c >= COLS || r < 0 || r >= ROWS) return null;
    43	    return { c: c, r: r };
    44	  },
    45	  inPath: function (c, r) {
    46	    for (var i = 0; i < this.path.length; i++) if (this.path[i].c === c && this.path[i].r === r) return i;
    47	    return -1;
    48	  },
    49	  start: function (c, r, id) {
    50	    this.path.length = 0;
    51	    this.path.push({ c: c, r: r });
    52	    this.tracing = true;
    53	    this.traceT = M.traceTime;
    54	    this.traceId = id;
    55	    Snd.link(0);
    56	  },
    57	  extend: function (c, r) {
    58	    if (!this.tracing || !this.path.length) return false;
    59	    var last = this.path[this.path.length - 1];
    60	    if (last.c === c && last.r === r) return false;
    61	    // backtrack support
    62	    if (this.path.length >= 2) {
    63	      var prev = this.path[this.path.length - 2];
    64	      if (prev.c === c && prev.r === r) { this.path.pop(); Snd.link(0); return true; }
    65	    }
    66	    if (this.inPath(c, r) >= 0) return false;
    67	    if (this.path.length >= M.maxPath) return false;
    68	    var dc = c - last.c, dr = r - last.r;
    69	    if (Math.abs(dc) > 1 || Math.abs(dr) > 1) {
    70	      // fast drag skipped cells: walk the gap so the chain still links
    71	      var cc = last.c, rr = last.r, added = false, guard = 0;
    72	      while ((cc !== c || rr !== r) && guard++ < COLS + ROWS) {
    73	        cc += Math.sign(c - cc);
    74	        rr += Math.sign(r - rr);
    75	        if (this.inPath(cc, rr) >= 0) return added;
    76	        if (this.path.length >= M.maxPath) return added;
    77	        this.path.push({ c: cc, r: rr });
    78	        Snd.link(this.path.length);
    79	        added = true;
    80	      }
    81	      return added;
    82	    }
    83	    this.path.push({ c: c, r: r });
    84	    Snd.link(this.path.length);
    85	    return true;
    86	  },
    87	  /* Split the traced path into scoring runs of same-type orbs (length >= minRun). */
    88	  runs: function () {
    89	    var out = [], cur = null, i, cell, t;
    90	    for (i = 0; i < this.path.length; i++) {
    91	      cell = this.path[i];
    92	      t = this.g[cell.r][cell.c].t;
    93	      if (cur && cur.t === t) cur.cells.push(cell);
    94	      else { if (cur && cur.cells.length >= M.minRun) out.push(cur); cur = { t: t, cells: [cell] }; }
    95	    }
    96	    if (cur && cur.cells.length >= M.minRun) out.push(cur);
    97	    return out;
    98	  },
    99	  /* live preview count of scoring orbs */
   100	  previewCount: function () {
   101	    var rs = this.runs(), n = 0;
   102	    for (var i = 0; i < rs.length; i++) n += rs[i].cells.length;
   103	    return { orbs: n, runs: rs.length };
   104	  },
   105	  markDead: function (cells) {
   106	    for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) {
   107	      var o = this.g[cells[i].r][cells[i].c];
   108	      if (o) { o.dead = true; o.pop = 1; }
   109	    }
   110	  },
   111	  collapse: function () {
   112	    for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   113	      var write = ROWS - 1;
   114	      for (var r = ROWS - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
   115	        var o = this.g[r][c];
   116	        if (!o.dead) {
   117	          if (write !== r) { o.oy = (write - r) * CELL; this.g[write][c] = o; }
   118	          write--;
   119	        }
   120	      }
   121	      for (var k = write; k >= 0; k--) {
   122	        this.g[k][c] = this.newOrb((k + 2) * CELL);
   123	      }
   124	    }
   125	  },
   126	  update: function (dt) {
   127	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   128	      var o = this.g[r][c];
   129	      if (o.oy > 0) { o.oy -= (600 + o.oy * 6) * dt; if (o.oy < 0) o.oy = 0; }
   130	      if (o.pop > 0) { o.pop -= dt * 5; if (o.pop < 0) o.pop = 0; }
   131	    }
   132	  },
   133	
   134	  /* ---- rendering ---- */
   135	  drawGlyph: function (ctx, t, x, y, rad) {
   136	    ctx.save();
   137	    ctx.translate(x, y);
   138	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b0d14';
   139	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0b0d14';
   140	    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   141	    ctx.beginPath();
   142	    if (t === 0) { // POWER - triangle
   143	      ctx.moveTo(0, -rad); ctx.lineTo(rad * 0.88, rad * 0.66); ctx.lineTo(-rad * 0.88, rad * 0.66); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   144	    } else if (t === 1) { // SPEED - chevron
   145	      ctx.moveTo(-rad * 0.85, -rad * 0.55); ctx.lineTo(0, rad * 0.15); ctx.lineTo(rad * 0.85, -rad * 0.55);
   146	      ctx.lineTo(rad * 0.85, rad * 0.05); ctx.lineTo(0, rad * 0.75); ctx.lineTo(-rad * 0.85, rad * 0.05);
   147	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   148	    } else if (t === 2) { // FOCUS - ring
   149	      ctx.lineWidth = rad * 0.42;
   150	      ctx.arc(0, 0, rad * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
   151	    } else { // HEART - diamond cross
   152	      ctx.moveTo(0, -rad * 0.95); ctx.lineTo(rad * 0.62, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, rad * 0.95); ctx.lineTo(-rad * 0.62, 0);
   153	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   154	    }
   155	    ctx.restore();
   156	  },
   157	  draw: function (ctx, active) {
   158	    var r, c, i;
   159	    // frame
   160	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1119';
   161	    rrect(ctx, BX - 6, BY - 6, COLS * CELL + 12, ROWS * CELL + 12, 12); ctx.fill();
   162	    ctx.strokeStyle = active ? '#26314a' : '#1a2130'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
   163	
   164	    ctx.save();
   165	    ctx.beginPath();
   166	    ctx.rect(BX - 6, BY - 6, COLS * CELL + 12, ROWS * CELL + 12);
   167	    ctx.clip();
   168	
   169	    // orbs
   170	    for (r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) for (c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   171	      var o = this.g[r][c];
   172	      var x = this.cx(c), y = this.cy(r) - o.oy;

    20	  ];
    21	  function gearCost(lvl) { return Math.round(25 * Math.pow(1.78, lvl)); }
    22	  var MAXLVL = 8;

    24	  var cv = d.getElementById('cv'), g = cv.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    25	  var bootEl = d.getElementById('boot'), rotEl = d.getElementById('rot');

    28	  var save = HF.loadSave();
    29	  var board = new HF.Board(COLS, ROWS, NCOL);
    30	  var battle = new HF.Battle();
    31	  var state = 'shop';         /* shop | fight | lost | won */
    32	  var started = false, paused = false, rotated = false;
    33	  var hintT = 0, shakeT = 0, resultT = 0, endBonus = 0;
    34	  var cursor = { r: ROWS - 1, c: 0, sel: null };
    35	  var shopSel = 0;
    36	  var wave = HF.genWave(save.fight, COLS);

    39	  /* ---------- input state (fully clearable) ---------- */
    40	  var IN = { ptr: {}, dragId: null, dragCell: null, dragX: 0, dragY: 0, keys: {}, btnDown: null };
    41	  function resetInput() {
    42	    IN.ptr = {}; IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null; IN.dragX = 0; IN.dragY = 0;
    43	    IN.keys = {}; IN.btnDown = null; IN.btnPtr = null; IN.keyMode = false;
    44	    cursor.sel = null;
    45	  }

    47	  /* ---------- layout ---------- */
    48	  function layout() {
    49	    var W = w.innerWidth, H = w.innerHeight;
    50	    var dpr = Math.min(2, w.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    51	    var longAxis = Math.max(W, H);
    52	    if (longAxis * dpr > 960) dpr = 960 / longAxis;
    53	    cv.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(W * dpr));
    54	    cv.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(H * dpr));
    55	    cv.style.width = W + 'px'; cv.style.height = H + 'px';
    56	    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    57	    L.W = W; L.H = H; L.dpr = dpr;
    58	    L.hud = 46; L.btop = L.hud;
    59	    var cell = Math.min((W - 14) / COLS, (H - L.hud - 26 - H * 0.34) / ROWS);
    60	    cell = Math.max(30, cell);
    61	    L.cell = cell;
    62	    L.bw = cell * COLS; L.bh = cell * ROWS;
    63	    L.bx = Math.round((W - L.bw) / 2);
    64	    L.by = Math.round(H - L.bh - 8);
    65	    L.wallY = L.by - 18;
    66	    rotated = W > H;
    67	    rotEl.classList.toggle('on', rotated && started);
    68	  }
