    70	  /* ---------- ui buttons ---------- */
    71	  var BTN = [];
    72	  function btn(id, x, y, bw, bh, label, kind) {
    73	    BTN.push({ id: id, x: x, y: y, w: bw, h: bh, label: label, kind: kind || 'main' });
    74	    return BTN[BTN.length - 1];
    75	  }
    76	  function hitBtn(x, y) {
    77	    for (var i = BTN.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    78	      var b = BTN[i];
    79	      if (x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h) return b;
    80	    }
    81	    return null;
    82	  }
    83	  function drawBtn(b, on) {
    84	    var bg = b.kind === 'go' ? '#ffd15c' : (b.kind === 'ghost' ? '#182231' : '#22314a');
    85	    var fg = b.kind === 'go' ? '#0b0f14' : '#dfe8f2';
    86	    if (b.dim) { bg = '#141c27'; fg = '#4d5c70'; }
    87	    g.fillStyle = on ? '#ffffff' : bg;
    88	    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 10); g.fill();
    89	    g.fillStyle = on ? '#0b0f14' : fg;
    90	    g.font = 'bold ' + (b.fs || 15) + 'px ui-monospace,monospace';
    91	    g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    92	    g.fillText(b.label, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2 + 1);
    93	  }
    94	  function roundRect(x, y, ww, hh, r) {
    95	    g.beginPath();
    96	    g.moveTo(x + r, y);
    97	    g.arcTo(x + ww, y, x + ww, y + hh, r);
    98	    g.arcTo(x + ww, y + hh, x, y + hh, r);
    99	    g.arcTo(x, y + hh, x, y, r);
   100	    g.arcTo(x, y, x + ww, y, r);
   101	    g.closePath();
   102	  }

   104	  /* ---------- flow ---------- */
   105	  function persist() {
   106	    save.best = Math.max(save.best, save.fight);
   107	    HF.writeSave(save);
   108	  }
   109	  function startFight() {
   110	    HF.clearTimers();
   111	    resetInput();
   112	    HF.fx.clear();
   113	    board.reset();
   114	    battle.reset(save.fight, save.gear, COLS);
   115	    wave = battle.wave;
   116	    state = 'fight'; hintT = 9; shakeT = 0;
   117	    cursor.r = ROWS - 1; cursor.c = 0; cursor.sel = null;
   118	  }
   119	  function toShop() {
   120	    HF.clearTimers(); resetInput();
   121	    wave = HF.genWave(Math.min(save.fight, MAXFIGHT), COLS);
   122	    state = 'shop'; shopSel = 0;
   123	  }
   124	  function newRun() {
   125	    HF.clearTimers(); resetInput(); HF.fx.clear();
   126	    save.fight = 1; save.coins = 0;
   127	    save.gear = { dmg: 0, slow: 0, wall: 0, coin: 0 };
   128	    persist(); toShop();
   129	  }
   130	  function buy(i) {
   131	    var k = GEAR[i].k, lvl = save.gear[k];
   132	    if (lvl >= MAXLVL) return;
   133	    var cost = gearCost(lvl);
   134	    if (save.coins < cost) { HF.audio.sfx('bad'); return; }
   135	    save.coins -= cost; save.gear[k] = lvl + 1;
   136	    HF.audio.sfx('buy'); persist();
   137	  }
   138	
   139	  /* board match -> weapons */
   140	  board.onClear = function (runs, combo) {
   141	    var cmul = 1 + 0.28 * (combo - 1);
   142	    var total = 0;
   143	    for (var i = 0; i < runs.length; i++) {
   144	      var run = runs[i], splash = run.len >= 4, pierce = run.len >= 5;
   145	      var power = cmul * (1 + (run.len - 3) * 0.35);
   146	      for (var j = 0; j < run.cells.length; j++) {
   147	        var cc = run.cells[j];
   148	        battle.fire(cc.c, run.t, power, splash, pierce, L);
   149	        var rect = board.cellRect(L, cc.r, cc.c);
   150	        HF.fx.burst(rect.x + rect.s / 2, rect.y + rect.s / 2, GEM[run.t].c, 5, 130, 0.4);
   151	        total++;
   152	      }
   153	    }
   154	    HF.audio.sfx('match', combo);
   155	    if (combo > 1) {
   156	      HF.fx.text(L.W / 2, L.by - 26, 'COMBO x' + combo, '#ffd15c');
   157	      shakeT = Math.min(8, shakeT + 2);
   158	    }
   159	    if (total > 6) shakeT = Math.min(10, shakeT + 2);
   160	  };
   161	
   162	  /* ---------- update ---------- */
   163	  function update(dt) {
   164	    HF.fx.update(dt);
   165	    shakeT = Math.max(0, shakeT - dt * 24);
   166	    if (state === 'fight') {
   167	      hintT -= dt;
   168	      board.update(dt);
   169	      battle.update(dt, L);
   170	      if (battle.coins > 0) { save.coins += battle.coins; battle.coins = 0; }
   171	      if (battle.over === -1) {
   172	        state = 'lost'; resultT = 0; persist();
   173	        HF.audio.sfx('lose'); resetInput();
   174	      } else if (battle.over === 1) {
   175	        endBonus = 25 + save.fight * 12;
   176	        save.coins += endBonus;
   177	        state = 'won'; resultT = 0;
   178	        save.fight = Math.min(MAXFIGHT + 1, save.fight + 1);
   179	        if (save.fight > MAXFIGHT) save.wins++;
   180	        persist(); HF.audio.sfx('win'); resetInput();
   181	      }
   182	    }
   183	  }

   186	  function drawHUD() {
   187	    g.fillStyle = '#111823';
   188	    g.fillRect(0, 0, L.W, L.hud);
   189	    g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.textAlign = 'left';
   190	    g.font = 'bold 14px ui-monospace,monospace';
   191	    g.fillStyle = '#9fb3c8';
   192	    var f = Math.min(save.fight, MAXFIGHT);
   193	    g.fillText('FIGHT ' + f + '/' + MAXFIGHT, 10, 15);
   194	    g.fillStyle = '#ffd15c';
   195	    g.textAlign = 'right';
   196	    g.fillText(save.coins + 'c', L.W - 56, 15);
   197	    /* wall bar */
   198	    var bw = L.W - 20, hp = state === 'fight' ? battle.wallHp : battle.wallMax(save.gear);
   199	    var mx = state === 'fight' ? battle.wallHpMax : battle.wallMax(save.gear);
   200	    g.fillStyle = '#0b0f14'; g.fillRect(10, 26, bw, 10);
   201	    var frac = HF.clamp(hp / mx, 0, 1);
   202	    g.fillStyle = frac > 0.5 ? '#6fdc7f' : (frac > 0.22 ? '#ffd15c' : '#ff5f5f');
   203	    g.fillRect(10, 26, bw * frac, 10);
   204	    g.fillStyle = '#dfe8f2'; g.font = 'bold 10px ui-monospace,monospace'; g.textAlign = 'left';
   205	    g.fillText('WALL ' + Math.ceil(hp) + '/' + Math.round(mx), 14, 31);
   206	    /* mute */
   207	    var mb = btn('mute', L.W - 50, 0, 50, L.hud, HF.audio.muted() ? 'off' : 'snd', 'ghost');
   208	    mb.fs = 12;
   209	    drawBtn(mb, IN.btnDown === 'mute');
   210	  }

   212	  function drawBoard() {
   213	    /* frame */
   214	    g.fillStyle = '#0d131b';
   215	    g.fillRect(0, L.by - 20, L.W, L.H - (L.by - 20));
   216	    /* wall */
   217	    var wy = L.wallY;
   218	    g.fillStyle = '#3a4b63';
   219	    g.fillRect(0, wy, L.W, 10);
   220	    g.fillStyle = '#22304a';
   221	    for (var i = 0; i < COLS; i++) {
   222	      var x = L.bx + i * L.cell;
   223	      g.fillRect(x + 2, wy + 2, L.cell - 4, 6);
   224	      /* turret nub */
   225	      g.fillStyle = '#5b7595';
   226	      g.fillRect(x + L.cell / 2 - 4, wy - 7, 8, 8);
   227	      g.fillStyle = '#22304a';
   228	    }
   229	
   230	    var sw = board.sw;
   231	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   232	      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   233	        var cellObj = board.grid[r][c];
   234	        var rect = board.cellRect(L, r, c);
   235	        var cx = rect.x + rect.s / 2, cy = rect.y + rect.s / 2 - cellObj.oy * L.cell;
   236	        var sc = 1;
   237	        if (cellObj.pop >= 0) sc = 1 - cellObj.pop;
   238	        if (sw) {
   239	          var p = HF.ease(HF.clamp(sw.t, 0, 1));
   240	          var dir = null;
   241	          if (sw.a.r === r && sw.a.c === c) dir = { dr: sw.b.r - r, dc: sw.b.c - c };
   242	          else if (sw.b.r === r && sw.b.c === c) dir = { dr: sw.a.r - r, dc: sw.a.c - c };
   243	          if (dir) { cx += dir.dc * L.cell * p; cy += dir.dr * L.cell * p; }
   244	        }
   245	        /* slot */
   246	        g.fillStyle = ((r + c) % 2) ? '#131c27' : '#16202d';
   247	        g.fillRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.s, rect.s);
   248	        if (sc <= 0.02) continue;
   249	        drawGem(cellObj.t, cx, cy, L.cell * 0.40 * sc);
   250	      }
   251	    }
   252	    /* selection / cursor */
   253	    if (cursor.sel) outline(cursor.sel.r, cursor.sel.c, '#ffd15c', 3);
   254	    if (IN.dragCell) outline(IN.dragCell.r, IN.dragCell.c, '#ffffff', 3);
   255	    if (IN.keyMode) outline(cursor.r, cursor.c, '#7fd8ff', 2);
   256	    /* board border */
   257	    g.strokeStyle = '#1e2a3a'; g.lineWidth = 2;
   258	    g.strokeRect(L.bx, L.by, L.bw, L.bh);
   259	  }
   260	  function outline(r, c, col, lw) {
   261	    var rect = board.cellRect(L, r, c);
   262	    g.strokeStyle = col; g.lineWidth = lw;
   263	    g.strokeRect(rect.x + 2, rect.y + 2, rect.s - 4, rect.s - 4);
   264	  }
   265	
   266	  function drawGem(t, x, y, r) {
   267	    g.fillStyle = GEM[t].c;
   268	    g.beginPath();
   269	    if (t === 0) { g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); }
   270	    else if (t === 1) { g.moveTo(x, y - r); g.lineTo(x + r, y); g.lineTo(x, y + r); g.lineTo(x - r, y); g.closePath(); }
   271	    else if (t === 2) {
   272	      var q = r * 0.42;
   273	      g.rect(x - q, y - r, q * 2, r * 2); g.rect(x - r, y - q, r * 2, q * 2);
   274	    } else if (t === 3) { g.rect(x - r * 0.82, y - r * 0.82, r * 1.64, r * 1.64); }
   275	    else { g.moveTo(x, y - r); g.lineTo(x + r * 0.92, y + r * 0.72); g.lineTo(x - r * 0.92, y + r * 0.72); g.closePath(); }
   276	    g.fill();
   277	    g.globalAlpha = 0.3; g.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
   278	    g.fillRect(x - r * 0.5, y - r * 0.72, r * 0.5, r * 0.28);
   279	    g.globalAlpha = 1;
   280	  }

   282	  function drawFight() {
   283	    battle.draw(g, L);
   284	    drawBoard();
   285	    HF.fx.draw(g);
   286	    drawHUD();
   287	    /* remaining */
   288	    g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
   289	    g.font = 'bold 12px ui-monospace,monospace';
   290	    var left = (battle.queue.length - battle.qi) + battle.enemies.length;
   291	    g.fillStyle = '#8fa4bb';
   292	    g.fillText('SWARM LEFT ' + left, L.W / 2, L.hud + 12);
   293	    if (hintT > 0) {
   294	      g.globalAlpha = HF.clamp(hintT, 0, 1);
   295	      g.fillStyle = '#ffd15c';
   296	      g.font = 'bold 12px ui-monospace,monospace';
   297	      g.fillText('SWIPE TO MATCH - SHOTS FIRE UP THAT COLUMN', L.W / 2, L.wallY - 26);
   298	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   299	    }
   300	  }

   307	  function drawShop() {
   308	    g.fillStyle = '#0b0f14'; g.fillRect(0, 0, L.W, L.H);
   309	    drawHUD();
   310	    var y = L.hud + 10, pad = 10, ww = L.W - 20;
   311	    /* wave preview */
   312	    var ph = 92;
   313	    panel(pad, y, ww, ph);
   314	    g.textAlign = 'left'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
   315	    g.fillStyle = '#ffd15c'; g.font = 'bold 16px ui-monospace,monospace';
   316	    g.fillText('WAVE ' + Math.min(save.fight, MAXFIGHT) + (wave.boss ? '  [BROOD]' : ''), pad + 12, y + 20);
   317	    var sum = HF.waveSummary(wave);
   318	    g.font = '12px ui-monospace,monospace';
   319	    var lx = pad + 12, ly = y + 41;
   320	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
### game 320-700
   320	    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
   321	      if (!sum[i]) continue;
   322	      var K = HF.KINDS[i], lab = K.name + ' x' + sum[i];
   323	      var wdt = 15 + g.measureText(lab).width + 16;
   324	      if (lx + wdt > pad + ww - 8) { lx = pad + 12; ly += 16; }
   325	      g.fillStyle = K.col;
   326	      g.fillRect(lx, ly - 5, 10, 10);
   327	      g.fillStyle = '#c9d8e8';
   328	      g.fillText(lab, lx + 15, ly);
   329	      lx += wdt;
   330	    }
   331	    g.fillStyle = '#8fa4bb'; g.font = '11px ui-monospace,monospace';
   332	    g.fillText('WALL ' + battle.wallMax(save.gear) + ' HP   BEST FIGHT ' + Math.min(save.best, MAXFIGHT) + (save.wins ? '   RUNS WON ' + save.wins : ''), pad + 12, y + 66);
   333	
   334	    y += ph + 10;
   335	    /* gear rows */
   336	    var rowH = Math.max(48, Math.min(58, (L.H - y - 100) / 4 - 8));
   337	    for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   338	      var gy = y + k * (rowH + 8);
   339	      var lvl = save.gear[GEAR[k].k];
   340	      var cost = gearCost(lvl);
   341	      var maxed = lvl >= MAXLVL;
   342	      var afford = save.coins >= cost && !maxed;
   343	      var b = btn('buy' + k, pad, gy, ww, rowH, '', afford ? 'main' : 'ghost');
   344	      b.dim = !afford;
   345	      drawBtn(b, IN.btnDown === b.id);
   346	      /* content */
   347	      g.textAlign = 'left'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
   348	      g.font = 'bold 14px ui-monospace,monospace';
   349	      g.fillStyle = maxed ? '#6fdc7f' : (afford ? '#dfe8f2' : '#66788d');
   350	      g.fillText(GEAR[k].name, pad + 12, gy + rowH * 0.32);
   351	      g.font = '11px ui-monospace,monospace';
   352	      g.fillStyle = '#8fa4bb';
   353	      g.fillText(GEAR[k].desc, pad + 12, gy + rowH * 0.68);
   354	      /* pips */
   355	      for (var p = 0; p < MAXLVL; p++) {
   356	        g.fillStyle = p < lvl ? '#ffd15c' : '#2b3a4f';
   357	        g.fillRect(pad + 150 + p * 11, gy + rowH * 0.28 - 4, 8, 8);
   358	      }
   359	      g.textAlign = 'right';
   360	      g.font = 'bold 13px ui-monospace,monospace';
   361	      g.fillStyle = maxed ? '#6fdc7f' : (afford ? '#ffd15c' : '#66788d');
   362	      g.fillText(maxed ? 'MAX' : (cost + 'c'), pad + ww - 12, gy + rowH * 0.62);
   363	      if (shopSel === k) { g.strokeStyle = '#7fd8ff'; g.lineWidth = 2; roundRect(pad, gy, ww, rowH, 10); g.stroke(); }
   364	    }
   365	    /* fight button */
   366	    var fy = y + 4 * (rowH + 8) + 6;
   367	    fy = Math.min(fy, L.H - 74);
   368	    var fb = btn('fight', pad, fy, ww, 64, save.fight > MAXFIGHT ? 'RUN COMPLETE - NEW RUN' : 'DEPLOY  >', 'go');
   369	    fb.fs = 18;
   370	    drawBtn(fb, IN.btnDown === 'fight');
   371	    g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
   372	    g.fillStyle = '#5b6d82'; g.font = '10px ui-monospace,monospace';
   373	    g.fillText('everything here is earned by playing - no purchases', L.W / 2, Math.min(L.H - 6, fy + 76));
   374	    HF.fx.draw(g);
   375	  }

   403	        var nb = btn('newrun', L.W / 2 - 130, cy + 90, 260, 60, 'NEW RUN', 'go'); nb.fs = 17;
   404	        drawBtn(nb, IN.btnDown === 'newrun');
   405	      } else {
   406	        var cb = btn('shop', L.W / 2 - 130, cy + 84, 260, 60, 'TO THE ARMORY', 'go'); cb.fs = 17;
   407	        drawBtn(cb, IN.btnDown === 'shop');
   408	      }
   409	    }

   412	  function frame(ts) {
   413	    w.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   414	    var dt = (ts - lastT) / 1000; lastT = ts;
   415	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   416	    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
   417	    if (!started) { return; }
   418	    if (rotated || paused || d.hidden) { drawFrameOnly(); return; }
   419	    update(dt);
   420	    render();
   421	  }
   422	  function drawFrameOnly() { render(); }
   423	
   424	  function render() {
   425	    BTN.length = 0;
   426	    g.save();
   427	    if (shakeT > 0 || (state === 'fight' && battle.shake > 0)) {
   428	      var s = Math.max(shakeT, state === 'fight' ? battle.shake : 0);
   429	      g.translate(HF.rnd(-s, s) * 0.5, HF.rnd(-s, s) * 0.5);
   430	    }
   431	    g.fillStyle = '#0b0f14'; g.fillRect(-20, -20, L.W + 40, L.H + 40);
   432	    if (state === 'shop') drawShop();
   433	    else if (state === 'fight') drawFight();
   434	    else drawResult();
   435	    g.restore();
   436	  }
   437	
   438	  /* ---------- pointer input ---------- */
   439	  function pos(e) {
   440	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   441	    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   442	  }
   443	  function onDown(e) {
   444	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   445	    e.preventDefault();
   446	    var p = pos(e), id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   447	    IN.ptr[id] = { x: p.x, y: p.y };
   448	    var b = hitBtn(p.x, p.y);
   449	    if (b) { IN.btnDown = b.id; IN.btnPtr = id; return; }
   450	    if (state === 'fight' && board.state === 'idle' && IN.dragId === null) {
   451	      var cell = board.hitCell(L, p.x, p.y);
   452	      if (cell) { IN.dragId = id; IN.dragCell = cell; IN.dragX = p.x; IN.dragY = p.y; IN.keyMode = false; }
   453	    }
   454	  }
   455	  function onMove(e) {
   456	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   457	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   458	    if (!IN.ptr[id]) return;
   459	    e.preventDefault();
   460	    var p = pos(e);
   461	    IN.ptr[id].x = p.x; IN.ptr[id].y = p.y;
   462	    if (IN.dragId === id && IN.dragCell) {
   463	      var dx = p.x - IN.dragX, dy = p.y - IN.dragY;
   464	      var th = Math.max(14, L.cell * 0.38);
   465	      if (Math.abs(dx) > th || Math.abs(dy) > th) {
   466	        var r2 = IN.dragCell.r, c2 = IN.dragCell.c;
   467	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) c2 += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else r2 += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   468	        board.trySwap(IN.dragCell.r, IN.dragCell.c, r2, c2);
   469	        IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null;
   470	      }
   471	    }
   472	  }
   473	  function onUp(e) {
   474	    if (!started) return;
   475	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   476	    var p = IN.ptr[id] ? { x: IN.ptr[id].x, y: IN.ptr[id].y } : null;
   477	    delete IN.ptr[id];
   478	    if (IN.dragId === id) { IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null; }
   479	    if (IN.btnDown && IN.btnPtr === id) {
   480	      var wasDown = IN.btnDown; IN.btnDown = null; IN.btnPtr = null;
   481	      if (p && !rotated) {
   482	        var b = hitBtn(p.x, p.y);
   483	        if (b && b.id === wasDown) activate(b.id);
   484	      }
   485	    }
   486	  }
   487	  function onCancel(e) {
   488	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   489	    delete IN.ptr[id];
   490	    if (IN.dragId === id) { IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null; }
   491	    if (IN.btnPtr === id) { IN.btnDown = null; IN.btnPtr = null; }
   492	  }
   493	
   494	  function activate(id) {
   495	    if (id === 'mute') { HF.audio.toggle(); return; }
   496	    if (id === 'fight') {
   497	      if (save.fight > MAXFIGHT) { newRun(); return; }
   498	      startFight(); return;
   499	    }
   500	    if (id === 'retry') { startFight(); return; }
   501	    if (id === 'shop') { toShop(); return; }
   502	    if (id === 'newrun') { newRun(); return; }
   503	    if (id.indexOf('buy') === 0) { buy(parseInt(id.slice(3), 10) || 0); return; }
   504	  }
   505	
   506	  /* ---------- keyboard ---------- */
   507	  function onKey(e) {
   508	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   509	    var k = e.key;
   510	    if (IN.keys[k]) { if (k === ' ') e.preventDefault(); }
   511	    IN.keys[k] = 1;
   512	    if (state === 'fight') {
   513	      IN.keyMode = true;
   514	      var dr = 0, dc = 0;
   515	      if (k === 'ArrowLeft') dc = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowRight') dc = 1;
   516	      else if (k === 'ArrowUp') dr = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowDown') dr = 1;
   517	      if (dr || dc) {
   518	        e.preventDefault();
   519	        if (cursor.sel) {
   520	          board.trySwap(cursor.sel.r, cursor.sel.c, cursor.sel.r + dr, cursor.sel.c + dc);
   521	          cursor.r = HF.clamp(cursor.sel.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   522	          cursor.c = HF.clamp(cursor.sel.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   523	          cursor.sel = null;
   524	        } else {
   525	          cursor.r = HF.clamp(cursor.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   526	          cursor.c = HF.clamp(cursor.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   527	        }
   528	      } else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   529	        e.preventDefault();
   530	        cursor.sel = cursor.sel ? null : { r: cursor.r, c: cursor.c };
   531	      } else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { startFight(); }
   532	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { HF.audio.toggle(); }
   533	      return;
   534	    }
   535	    if (state === 'shop') {
   536	      if (k === 'ArrowUp') { shopSel = (shopSel + 3) % 4; e.preventDefault(); }
   537	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown') { shopSel = (shopSel + 1) % 4; e.preventDefault(); }
   538	      else if (k === 'Enter') { buy(shopSel); }
   539	      else if (k === ' ' || k === 'f' || k === 'F') { e.preventDefault(); activate('fight'); }
   540	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { HF.audio.toggle(); }
   541	      return;
   542	    }
   543	    if (state === 'lost') {
   544	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'r' || k === 'R') { e.preventDefault(); startFight(); }
   545	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'u' || k === 'U') { toShop(); }
   546	      return;
   547	    }
   548	    if (state === 'won') {
   549	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); (save.fight > MAXFIGHT) ? newRun() : toShop(); }
   550	      return;
   551	    }
   552	  }
   553	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete IN.keys[e.key]; }
   554	
   555	  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
   556	  function boot() {
   557	    HF.audio.unlock();
   558	    bootEl.classList.remove('on');
   559	    started = true;
   560	    lastT = w.performance.now();
   561	    resetInput();
   562	    layout();
   563	    toShop();
   564	  }
   565	
   566	  d.getElementById('bootBtn').addEventListener('click', boot);
   567	  bootEl.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { if (e.target.id === 'bootBtn') { e.preventDefault(); boot(); } }, { passive: false });
   568	
   569	  var wrap = d.getElementById('wrap');
   570	  var hasPointer = !!w.PointerEvent;
   571	  if (hasPointer) {
   572	    wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, { passive: false });
   573	    wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, { passive: false });
   574	    w.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp, { passive: false });
   575	    w.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel, { passive: false });
   576	  } else {
   577	    wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
   578	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   579	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   580	        onDown({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY, preventDefault: function () { e.preventDefault(); } });
   581	      }
   582	    }, { passive: false });
   583	    wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
   584	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   585	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   586	        onMove({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY, preventDefault: function () { e.preventDefault(); } });
   587	      }
   588	    }, { passive: false });
   589	    wrap.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
   590	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   591	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   592	        onUp({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY });
   593	      }
   594	    }, { passive: false });
   595	    wrap.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) {
   596	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) onCancel({ pointerId: e.changedTouches[i].identifier });
   597	    }, { passive: false });
   598	    wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
   599	    wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
   600	    w.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
   601	  }
   602	  wrap.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   603	  d.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   604	  w.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
   605	  w.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
   606	  w.addEventListener('blur', function () { resetInput(); });
   607	  d.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
   608	    resetInput();
   609	    if (!d.hidden) lastT = w.performance.now();
   610	  });
   611	  w.addEventListener('resize', function () { layout(); resetInput(); });
   612	  w.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { HF.after(layout, 60); resetInput(); });
   613	
   614	  layout();
   615	  w.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   616	})(window);
### battle
     1	/* Hivefall - battle half: swarm waves, wall, lane-mapped shots */
     2	(function (w) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var HF = w.HF;
     5	
     6	  var MAX_ENEMIES = 64, MAX_SHOTS = 90;
     7	
     8	  var KINDS = [
     9	    { id: 0, name: 'MITE',   hp: 16,  spd: 26, r: 11, dmg: 5,  col: '#8ad06a', coin: 2 },
    10	    { id: 1, name: 'HUSK',   hp: 50,  spd: 15, r: 17, dmg: 13, col: '#c98a4b', coin: 5 },
    11	    { id: 2, name: 'DARTER', hp: 22,  spd: 44, r: 10, dmg: 6,  col: '#6ac6d0', coin: 3 },
    12	    { id: 3, name: 'BROOD',  hp: 300, spd: 9,  r: 25, dmg: 38, col: '#d05a8a', coin: 40 }
    13	  ];
    14	  HF.KINDS = KINDS;
    15	
    16	  function mulberry32(a) {
    17	    return function () {
    18	      a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    19	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    20	      t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    21	      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    22	    };
    23	  }
    24	
    25	  /* deterministic wave script for a fight number (1..20) */
    26	  HF.genWave = function (f, lanes) {
    27	    var rng = mulberry32(9176 + f * 7919);
    28	    var list = [], t = 1.2;
    29	    var n = Math.min(46, 7 + Math.round(f * 1.7));
    30	    var gap = HF.clamp(1.55 - f * 0.035, 0.52, 1.55);
    31	    var boss = (f === 10 || f === 15 || f === 20);
    32	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    33	      var roll = rng(), k = 0;
    34	      if (f >= 3 && roll > 0.72) k = 2;
    35	      if (f >= 4 && roll < 0.22 + Math.min(0.2, f * 0.012)) k = 1;
    36	      list.push({ t: t, kind: k, lane: Math.floor(rng() * lanes) });
    37	      t += gap * (0.55 + rng() * 0.9);
    38	      if (f >= 6 && rng() > 0.86) { /* paired spawn */
    39	        list.push({ t: t - 0.12, kind: k, lane: Math.floor(rng() * lanes) });
    40	      }
    41	    }
    42	    if (boss) list.push({ t: 4 + n * gap * 0.34, kind: 3, lane: Math.floor(lanes / 2) });
    43	    list.sort(function (a, b) { return a.t - b.t; });
    44	    return { list: list, boss: boss, count: list.length, dur: t };
    45	  };
    46	
    47	  HF.waveSummary = function (wave) {
    48	    var c = [0, 0, 0, 0];
    49	    for (var i = 0; i < wave.list.length; i++) c[wave.list[i].kind]++;
    50	    return c;
    51	  };
    52	
    53	  /* ---------- Battle ---------- */
    54	  function Battle() {
    55	    this.enemies = []; this.shots = []; this.lanes = 6;
    56	    this.reset(1, { dmg: 0, slow: 0, wall: 0, coin: 0 }, 6);
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  Battle.prototype.wallMax = function (gear) { return 130 + gear.wall * 60; };
    60	
    61	  Battle.prototype.reset = function (fight, gear, lanes) {
    62	    this.lanes = lanes || 6;
    63	    this.fight = fight;
    64	    this.gear = gear;
    65	    this.enemies.length = 0;
    66	    this.shots.length = 0;
    67	    this.wave = HF.genWave(fight, this.lanes);
    68	    this.queue = this.wave.list.slice();
    69	    this.qi = 0;
    70	    this.time = 0;
    71	    this.hpMul = 1 + 0.17 * (fight - 1);
    72	    this.spdMul = 1 + 0.018 * (fight - 1);
    73	    this.wallHpMax = this.wallMax(gear);
    74	    this.wallHp = this.wallHpMax;
    75	    this.shake = 0;
    76	    this.flashLane = new Array(this.lanes);
    77	    for (var i = 0; i < this.lanes; i++) this.flashLane[i] = 0;
    78	    this.over = 0; /* 0 running, 1 won, -1 lost */
    79	    this.killCount = 0;
    80	    this.coins = 0;
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  Battle.prototype.dmgMul = function () { return 1 + 0.42 * this.gear.dmg; };
    84	  Battle.prototype.slowFactor = function () { return Math.max(0.22, 0.66 - 0.055 * this.gear.slow); };
    85	  Battle.prototype.slowTime = function () { return 2.0 + 0.45 * this.gear.slow; };
    86	  Battle.prototype.coinMul = function () { return 1 + 0.45 * this.gear.coin; };
    87	
    88	  /* fire from a matched gem: col = lane, gem type index */
    89	  Battle.prototype.fire = function (col, type, power, splash, pierce, L) {
    90	    if (col < 0 || col >= this.lanes) return;
    91	    this.flashLane[col] = 0.35;
    92	    var x = L.bx + (col + 0.5) * L.cell;
    93	    if (type === 2) { /* green: repair */
    94	      var heal = Math.round(3.2 * power);
    95	      this.wallHp = Math.min(this.wallHpMax, this.wallHp + heal);
    96	      HF.fx.text(x, L.wallY - 8, '+' + heal, '#7fe08a');
    97	      HF.fx.burst(x, L.wallY, '#7fe08a', 5, 90, 0.4);
    98	      HF.audio.sfx('repair');
    99	      return;
   100	    }
   101	    if (type === 3) { /* gold: coins */
   102	      var got = Math.max(1, Math.round(1.4 * power * this.coinMul()));
   103	      this.coins += got;
   104	      HF.fx.text(x, L.wallY - 14, '+' + got + 'c', '#ffd15c');
   105	      HF.audio.sfx('coin');
   106	      return;
   107	    }
   108	    if (this.shots.length >= MAX_SHOTS) this.shots.shift();
   109	    this.shots.push({
   110	      lane: col, x: x, y: L.wallY - 6,
   111	      vy: -(type === 1 ? 430 : (type === 4 ? 360 : 520)),
   112	      kind: type,
   113	      dmg: (type === 1 ? 5 : (type === 4 ? 7 : 20)) * power * this.dmgMul(),
   114	      splash: !!splash, pierce: !!pierce, hits: [], life: 3
   115	    });
   116	    HF.audio.sfx('shoot');
   117	  };
   118	
   119	  Battle.prototype.spawn = function (kind, lane, L) {
   120	    if (this.enemies.length >= MAX_ENEMIES) return;
   121	    var K = KINDS[kind];
   122	    var hp = K.hp * this.hpMul;
   123	    this.enemies.push({
   124	      kind: kind, lane: lane,
   125	      x: L.bx + (lane + 0.5) * L.cell,
   126	      y: L.btop - 20 - Math.random() * 14,
   127	      hp: hp, max: hp, spd: K.spd * this.spdMul * (0.9 + Math.random() * 0.2),
   128	      r: K.r, slow: 0, ven: 0, venDps: 0, flash: 0, wob: Math.random() * 6.28, dead: false
   129	    });
   130	  };
   131	
   132	  Battle.prototype.hurt = function (e, d, L, col) {
   133	    e.hp -= d; e.flash = 0.12;
   134	    if (e.hp <= 0 && !e.dead) {
   135	      e.dead = true;
   136	      this.killCount++;
   137	      var K = KINDS[e.kind];
   138	      var got = Math.max(1, Math.round(K.coin * this.coinMul() * 0.5));
   139	      this.coins += got;
   140	      HF.fx.burst(e.x, e.y, K.col, e.kind === 3 ? 26 : 9, 190, 0.55);
   141	      if (e.kind === 3) { this.shake = Math.max(this.shake, 9); HF.fx.text(e.x, e.y, 'BROOD DOWN', '#ffd15c'); }
   142	      HF.audio.sfx('kill');
   143	    } else {
   144	      HF.fx.burst(e.x, e.y, col || '#ffffff', 3, 110, 0.28);
   145	      HF.audio.sfx('hit');
   146	    }
   147	  };
   148	
   149	  Battle.prototype.update = function (dt, L) {
   150	    if (this.over) return;
   151	    var i, j, e, s;
   152	    this.time += dt;
   153	    this.shake = Math.max(0, this.shake - dt * 22);
   154	    for (i = 0; i < this.lanes; i++) if (this.flashLane[i] > 0) this.flashLane[i] -= dt;
   155	
   156	    /* spawns */
   157	    while (this.qi < this.queue.length && this.queue[this.qi].t <= this.time) {
   158	      var q = this.queue[this.qi++];
   159	      this.spawn(q.kind, q.lane, L);
   160	    }
   161	
   162	    /* shots */
   163	    var ks = 0;
   164	    for (i = 0; i < this.shots.length; i++) {
   165	      s = this.shots[i];
   166	      s.y += s.vy * dt; s.life -= dt;
   167	      var alive = s.y > L.btop - 30 && s.life > 0;
   168	      if (alive) {
   169	        for (j = 0; j < this.enemies.length; j++) {
   170	          e = this.enemies[j];
   171	          if (e.dead) continue;
   172	          var laneOk = s.splash ? Math.abs(e.lane - s.lane) <= 1 : e.lane === s.lane;
   173	          if (!laneOk) continue;
   174	          if (s.hits.indexOf(e) >= 0) continue;
   175	          if (Math.abs(e.y - s.y) > e.r + 8) continue;
   176	          var mult = (s.splash && e.lane !== s.lane) ? 0.5 : 1;
   177	          if (s.kind === 1) {
   178	            e.slow = this.slowTime();
   179	            HF.fx.burst(e.x, e.y, '#7fd8ff', 6, 120, 0.4);
   180	            HF.audio.sfx('frost');
   181	          } else if (s.kind === 4) {
   182	            e.venDps = Math.max(e.venDps, s.dmg * 0.75);
   183	            e.ven = 3.2;
   184	            HF.fx.burst(e.x, e.y, '#c48aff', 5, 110, 0.4);
   185	            HF.audio.sfx('venom');
   186	          }
   187	          this.hurt(e, s.dmg * mult, L, s.kind === 1 ? '#7fd8ff' : (s.kind === 4 ? '#c48aff' : '#ff9b5c'));
   188	          s.hits.push(e);
   189	          if (s.hits.length > 12) s.hits.shift();
   190	          if (!s.pierce) { alive = false; break; }
   191	        }
   192	      }
   193	      if (alive) this.shots[ks++] = s;
   194	    }
   195	    this.shots.length = ks;
   196	
   197	    /* enemies */
   198	    var ke = 0;
   199	    for (i = 0; i < this.enemies.length; i++) {
   200	      e = this.enemies[i];
   201	      if (e.dead) continue;
   202	      if (e.flash > 0) e.flash -= dt;
   203	      if (e.slow > 0) e.slow -= dt;
   204	      if (e.ven > 0) {
   205	        e.ven -= dt;
   206	        e.hp -= e.venDps * dt;
   207	        if (Math.random() < dt * 8) HF.fx.burst(e.x, e.y, '#c48aff', 1, 40, 0.3);
   208	        if (e.hp <= 0) { this.hurt(e, 0.01, L, '#c48aff'); continue; }
   209	      }
   210	      e.wob += dt * 5;
   211	      e.y += e.spd * (e.slow > 0 ? this.slowFactor() : 1) * dt;
   212	      if (e.y + e.r >= L.wallY) {
   213	        var d = KINDS[e.kind].dmg * (1 + 0.10 * (this.fight - 1));
   214	        this.wallHp -= d;
   215	        this.shake = Math.min(14, this.shake + 5);
   216	        HF.fx.burst(e.x, L.wallY, '#ff5c5c', 12, 170, 0.5);
   217	        HF.fx.text(e.x, L.wallY + 14, '-' + Math.round(d), '#ff8a8a');
   218	        HF.audio.sfx('wall');
   219	        e.dead = true;
   220	        if (this.wallHp <= 0) { this.wallHp = 0; this.over = -1; }
   221	        continue;
   222	      }
   223	      this.enemies[ke++] = e;
   224	    }
   225	    this.enemies.length = ke;
   226	
   227	    if (!this.over && this.qi >= this.queue.length && this.enemies.length === 0) this.over = 1;
   228	  };
   229	
   230	  /* ---------- draw ---------- */
   231	  Battle.prototype.draw = function (g, L) {
   232	    var i, e, s;
   233	    /* field backdrop */
   234	    g.fillStyle = '#0e141c';
   235	    g.fillRect(0, L.btop, L.W, L.wallY - L.btop);
   236	    /* lanes */

   238	      var x = L.bx + i * L.cell;
   239	      g.fillStyle = (i % 2) ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.022)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
   240	      g.fillRect(x, L.btop, L.cell, L.wallY - L.btop);
   241	      if (this.flashLane[i] > 0) {

   243	        g.fillRect(x, L.btop, L.cell, L.wallY - L.btop);
   244	      }
   245	    }
   246	    /* hive line at top */
   247	    g.fillStyle = '#1b2430';
   248	    g.fillRect(0, L.btop, L.W, 6);
   249	    g.fillStyle = '#33415a';
   250	    for (i = 0; i < this.lanes; i++) {
   251	      g.fillRect(L.bx + i * L.cell + 3, L.btop, L.cell - 6, 3);
   252	    }

   254	    /* shots */

   258	      g.fillStyle = sc;

   260	      g.fillRect(s.x - wdt / 2, s.y - hgt / 2, wdt, hgt);
   261	      g.globalAlpha = 0.35;
   262	      g.fillRect(s.x - wdt / 2, s.y, wdt, hgt * 1.4);
   263	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   264	    }

   277	      g.lineTo(cx - e.r * 0.62, cy + e.r * 0.85);

   282	      g.fillRect(cx - e.r * 0.45, cy - e.r * 0.1, e.r * 0.3, e.r * 0.22);
   283	      g.fillRect(cx + e.r * 0.15, cy - e.r * 0.1, e.r * 0.3, e.r * 0.22);

   286	        g.strokeRect(cx - e.r, cy - e.r, e.r * 2, e.r * 2);

   295	      }

### board
     1	/* Hivefall - match-3 board engine (grid, swaps, cascades, animation phases) */
     2	(function (w) {
     3	  'use strict';
     4	  var HF = w.HF;
     5	
     6	  var CLEAR_TIME = 0.15, SWAP_TIME = 0.11, FALL_SPEED = 15.0; /* cells per second */
     7	
     8	  function Board(cols, rows, ncolors) {
     9	    this.cols = cols; this.rows = rows; this.nc = ncolors;
    10	    this.grid = [];
    11	    this.onClear = null;      /* fn(runs, combo) */
    12	    this.reset();
    13	  }
    14	
    15	  Board.prototype.reset = function () {
    16	    this.state = 'idle';
    17	    this.combo = 0;
    18	    this.sw = null;
    19	    this.timer = 0;
    20	    this.grid = [];
    21	    for (var r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
    22	      var row = [];
    23	      for (var c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) row.push(null);
    24	      this.grid.push(row);
    25	    }
    26	    for (var r2 = 0; r2 < this.rows; r2++)
    27	      for (var c2 = 0; c2 < this.cols; c2++)
    28	        this.grid[r2][c2] = { t: this.safeType(r2, c2), oy: 0, pop: -1 };
    29	    this.ensureMove();
    30	  };
    31	
    32	  /* pick a colour that does not immediately complete a run */
    33	  Board.prototype.safeType = function (r, c) {
    34	    var tries = 0, t;
    35	    do {
    36	      t = HF.irnd(this.nc); tries++;
    37	      var h = (c >= 2 && this.grid[r][c - 1] && this.grid[r][c - 2] &&
    38	               this.grid[r][c - 1].t === t && this.grid[r][c - 2].t === t);
    39	      var v = (r >= 2 && this.grid[r - 1][c] && this.grid[r - 2][c] &&
    40	               this.grid[r - 1][c].t === t && this.grid[r - 2][c].t === t);
    41	      if (!h && !v) break;
    42	    } while (tries < 20);
    43	    return t;
    44	  };
    45	
    46	  Board.prototype.at = function (r, c) {
    47	    if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= this.rows || c >= this.cols) return null;
    48	    return this.grid[r][c];
    49	  };
    50	
    51	  /* find all runs of >=3 -> [{t, cells:[{r,c}], len}] */
    52	  Board.prototype.findRuns = function () {
    53	    var runs = [], r, c, i;
    54	    for (r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
    55	      c = 0;
    56	      while (c < this.cols) {
    57	        var t = this.grid[r][c].t, n = 1;
    58	        while (c + n < this.cols && this.grid[r][c + n].t === t) n++;
    59	        if (n >= 3) {
    60	          var cells = [];
    61	          for (i = 0; i < n; i++) cells.push({ r: r, c: c + i });
    62	          runs.push({ t: t, cells: cells, len: n });
    63	        }
    64	        c += n;
    65	      }
    66	    }
    67	    for (c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
    68	      r = 0;
    69	      while (r < this.rows) {
    70	        var t2 = this.grid[r][c].t, m = 1;
    71	        while (r + m < this.rows && this.grid[r + m][c].t === t2) m++;
    72	        if (m >= 3) {
    73	          var cl = [];
    74	          for (i = 0; i < m; i++) cl.push({ r: r + i, c: c });
    75	          runs.push({ t: t2, cells: cl, len: m });
    76	        }
    77	        r += m;
    78	      }
    79	    }
    80	    return runs;
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  Board.prototype.hasMove = function () {
    84	    var self = this;
    85	    function swap(r1, c1, r2, c2) {
    86	      var a = self.grid[r1][c1], b = self.grid[r2][c2];
    87	      self.grid[r1][c1] = b; self.grid[r2][c2] = a;
    88	    }
    89	    for (var r = 0; r < this.rows; r++) {
    90	      for (var c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
    91	        if (c + 1 < this.cols) {
    92	          swap(r, c, r, c + 1);
    93	          if (this.findRuns().length) { swap(r, c, r, c + 1); return true; }
    94	          swap(r, c, r, c + 1);
    95	        }
    96	        if (r + 1 < this.rows) {
    97	          swap(r, c, r + 1, c);
    98	          if (this.findRuns().length) { swap(r, c, r + 1, c); return true; }
    99	          swap(r, c, r + 1, c);
   100	        }
   101	      }
   102	    }
   103	    return false;
   104	  };
   105	
   106	  Board.prototype.ensureMove = function () {
   107	    var guard = 0;
   108	    while (guard++ < 30) {
   109	      if (this.findRuns().length) { this.shuffleTypes(); continue; }
   110	      if (this.hasMove()) return;
   111	      this.shuffleTypes();
   112	    }
   113	  };
   114	
   115	  Board.prototype.shuffleTypes = function () {
   116	    for (var r = 0; r < this.rows; r++)
   117	      for (var c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
   118	        this.grid[r][c].t = HF.irnd(this.nc);
   119	        this.grid[r][c].oy = 0; this.grid[r][c].pop = -1;
   120	      }
   121	  };
   122	
   123	  /* player attempts a swap; returns true if accepted */
   124	  Board.prototype.trySwap = function (r, c, r2, c2) {
   125	    if (this.state !== 'idle') return false;
   126	    if (!this.at(r, c) || !this.at(r2, c2)) return false;
   127	    if (Math.abs(r - r2) + Math.abs(c - c2) !== 1) return false;
   128	    this.sw = { a: { r: r, c: c }, b: { r: r2, c: c2 }, t: 0, back: false };
   129	    this.state = 'swap';
   130	    this.combo = 0;
   131	    HF.audio.sfx('swap');
   132	    return true;
   133	  };
   134	
   135	  Board.prototype.doSwap = function () {
   136	    var a = this.sw.a, b = this.sw.b;
   137	    var t = this.grid[a.r][a.c]; this.grid[a.r][a.c] = this.grid[b.r][b.c]; this.grid[b.r][b.c] = t;
   138	  };
   139	
   140	  Board.prototype.startClear = function (runs) {
   141	    var seen = {}, i, j;
   142	    for (i = 0; i < runs.length; i++)
   143	      for (j = 0; j < runs[i].cells.length; j++) {
   144	        var cc = runs[i].cells[j];
   145	        seen[cc.r * this.cols + cc.c] = 1;
   146	        this.grid[cc.r][cc.c].pop = 0;
   147	      }
   148	    this.combo++;
   149	    if (this.onClear) this.onClear(runs, this.combo);
   150	    this.state = 'clear';
   151	    this.timer = 0;
   152	  };
   153	
   154	  Board.prototype.collapse = function () {
   155	    for (var c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
   156	      var write = this.rows - 1;
   157	      for (var r = this.rows - 1; r >= 0; r--) {
   158	        var g = this.grid[r][c];
   159	        if (g.pop >= 0) continue;
   160	        if (write !== r) {
   161	          this.grid[write][c] = g;
   162	          g.oy = (write - r);
   163	        }
   164	        write--;
   165	      }
   166	      var above = 1;
   167	      for (var r2 = write; r2 >= 0; r2--) {
   168	        this.grid[r2][c] = { t: HF.irnd(this.nc), oy: (r2 + above), pop: -1 };
   169	        above++;
   170	      }
   171	    }
   172	    this.state = 'fall';
   173	  };
   174	
   175	  Board.prototype.update = function (dt) {
   176	    var i, r, c;
   177	    if (this.state === 'swap') {
   178	      this.sw.t += dt / SWAP_TIME;
   179	      if (this.sw.t >= 1) {
   180	        this.doSwap();
   181	        if (this.sw.back) { this.sw = null; this.state = 'idle'; return; }
   182	        var runs = this.findRuns();
   183	        if (runs.length) { this.sw = null; this.startClear(runs); }
   184	        else {
   185	          HF.audio.sfx('bad');
   186	          this.sw = { a: this.sw.a, b: this.sw.b, t: 0, back: true };
   187	        }
   188	      }
   189	      return;
   190	    }
   191	    if (this.state === 'clear') {
   192	      this.timer += dt;
   193	      var p = HF.clamp(this.timer / CLEAR_TIME, 0, 1);
   194	      for (r = 0; r < this.rows; r++)
   195	        for (c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) if (this.grid[r][c].pop >= 0) this.grid[r][c].pop = p;
   196	      if (p >= 1) this.collapse();
   197	      return;
   198	    }
   199	    if (this.state === 'fall') {
   200	      var moving = false;
   201	      for (r = 0; r < this.rows; r++)
   202	        for (c = 0; c < this.cols; c++) {
   203	          var g = this.grid[r][c];
   204	          if (g.oy > 0) {
   205	            g.oy -= FALL_SPEED * dt * (1 + g.oy * 0.55);
   206	            if (g.oy < 0.001) g.oy = 0; else moving = true;
   207	          }
   208	        }
   209	      if (!moving) {
   210	        var runs2 = this.findRuns();
   211	        if (runs2.length) this.startClear(runs2);
   212	        else { this.state = 'idle'; this.combo = 0; if (!this.hasMove()) { this.shuffleTypes(); this.ensureMove(); } }
   213	      }
   214	      return;
   215	    }
   216	  };
   217	
   218	  /* pixel helpers */
   219	  Board.prototype.cellRect = function (L, r, c) {
   220	    return { x: L.bx + c * L.cell, y: L.by + r * L.cell, s: L.cell };
   221	  };
   222	
   223	  Board.prototype.hitCell = function (L, x, y) {
   224	    var c = Math.floor((x - L.bx) / L.cell), r = Math.floor((y - L.by) / L.cell);
   225	    if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= this.rows || c >= this.cols) return null;
   226	    return { r: r, c: c };
   227	  };
   228	
   229	  w.HF.Board = Board;
   230	})(window);

   212	  function drawBoard() {
   213	    /* frame */
   214	    g.fillStyle = '#0d131b';
   215	    g.fillRect(0, L.by - 20, L.W, L.H - (L.by - 20));
   216	    /* wall */
   217	    var wy = L.wallY;
   218	    g.fillStyle = '#3a4b63';
   219	    g.fillRect(0, wy, L.W, 10);
   220	    g.fillStyle = '#22304a';
   221	    for (var i = 0; i < COLS; i++) {
   222	      var x = L.bx + i * L.cell;
   223	      g.fillRect(x + 2, wy + 2, L.cell - 4, 6);
   224	      /* turret nub */
   225	      g.fillStyle = '#5b7595';
   226	      g.fillRect(x + L.cell / 2 - 4, wy - 7, 8, 8);
   227	      g.fillStyle = '#22304a';
   228	    }
   229	
   230	    var sw = board.sw;
   231	    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   232	      for (var c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   233	        var cellObj = board.grid[r][c];
   234	        var rect = board.cellRect(L, r, c);
   235	        var cx = rect.x + rect.s / 2, cy = rect.y + rect.s / 2 - cellObj.oy * L.cell;
   236	        var sc = 1;
   237	        if (cellObj.pop >= 0) sc = 1 - cellObj.pop;
   238	        if (sw) {
   239	          var p = HF.ease(HF.clamp(sw.t, 0, 1));
   240	          var dir = null;
   241	          if (sw.a.r === r && sw.a.c === c) dir = { dr: sw.b.r - r, dc: sw.b.c - c };
   242	          else if (sw.b.r === r && sw.b.c === c) dir = { dr: sw.a.r - r, dc: sw.a.c - c };
   243	          if (dir) { cx += dir.dc * L.cell * p; cy += dir.dr * L.cell * p; }
   244	        }
   245	        /* slot */
   246	        g.fillStyle = ((r + c) % 2) ? '#131c27' : '#16202d';
   247	        g.fillRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.s, rect.s);
   248	        if (sc <= 0.02) continue;
   249	        drawGem(cellObj.t, cx, cy, L.cell * 0.40 * sc);
   250	      }
   251	    }
   252	    /* selection / cursor */
   253	    if (cursor.sel) outline(cursor.sel.r, cursor.sel.c, '#ffd15c', 3);
   254	    if (IN.dragCell) outline(IN.dragCell.r, IN.dragCell.c, '#ffffff', 3);
   255	    if (IN.keyMode) outline(cursor.r, cursor.c, '#7fd8ff', 2);
   256	    /* board border */
   257	    g.strokeStyle = '#1e2a3a'; g.lineWidth = 2;
   258	    g.strokeRect(L.bx, L.by, L.bw, L.bh);
   259	  }
   260	  function outline(r, c, col, lw) {

   266	  function drawGem(t, x, y, r) {
   267	    g.fillStyle = GEM[t].c;
   268	    g.beginPath();
   269	    if (t === 0) { g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); }
   270	    else if (t === 1) { g.moveTo(x, y - r); g.lineTo(x + r, y); g.lineTo(x, y + r); g.lineTo(x - r, y); g.closePath(); }
   271	    else if (t === 2) {
   272	      var q = r * 0.42;
   273	      g.rect(x - q, y - r, q * 2, r * 2); g.rect(x - r, y - q, r * 2, q * 2);
   274	    } else if (t === 3) { g.rect(x - r * 0.82, y - r * 0.82, r * 1.64, r * 1.64); }
   275	    else { g.moveTo(x, y - r); g.lineTo(x + r * 0.92, y + r * 0.72); g.lineTo(x - r * 0.92, y + r * 0.72); g.closePath(); }
   276	    g.fill();
   277	    g.globalAlpha = 0.3; g.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
   278	    g.fillRect(x - r * 0.5, y - r * 0.72, r * 0.5, r * 0.28);
   279	    g.globalAlpha = 1;
   280	  }

   412	  function frame(ts) {
   413	    w.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   414	    var dt = (ts - lastT) / 1000; lastT = ts;
   415	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   416	    dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
   417	    if (!started) { return; }
   418	    if (rotated || paused || d.hidden) { drawFrameOnly(); return; }
   419	    update(dt);
   420	    render();
   421	  }
   422	  function drawFrameOnly() { render(); }
   423	
   424	  function render() {
   425	    BTN.length = 0;
   426	    g.save();
   427	    if (shakeT > 0 || (state === 'fight' && battle.shake > 0)) {
   428	      var s = Math.max(shakeT, state === 'fight' ? battle.shake : 0);
   429	      g.translate(HF.rnd(-s, s) * 0.5, HF.rnd(-s, s) * 0.5);
   430	    }
   431	    g.fillStyle = '#0b0f14'; g.fillRect(-20, -20, L.W + 40, L.H + 40);
   432	    if (state === 'shop') drawShop();
   433	    else if (state === 'fight') drawFight();
   434	    else drawResult();
   435	    g.restore();
   436	  }

   438	  /* ---------- pointer input ---------- */
   439	  function pos(e) {
   440	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   441	    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   442	  }
   443	  function onDown(e) {
   444	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   445	    e.preventDefault();
   446	    var p = pos(e), id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   447	    IN.ptr[id] = { x: p.x, y: p.y };
   448	    var b = hitBtn(p.x, p.y);
   449	    if (b) { IN.btnDown = b.id; IN.btnPtr = id; return; }
   450	    if (state === 'fight' && board.state === 'idle' && IN.dragId === null) {
   451	      var cell = board.hitCell(L, p.x, p.y);
   452	      if (cell) { IN.dragId = id; IN.dragCell = cell; IN.dragX = p.x; IN.dragY = p.y; IN.keyMode = false; }
   453	    }
   454	  }
   455	  function onMove(e) {
   456	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   457	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   458	    if (!IN.ptr[id]) return;
   459	    e.preventDefault();
   460	    var p = pos(e);
   461	    IN.ptr[id].x = p.x; IN.ptr[id].y = p.y;
   462	    if (IN.dragId === id && IN.dragCell) {
   463	      var dx = p.x - IN.dragX, dy = p.y - IN.dragY;
   464	      var th = Math.max(14, L.cell * 0.38);
   465	      if (Math.abs(dx) > th || Math.abs(dy) > th) {
   466	        var r2 = IN.dragCell.r, c2 = IN.dragCell.c;
   467	        if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) c2 += dx > 0 ? 1 : -1; else r2 += dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
   468	        board.trySwap(IN.dragCell.r, IN.dragCell.c, r2, c2);
   469	        IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null;
   470	      }
   471	    }
   472	  }
   473	  function onUp(e) {
   474	    if (!started) return;
   475	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   476	    var p = IN.ptr[id] ? { x: IN.ptr[id].x, y: IN.ptr[id].y } : null;
   477	    delete IN.ptr[id];
   478	    if (IN.dragId === id) { IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null; }
   479	    if (IN.btnDown && IN.btnPtr === id) {
   480	      var wasDown = IN.btnDown; IN.btnDown = null; IN.btnPtr = null;
   481	      if (p && !rotated) {
   482	        var b = hitBtn(p.x, p.y);
   483	        if (b && b.id === wasDown) activate(b.id);
   484	      }
   485	    }
   486	  }
   487	  function onCancel(e) {
   488	    var id = (e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId);
   489	    delete IN.ptr[id];
   490	    if (IN.dragId === id) { IN.dragId = null; IN.dragCell = null; }
   491	    if (IN.btnPtr === id) { IN.btnDown = null; IN.btnPtr = null; }
   492	  }
   493	
   494	  function activate(id) {
   495	    if (id === 'mute') { HF.audio.toggle(); return; }
   496	    if (id === 'fight') {
   497	      if (save.fight > MAXFIGHT) { newRun(); return; }
   498	      startFight(); return;
   499	    }
   500	    if (id === 'retry') { startFight(); return; }
   501	    if (id === 'shop') { toShop(); return; }
   502	    if (id === 'newrun') { newRun(); return; }
   503	    if (id.indexOf('buy') === 0) { buy(parseInt(id.slice(3), 10) || 0); return; }
   504	  }
   505	
   506	  /* ---------- keyboard ---------- */
   507	  function onKey(e) {
   508	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   509	    var k = e.key;
   510	    if (IN.keys[k]) { if (k === ' ') e.preventDefault(); }
   511	    IN.keys[k] = 1;
   512	    if (state === 'fight') {
   513	      IN.keyMode = true;
   514	      var dr = 0, dc = 0;
   515	      if (k === 'ArrowLeft') dc = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowRight') dc = 1;
   516	      else if (k === 'ArrowUp') dr = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowDown') dr = 1;
   517	      if (dr || dc) {
   518	        e.preventDefault();
   519	        if (cursor.sel) {
   520	          board.trySwap(cursor.sel.r, cursor.sel.c, cursor.sel.r + dr, cursor.sel.c + dc);
--- hive game 520-760
   520	          board.trySwap(cursor.sel.r, cursor.sel.c, cursor.sel.r + dr, cursor.sel.c + dc);
   521	          cursor.r = HF.clamp(cursor.sel.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   522	          cursor.c = HF.clamp(cursor.sel.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   523	          cursor.sel = null;
   524	        } else {
   525	          cursor.r = HF.clamp(cursor.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   526	          cursor.c = HF.clamp(cursor.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   527	        }
   528	      } else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   529	        e.preventDefault();
   530	        cursor.sel = cursor.sel ? null : { r: cursor.r, c: cursor.c };
   531	      } else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { startFight(); }
   532	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { HF.audio.toggle(); }
   533	      return;
   534	    }
   535	    if (state === 'shop') {
   536	      if (k === 'ArrowUp') { shopSel = (shopSel + 3) % 4; e.preventDefault(); }
   537	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown') { shopSel = (shopSel + 1) % 4; e.preventDefault(); }
   538	      else if (k === 'Enter') { buy(shopSel); }
   539	      else if (k === ' ' || k === 'f' || k === 'F') { e.preventDefault(); activate('fight'); }
   540	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { HF.audio.toggle(); }
   541	      return;
   542	    }
   543	    if (state === 'lost') {
   544	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'r' || k === 'R') { e.preventDefault(); startFight(); }
   545	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'u' || k === 'U') { toShop(); }
   546	      return;
   547	    }
   548	    if (state === 'won') {
   549	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); (save.fight > MAXFIGHT) ? newRun() : toShop(); }
   550	      return;
   551	    }
   552	  }
   553	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete IN.keys[e.key]; }
   554	
   555	  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
   556	  function boot() {
   557	    HF.audio.unlock();
   558	    bootEl.classList.remove('on');
   559	    started = true;
   560	    lastT = w.performance.now();
   561	    resetInput();
   562	    layout();
   563	    toShop();
   564	  }
   565	
   566	  d.getElementById('bootBtn').addEventListener('click', boot);
   567	  bootEl.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { if (e.target.id === 'bootBtn') { e.preventDefault(); boot(); } }, { passive: false });
   568	
   569	  var wrap = d.getElementById('wrap');
   570	  var hasPointer = !!w.PointerEvent;
   571	  if (hasPointer) {
   572	    wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, { passive: false });
   573	    wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, { passive: false });
   574	    w.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp, { passive: false });
   575	    w.addEventListener('pointercancel', onCancel, { passive: false });
   576	  } else {
   577	    wrap.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
   578	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   579	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   580	        onDown({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY, preventDefault: function () { e.preventDefault(); } });
   581	      }
   582	    }, { passive: false });
   583	    wrap.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
   584	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   585	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   586	        onMove({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY, preventDefault: function () { e.preventDefault(); } });
   587	      }
   588	    }, { passive: false });
   589	    wrap.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
   590	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
   591	        var t = e.changedTouches[i];
   592	        onUp({ pointerId: t.identifier, clientX: t.clientX, clientY: t.clientY });
   593	      }
   594	    }, { passive: false });
   595	    wrap.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) {
   596	      for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) onCancel({ pointerId: e.changedTouches[i].identifier });
   597	    }, { passive: false });
   598	    wrap.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
   599	    wrap.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
   600	    w.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
   601	  }
   602	  wrap.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   603	  d.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   604	  w.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
   605	  w.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
   606	  w.addEventListener('blur', function () { resetInput(); });
   607	  d.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
   608	    resetInput();
   609	    if (!d.hidden) lastT = w.performance.now();
   610	  });
   611	  w.addEventListener('resize', function () { layout(); resetInput(); });
   612	  w.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { HF.after(layout, 60); resetInput(); });
   613	
   614	  layout();
   615	  w.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   616	})(window);

   181	  function findLineMatches() {
   182	    const out = new Set();
   183	    for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) for (let c = 0; c < W;) {
   184	      const color = board[cellIndex(r, c)], start = c; while (c < W && board[cellIndex(r, c)] === color) c++;
   185	      if (color && c - start >= 3) for (let x = start; x < c; x++) out.add(cellIndex(r, x));
   186	    }
   187	    for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) for (let r = 0; r < H;) {
   188	      const color = board[cellIndex(r, c)], start = r; while (r < H && board[cellIndex(r, c)] === color) r++;
   189	      if (color && r - start >= 3) for (let y = start; y < r; y++) out.add(cellIndex(y, c));
   190	    }
   191	    return out;

   193	  function refill(matches) {
   194	    for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) {

   196	      for (let r = H - 1; r >= 0; r--) if (!matches.has(cellIndex(r, c))) keep.push(board[cellIndex(r, c)]);
   197	      for (let r = H - 1, k = 0; r >= 0; r--, k++) board[cellIndex(r, c)] = k < keep.length ? keep[k] : ORB_COLORS[rand(ORB_COLORS.length)];
   198	    }
   199	  }

   230	  function enemyAttack(active) {

   253	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   254	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   255	      if (particles.length >= MAX_PARTICLES) particles.shift();
   256	      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = 20 + Math.random() * 100;
   257	      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s, life: .35 + Math.random() * .55, max: .9, color, size: 2 + Math.random() * 4 });
   258	    }
   259	  }

   260	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   261	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = particles[i]; p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= .97; p.vy = p.vy * .97 + 35 * dt; if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1); }
   262	    for (let i = floatTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const t = floatTexts[i]; t.life -= dt; t.y -= 24 * dt; if (t.life <= 0) floatTexts.splice(i, 1); }
   263	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 24); flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
   264	    if (toastTimer > 0) toastTimer -= dt;
   265	  }
   266	  function update(dt) {

   136	  function queueAction(action) {
   137	    if (actionQueue.length < MAX_QUEUE) actionQueue.push(action);

   140	  function isLandscape() {
   141	    return viewW > viewH * 1.04;
   142	  }
   143	
   144	  function resizeCanvas() {
   145	    const wasBlocked = orientationBlocked;
   146	    viewW = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   147	    viewH = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   148	    const rawDpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   149	    const longAxis = Math.max(viewW, viewH) * rawDpr;
   150	    dpr = longAxis > 960 ? rawDpr * (960 / longAxis) : rawDpr;
   151	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(viewW * dpr));
   152	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(viewH * dpr));
   153	    scale = Math.min(viewW / W, viewH / H);
   154	    offsetX = (viewW - W * scale) / 2;
   155	    offsetY = (viewH - H * scale) / 2;
   156	    orientationBlocked = isLandscape();
   157	    if (orientationBlocked !== wasBlocked) resetInput();
   158	  }

   160	  function hashSeed(value) {
   161	    let h = 2166136261;
   162	    const text = String(value);
   163	    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
   164	      h ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
   165	      h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
   166	    }
   167	    return h >>> 0;
   168	  }
   169	
   170	  function seeded(seed) {
   171	    let n = hashSeed(seed) || 1;
   172	    return () => {
   173	      n += 0x6D2B79F5;
   174	      let t = n;
   175	      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
   176	      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
   177	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
   178	    };
   179	  }
   180	
   181	  function clamp(value, min, max) {
   182	    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
   183	  }

   185	  function createBirdName() {
   186	    const first = ['Aster', 'Brindle', 'Cinder', 'Dapple', 'Fable', 'Hush', 'Kestrel', 'Lumen', 'Mica', 'Nettle'];
   187	    const second = ['Vale', 'Quill', 'Crown', 'Drift', 'Loam', 'Gleam', 'Rook', 'Thimble', 'Skylark', 'Briar'];
   188	    const rng = seeded(save.runs + 19);
   189	    return first[Math.floor(rng() * first.length)] + ' ' + second[Math.floor(rng() * second.length)];
   190	  }

   233	  function unlockAudio() {
   234	    if (!audio) {
   235	      try {
   236	        const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   237	        if (AudioContextClass) audio = new AudioContextClass();
   238	      } catch (_) { audio = null; }
   239	    }
   240	    if (audio && audio.state === 'suspended') audio.resume().catch(() => {});
   241	  }
   242	
   243	  function beep(frequency, duration, type) {
   244	    if (!audio) return;
   245	    try {
   246	      const now = audio.currentTime;
   247	      const osc = audio.createOscillator();
   248	      const gain = audio.createGain();
   249	      osc.type = type || 'triangle';
   250	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   251	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
   252	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.045, now + 0.01);
   253	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
   254	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audio.destination);
   255	      osc.start(now);
   256	      osc.stop(now + duration + 0.02);
   257	    } catch (_) { /* Audio is decorative. */ }
   258	  }

   260	  function mentorBonus(stat) {
   261	    if (!state) return 0;
   262	    return state.mentors.reduce((total, id) => {
   263	      const mentor = MENTORS.find(item => item.id === id);
   264	      return total + (mentor && mentor.stat === stat ? mentor.train : 0);
   265	    }, 0);
   266	  }

   268	  function raceAnchor() {
   269	    return state.mentors.reduce((total, id) => {
   270	      const mentor = MENTORS.find(item => item.id === id);
   271	      return total + (mentor ? mentor.race : 0);
   272	    }, 0);
   273	  }

   279	  function applyTraining(id, bold) {
   280	    const card = trainingCard(id);
### game 280-620
   280	    const card = trainingCard(id);
   281	    const gain = (bold ? card.bold : card.base) + mentorBonus(id);
   282	    const fatigue = bold ? card.boldFatigue : card.safeFatigue;
   283	    state.stats[id] = clamp(state.stats[id] + gain, 0, 40);
   284	    state.stats.fatigue = clamp(state.stats.fatigue + fatigue, 0, 20);
   285	    state.turn = Math.min(2, state.turn + 1);
   286	    state.hint = bold
   287	      ? `${card.label}: +${gain} ${id}, +${fatigue} fatigue. Big wings, thin margin.`
   288	      : `${card.label}: +${gain} ${id}, +${fatigue} fatigue. Steady work compounds.`;
   289	    flash = 0.22;
   290	    shake = 0.08;
   291	    burst(170 + Math.random() * 50, 250, card.color, 10);
   292	    beep(bold ? 520 : 420, 0.09, bold ? 'square' : 'triangle');
   293	    state.selectedTraining = null;
   294	    state.screen = 'prep';
   295	  }

   297	  function applyRest(deep) {
   298	    const fatigue = deep ? 7 : 3;
   299	    const stamina = deep ? 1 : 0;
   300	    const focus = deep ? 0 : 1;
   301	    state.stats.fatigue = clamp(state.stats.fatigue - fatigue, 0, 20);
   302	    state.stats.stamina = clamp(state.stats.stamina + stamina, 0, 40);
   303	    state.stats.focus = clamp(state.stats.focus + focus, 0, 40);
   304	    state.turn = Math.min(2, state.turn + 1);
   305	    state.hint = deep
   306	      ? `Deep rest: -${fatigue} fatigue, +${stamina} stamina. The safest route to race day.`
   307	      : `Light rest: -${fatigue} fatigue, +${focus} focus. Keep the mind bright.`;
   308	    flash = 0.16;
   309	    burst(250, 228, COLORS.cyan, 8);
   310	    beep(deep ? 280 : 340, 0.1, 'sine');
   311	    state.screen = 'prep';
   312	  }

   325	  function paceModifier(strategy) {
   326	    if (strategy === 'front') return state.stats.speed * 0.16 - state.stats.stamina * 0.04;
   327	    if (strategy === 'stalk') return state.stats.stamina * 0.14 + state.stats.focus * 0.12;
   328	    return state.stats.wing * 0.1 + state.stats.focus * 0.18;
   329	  }
   330	
   331	  function playerPower(strategy) {
   332	    const s = state.stats;
   333	    const base = s.speed * 2 + s.stamina * 1.25 + s.wing * 0.85 + s.focus * 0.65;
   334	    const fatiguePenalty = s.fatigue * 1.4;
   335	    return base - fatiguePenalty + paceModifier(strategy) + raceAnchor() + state.season * 2;
   336	  }

   338	  function enterRace(strategy) {
   339	    const rng = seeded(`${save.runs}:${state.season}:field`);
   340	    const rivalScores = [];
   341	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   342	      rivalScores.push(49 + state.season * 4 + Math.round(rng() * 13) + i * 0.12);
   343	    }
   344	    const player = {
   345	      name:state.birdName,
   346	      score:playerPower(strategy),
   347	      player:true,
   348	      color:COLORS.lime,
   349	      progress:0,
   350	      lane:2
   351	    };
   352	    const rivals = rivalScores.map((score, index) => ({
   353	      name:FIELD_NAMES[index],
   354	      score,
   355	      player:false,
   356	      color:FIELD_COLORS[index],
   357	      progress:0,
   358	      lane:index < 2 ? index : index + 1
   359	    }));
   360	    state.race = {
   361	      strategy,
   362	      t:0,
   363	      duration:4.6,
   364	      cheers:0,
   365	      field:[...rivals.slice(0, 2), player, ...rivals.slice(2)],
   366	      rivals,
   367	      seed:`${save.runs}:${state.season}:field`
   368	    };
   369	    state.screen = 'race';
   370	    flash = 0.2;
   371	    beep(strategy === 'front' ? 620 : strategy === 'stalk' ? 480 : 390, 0.13, 'triangle');
   372	  }

   374	  function cheer() {
   375	    if (!state || state.screen !== 'race' || !state.race) return;
   376	    if (state.race.cheers >= 12) return;
   377	    state.race.cheers++;
   378	    const x = 58 + state.race.cheers * 22;
   379	    burst(x, 560, COLORS.orange, 9);
   380	    shake = 0.14;
   381	    beep(540 + state.race.cheers * 18, 0.06, 'square');
   382	  }

   384	  function finishRace() {
   385	    const race = state.race;
   386	    if (!race) return;
   387	    const cheerBonus = Math.min(8, race.cheers * 0.6);
   388	    const ranked = [
   389	      { name:state.birdName, score:playerPower(race.strategy) + cheerBonus, player:true, color:COLORS.lime },
   390	      ...race.rivals.map(rival => ({ ...rival }))
   391	    ].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
   392	    const place = ranked.findIndex(bird => bird.player) + 1;
   393	    const points = Math.max(8, 72 - (place - 1) * 12) + (place === 1 ? 18 : 0) + state.season * 4;
   394	    state.careerScore += points;
   395	    state.stats.fatigue = clamp(state.stats.fatigue - 3, 0, 20);
   396	    state.lastRace = {
   397	      season:state.season,
   398	      strategy:race.strategy,
   399	      place,
   400	      points,
   401	      cheerBonus,
   402	      ranked:ranked.slice(0, 6)
   403	    };
   404	    state.raceHistory.push({ season:state.season, place, points });
   405	    if (state.raceHistory.length > MAX_HISTORY) state.raceHistory.splice(0, state.raceHistory.length - MAX_HISTORY);
   406	    state.race = null;
   407	    flash = place === 1 ? 0.65 : 0.25;
   408	    shake = place === 1 ? 0.3 : 0.12;
   409	    beep(place === 1 ? 740 : 220, place === 1 ? 0.3 : 0.16, place === 1 ? 'triangle' : 'sawtooth');
   410	    if (state.season === 3) {
   411	      state.won = place === 1;
   412	      state.finalScore = state.careerScore + Math.round(state.stats.speed + state.stats.stamina + state.stats.wing + state.stats.focus);
   413	      if (state.finalScore > save.best) {
   414	        save.best = state.finalScore;
   415	        writeSave();
   416	      }
   417	      state.screen = 'final';
   418	      if (state.won) burst(195, 300, COLORS.lime, 36);
   419	      return;
   420	    }
   421	    const mentor = MENTORS.find(item => !state.mentors.includes(item.id));
   422	    state.pendingMentor = place === 1 ? mentor || null : null;
   423	    state.screen = state.pendingMentor ? 'mentor' : 'summary';
   424	  }

   426	  function chooseMentor() {
   427	    if (!state.pendingMentor) return advanceSeason();
   428	    state.mentors.push(state.pendingMentor.id);
   429	    if (state.mentors.length > MENTORS.length) state.mentors.splice(0, state.mentors.length - MENTORS.length);
   430	    state.hint = `${state.pendingMentor.name} is active. This buff is earned, permanent, and shown in the math.`;
   431	    state.pendingMentor = null;
   432	    state.screen = 'summary';
   433	    burst(195, 250, COLORS.cyan, 18);
   434	    beep(660, 0.18, 'triangle');
   435	  }

   439	    state.season++;
   440	    state.turn = 0;
   441	    state.screen = 'prep';
   442	    state.hint = `Season ${state.season}: two prep turns, then choose your pace for the race.`;
   443	    state.lastRace = state.lastRace;
   444	    flash = 0.24;
   445	  }

   449	    const bonus = {
   450	      speed:clamp(Math.floor(s.speed * 0.18), 1, 7),
   451	      stamina:clamp(Math.floor(s.stamina * 0.18), 1, 7),
   452	      wing:clamp(Math.floor(s.wing * 0.18), 1, 7),
   453	      focus:clamp(Math.floor(s.focus * 0.18), 1, 7)
   454	    };
   455	    save.legacy = { name:state.birdName, bonus, score:state.finalScore };
   456	    writeSave();
   457	    state.screen = 'legacy';

   459	    burst(195, 320, COLORS.pink, 28);

   461	  }

   484	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   485	    setFont(size, weight);
   486	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.text;
   487	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   488	    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   489	    ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   490	  }
   491	
   492	  function wrap(value, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, size, color, weight) {
   493	    setFont(size, weight);
   494	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.text;
   495	    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   496	    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   497	    const words = String(value).split(' ');
   498	    let line = '';
   499	    let row = 0;
   500	    for (const word of words) {
   501	      const test = line ? `${line} ${word}` : word;
   502	      if (ctx.measureText(test).width > maxWidth && line) {
   503	        ctx.fillText(line, x, y + row * lineHeight);
   504	        line = word;
   505	        row++;
   506	      } else line = test;
   507	    }
   508	    if (line) ctx.fillText(line, x, y + row * lineHeight);
   509	    return row + 1;
   510	  }
   511	
   512	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lineWidth) {
   513	    ctx.beginPath();
   514	    if (typeof ctx.roundRect === 'function') {
   515	      ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
   516	    } else {
   517	      const radius = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   518	      ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
   519	      ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
   520	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius);
   521	      ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
   522	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h);
   523	      ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
   524	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius);
   525	      ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
   526	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
   527	      ctx.closePath();
   528	    }
   529	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   530	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   531	  }

   536	    ctx.beginPath();
   537	    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
   538	    ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
   539	    ctx.stroke();
   540	  }

   877	  function draw() {
   878	    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   879	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.ink;
   880	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewW, viewH);
   881	    ctx.setTransform(dpr * scale, 0, 0, dpr * scale, dpr * offsetX, dpr * offsetY);
   882	    drawBackground();
   883	    hitAreas = [];
   884	    if (!state) drawStart();
   885	    else if (state.screen === 'prep') drawPrep();
   886	    else if (state.screen === 'decision') drawDecision();
   887	    else if (state.screen === 'rest') drawRest();
   888	    else if (state.screen === 'strategy') drawStrategy();
   889	    else if (state.screen === 'race') drawRace();
   890	    else if (state.screen === 'summary') drawSummary();
   891	    else if (state.screen === 'mentor') drawMentor();
   892	    else if (state.screen === 'final') drawFinal();
   893	    else if (state.screen === 'legacy') drawLegacy();
   894	    drawParticles();
   895	    if (flash > 0) {
   896	      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${clamp(flash * 0.13, 0, 0.14)})`;
   897	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   898	    }
   899	    if (orientationBlocked) drawOrientationOverlay();
   900	    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   901	  }
   902	
   903	  function burst(x, y, color, count) {
   904	    const amount = Math.min(count || 8, MAX_PARTICLES - particles.length);
   905	    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
   906	      const angle = Math.random() * TAU;
   907	      const speed = 20 + Math.random() * 80;
   908	      particles.push({ x, y, vx:Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy:Math.sin(angle) * speed - 30, life:0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5, max:1, color, size:2 + Math.random() * 3 });
   909	    }
   910	  }
   911	
   912	  function drawParticles() {
   913	    for (const particle of particles) {
   914	      ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(particle.life / particle.max, 0, 1);
   915	      ctx.fillStyle = particle.color;
   916	      ctx.fillRect(particle.x, particle.y, particle.size, particle.size);
   917	    }
   918	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   919	  }
   920	
### game 920-1060
   920	
   921	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   922	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   923	      const p = particles[i];
   924	      p.life -= dt;
   925	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   926	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   927	      p.vy += 80 * dt;
   928	      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
   929	    }
   930	    if (particles.length > MAX_PARTICLES) particles.splice(0, particles.length - MAX_PARTICLES);
   931	  }
   932	
   933	  function update(dt) {
   934	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
   935	    updateParticles(dt);
   936	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt);
   937	    flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt);
   938	    if (actionQueue.length) {
   939	      const action = actionQueue.shift();
   940	      if (typeof action === 'function') action();
   941	    }
   942	    if (!state) return;
   943	    if (state.screen === 'race' && state.race) {
   944	      state.race.t += dt;
   945	      if (state.race.t >= state.race.duration) finishRace();
   946	    }
   947	  }

   949	  function canvasPoint(event) {
   950	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   951	    return { x:(event.clientX - rect.left - offsetX) / scale, y:(event.clientY - rect.top - offsetY) / scale };
   952	  }
   953	
   954	  function controlAt(point) {
   955	    for (let i = hitAreas.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   956	      const area = hitAreas[i];
   957	      if (point.x >= area.x && point.x <= area.x + area.w && point.y >= area.y && point.y <= area.y + area.h) return area;
   958	    }
   959	    return null;
   960	  }
   961	
   962	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   963	    event.preventDefault();
   964	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
   965	    unlockAudio();
   966	    const point = canvasPoint(event);
   967	    const area = controlAt(point);
   968	    if (!area || controlPointers[area.id] != null) return;
   969	    controlPointers[area.id] = event.pointerId;
   970	    activePointers.set(event.pointerId, area.id);
   971	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   972	    queueAction(area.action);
   973	  }
   974	
   975	  function releasePointer(event) {
   976	    const areaId = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   977	    if (!areaId) return;
   978	    if (controlPointers[areaId] === event.pointerId) delete controlPointers[areaId];
   979	    activePointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   980	  }
   981	
   982	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   983	    if ([' ', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight'].includes(event.key)) event.preventDefault();
   984	    if (keys.has(event.key)) return;
   985	    keys.add(event.key);
   986	    if (orientationBlocked) return;
   987	    unlockAudio();
   988	    if (!state) {
   989	      if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') queueAction(begin);
   990	      return;
   991	    }
   992	    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
   993	    if (state.screen === 'prep') {
   994	      if (['1','2','3','4'].includes(event.key)) queueAction(() => trainingDecision(TRAINING[Number(event.key) - 1].id));
   995	      else if (event.key === '5') queueAction(openRest);
   996	      else if (key === 'r' || event.key === 'Enter') queueAction(() => { state.screen = 'strategy'; });
   997	    } else if (state.screen === 'decision') {
   998	      if (event.key === '1') queueAction(() => applyTraining(state.selectedTraining, false));
   999	      else if (event.key === '2') queueAction(() => applyTraining(state.selectedTraining, true));
  1000	      else if (event.key === 'Escape') queueAction(() => { state.screen = 'prep'; });
  1001	    } else if (state.screen === 'rest') {
  1002	      if (event.key === '1') queueAction(() => applyRest(true));
  1003	      else if (event.key === '2') queueAction(() => applyRest(false));
  1004	      else if (event.key === 'Escape') queueAction(() => { state.screen = 'prep'; });
  1005	    } else if (state.screen === 'strategy') {
  1006	      if (event.key === '1') queueAction(() => enterRace('front'));
  1007	      else if (event.key === '2') queueAction(() => enterRace('stalk'));
  1008	      else if (event.key === '3') queueAction(() => enterRace('close'));
  1009	      else if (event.key === 'Escape') queueAction(() => { state.screen = 'prep'; });
  1010	    } else if (state.screen === 'race') {
  1011	      if (event.key === ' ' || key === 'c') queueAction(cheer);
  1012	    } else if (state.screen === 'summary') {
  1013	      if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') queueAction(advanceSeason);
  1014	    } else if (state.screen === 'mentor') {
  1015	      if (event.key === '1' || event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') queueAction(chooseMentor);
  1016	    } else if (state.screen === 'final') {
  1017	      if (event.key === '1') queueAction(retireBird);
  1018	      else if (event.key === '2' || event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') queueAction(newCareer);
  1019	    } else if (state.screen === 'legacy') {
  1020	      if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') queueAction(newCareer);
  1021	    }
  1022	  }
