   484	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   485	    setFont(size, weight);
   486	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.text;
   487	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   488	    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   489	    ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   490	  }
   491	
   492	  function wrap(value, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, size, color, weight) {
   493	    setFont(size, weight);
   494	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.text;
   495	    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   496	    ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
   497	    const words = String(value).split(' ');
   498	    let line = '';
   499	    let row = 0;
   500	    for (const word of words) {
   501	      const test = line ? `${line} ${word}` : word;
   502	      if (ctx.measureText(test).width > maxWidth && line) {
   503	        ctx.fillText(line, x, y + row * lineHeight);
   504	        line = word;
   505	        row++;
   506	      } else line = test;
   507	    }
   508	    if (line) ctx.fillText(line, x, y + row * lineHeight);
   509	    return row + 1;
   510	  }

   512	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lineWidth) {
   513	    ctx.beginPath();
   514	    if (typeof ctx.roundRect === 'function') {
   515	      ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r);
   516	    } else {
   517	      const radius = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   518	      ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
   519	      ctx.lineTo(x + w - radius, y);
   520	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + radius);
   521	      ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - radius);
   522	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - radius, y + h);
   523	      ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + h);
   524	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - radius);
   525	      ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius);
   526	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + radius, y);
   527	      ctx.closePath();
   528	    }
   529	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   530	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   531	  }

   175	    try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return { courts: 0, pets: 0, score: 0 }; }
   176	    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) return { courts: 0, pets: 0, score: 0 };
   177	    return {
   178	      courts: intIn(data.courts, 0, 3, 0),
   179	      pets: intIn(data.pets, 0, pets.length, 0),
   180	      score: intIn(data.score, 0, 9999999, 0)
   181	    };
   182	  }
   183	  function saveBest() {
   184	    game.best = {
   185	      courts: Math.max(game.best.courts, game.courtsBeaten),
   186	      pets: Math.max(game.best.pets, game.owned.length),
   187	      score: Math.max(game.best.score, Math.floor(game.score))
   188	    };
   189	    storageSet(SAVE_KEY + ':best', JSON.stringify(game.best));
   190	  }
   191	  function saveGame() {
   192	    saveBest();
   193	    const data = {
   194	      v: 1, act: game.act, mapCol: game.mapCol, mapLane: game.mapLane, score: Math.floor(game.score),
   195	      courtsBeaten: game.courtsBeaten, wildCursor: game.wildCursor, owned: game.owned.slice(0, pets.length),
   196	      activePet: game.activePet, luckyBonus: game.luckyBonus, rationBonus: game.rationBonus,
   197	      elapsed: Number.isFinite(game.elapsed) ? game.elapsed : 0,
   198	      hp: game.party.map(p => Math.round(p.hp))
   199	    };
   200	    storageSet(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
   201	  }
   202	  function loadGame() {
   203	    const raw = storageGet(SAVE_KEY);
   204	    if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) return false;
   205	    let data;
   206	    try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) { return false; }
   207	    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data) || data.v !== 1) return false;
   208	    const ids = Array.isArray(data.owned) ? data.owned.filter(id => typeof id === 'string' && !!petById(id)).slice(0, pets.length) : [];
   209	    game.act = intIn(data.act, 0, 2, 0);
   210	    game.mapCol = intIn(data.mapCol, 0, 4, 0);
   211	    game.mapLane = intIn(data.mapLane, 0, 2, 1);
   212	    game.score = intIn(data.score, 0, 9999999, 0);
   213	    game.courtsBeaten = intIn(data.courtsBeaten, 0, 3, game.act);
   214	    game.wildCursor = intIn(data.wildCursor, 0, 9999, 0);
   215	    game.owned = Array.from(new Set(ids));
   216	    game.activePet = typeof data.activePet === 'string' && game.owned.includes(data.activePet) ? data.activePet : (game.owned[0] || null);
   217	    game.luckyBonus = data.luckyBonus === true;
   218	    game.rationBonus = data.rationBonus === true;
   219	    game.elapsed = numIn(data.elapsed, 0, 864000, 0);
   220	    buildMap();
   221	    game.party = makeParty();
   222	    if (Array.isArray(data.hp)) data.hp.slice(0, game.party.length).forEach((hp, i) => { game.party[i].hp = numIn(hp, 0, game.party[i].maxHp, game.party[i].maxHp); });
   223	    game.runStart = performance.now() - game.elapsed * 1000;
   224	    game.orientationStarted = game.orientationBlocked ? performance.now() : 0;
   225	    game.screen = 'map';
   226	    setMessage(game.owned.length ? 'Your road remembers. Choose a glowing node.' : 'Choose a glowing road node.', 4);
   227	    return true;
   228	  }
   229	  function setMessage(text, seconds) { game.message = text; game.messageTimer = seconds || 3; }
   230	  function unlockAudio() {
   231	    if (!audioContext) {
   232	      try { audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (_) { audioContext = null; }
   233	    }
   234	    if (audioContext) { try { audioContext.resume(); } catch (_) {} }
   235	    audioUnlocked = true;
   236	    audioGate.hidden = true;
   237	    game.running = true;
   238	    if (!game.runStart) game.runStart = performance.now();
   239	    sound('start');
   240	  }
   241	  function sound(kind) {
   242	    if (!audioUnlocked || !audioContext) return;
   243	    const settings = { hit: [160, .07, 'square'], catch: [620, .16, 'sine'], heal: [390, .12, 'triangle'], start: [240, .16, 'triangle'], win: [520, .3, 'sine'], fail: [90, .18, 'sawtooth'] }[kind];
   244	    if (!settings) return;
   245	    try {
   246	      const osc = audioContext.createOscillator();
   247	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   248	      osc.type = settings[2]; osc.frequency.value = settings[0]; gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, audioContext.currentTime);
   249	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.045, audioContext.currentTime + .01);
   250	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, audioContext.currentTime + settings[1]);
   251	      osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audioContext.destination); osc.start(); osc.stop(audioContext.currentTime + settings[1] + .02);
   252	    } catch (_) {}
   253	  }
   254	  function resize() {
   255	    view.cssW = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   256	    view.cssH = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   257	    view.pixelScale = Math.min(2, 960 / Math.max(view.cssW, view.cssH));
   258	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.cssW * view.pixelScale));
   259	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.cssH * view.pixelScale));
   260	    view.fit = Math.min(view.cssW / W, view.cssH / H);
### game 260-520
   260	    view.fit = Math.min(view.cssW / W, view.cssH / H);
   261	    view.x = (view.cssW - W * view.fit) / 2;
   262	    view.y = (view.cssH - H * view.fit) / 2;

   264	  }
   265	  function updateOrientation() {
   266	    const blocked = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   267	    if (blocked && !game.orientationBlocked) game.orientationStarted = performance.now();
   268	    if (!blocked && game.orientationBlocked && game.orientationStarted) {
   269	      game.runStart += performance.now() - game.orientationStarted;
   270	      game.orientationStarted = 0;
   271	    }
   272	    game.orientationBlocked = blocked;
   273	    rotateCover.hidden = !blocked;
   274	  }
   275	  function rr(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke) {
   276	    ctx.beginPath();
   277	    const radius = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   278	    ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, radius); ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, radius); ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, radius); ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, radius); ctx.closePath();
   279	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   280	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   281	  }

   428	  function render() {
   429	    ctx.setTransform(view.pixelScale, 0, 0, view.pixelScale, 0, 0);
   430	    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1020'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.cssW, view.cssH);
   431	    const sx = game.shake ? (Math.random() - .5) * game.shake : 0;
   432	    const sy = game.shake ? (Math.random() - .5) * game.shake : 0;
   433	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(view.x + sx, view.y + sy); ctx.scale(view.fit, view.fit);
   434	    drawBackground();
   435	    if (game.screen === 'map') drawMap();
   436	    else if (game.screen === 'battle') drawBattle();
   437	    else if (game.screen === 'spring' || game.screen === 'merchant') drawUtility(game.screen);
   438	    else drawEnd(game.screen);
   439	    drawParticles(); drawTexts();
   440	    if (game.flash > 0) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(game.flash / .18, 0, .45); ctx.fillStyle = colors.cream; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
   441	    ctx.restore();
   442	  }
   443	  function drawParticles() {
   444	    for (const p of game.particles) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(p.life / p.max, 0, 1); ctx.fillStyle = p.color; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * (p.life / p.max), 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); }
   445	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   446	  }
   447	  function drawTexts() { for (const t of game.texts) { ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(t.life / t.max, 0, 1); text(t.value, t.x, t.y, t.size, t.color, 'center', 900); } ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
   448	  function spawnBurst(x, y, color, count) {
   449	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) pushCapped(game.particles, { x, y, vx: (Math.random() - .5) * 130, vy: (Math.random() - .5) * 130, size: 2 + Math.random() * 4, life: .45 + Math.random() * .35, max: .8, color }, MAX_PARTICLES);
   450	  }
   451	  function floatText(value, x, y, color) { pushCapped(game.texts, { value, x, y, size: 15, life: .8, max: .8, color }, MAX_TEXTS); }
   452	  function update(dt) {
   453	    if (!game.running || game.orientationBlocked) return;
   454	    if (game.screen !== 'win' && game.screen !== 'wipe') game.elapsed = (performance.now() - game.runStart) / 1000;
   455	    game.messageTimer = Math.max(0, game.messageTimer - dt);
   456	    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 28);
   457	    game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt);
   458	    for (let i = game.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = game.particles[i]; p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 80 * dt; if (p.life <= 0) game.particles.splice(i, 1); }

   613	  function pointFromEvent(e) {

   617	  function controlAt(p) {

   619	    if (game.screen === 'map') {

   622	    } else if (game.screen === 'battle') {
   623	      if (p.y >= 494 && p.y <= 546) return p.x < 195 ? 'attack' : 'art';
   624	      if (p.y >= 554 && p.y <= 610) return p.x < 195 ? 'defend' : 'catch';
   625	      if (p.y >= 278 && p.y <= 425) for (let i = 0; i < game.party.length; i++) { const x = 42 + i * 85; if (p.x >= x && p.x <= x + 76) return `row-${i}`; }

   640	  function queueControl(control) {
   641	    if (!control) return;
   642	    if (control.startsWith('node-')) mapAction('node', Number(control.slice(5)));
   643	    else if (control.startsWith('row-')) mapAction('row', Number(control.slice(4)));
   644	    else input.queuedAction = { type: control };
   645	  }
   646	  function pointerDown(e) {
   647	    e.preventDefault(); const control = controlAt(pointFromEvent(e)); if (!control) return;
   648	    if (input.pointers.size >= 16) return;
   649	    if (input.controlPointers.has(control)) return;
   650	    input.pointers.set(e.pointerId, control); input.controlPointers.set(control, e.pointerId);
   651	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   652	  }
   653	  function pointerUp(e) {
   654	    e.preventDefault(); const control = input.pointers.get(e.pointerId); if (!control) return;
   655	    input.pointers.delete(e.pointerId); if (input.controlPointers.get(control) === e.pointerId) input.controlPointers.delete(control);
   656	    const now = controlAt(pointFromEvent(e)); if (now === control) queueControl(control);
   657	  }
   658	  function pointerCancel(e) {
   659	    e.preventDefault(); const control = input.pointers.get(e.pointerId); input.pointers.delete(e.pointerId); if (control && input.controlPointers.get(control) === e.pointerId) input.controlPointers.delete(control);
   660	  }

   452	  function update(dt) {
   453	    if (!game.running || game.orientationBlocked) return;
   454	    if (game.screen !== 'win' && game.screen !== 'wipe') game.elapsed = (performance.now() - game.runStart) / 1000;
   455	    game.messageTimer = Math.max(0, game.messageTimer - dt);
   456	    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt * 28);
   457	    game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt);
   458	    for (let i = game.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = game.particles[i]; p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 80 * dt; if (p.life <= 0) game.particles.splice(i, 1); }
   459	    for (let i = game.texts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const t = game.texts[i]; t.life -= dt; t.y -= 22 * dt; if (t.life <= 0) game.texts.splice(i, 1); }
   460	    if (input.queuedAction) { const action = input.queuedAction; input.queuedAction = null; handleAction(action); }
   461	  }
   462	  function catchOdds() {
   463	    if (!game.battle || game.battle.kind !== 'wild') return 0;
   464	    const e = game.battle.enemy; const weakened = 1 - e.hp / e.maxHp;
   465	    return clamp(.06 + weakened * .72 + partyBonuses().catchOdds + (game.battle.lucky ? .1 : 0), .05, .94);
   466	  }
   467	  function mapAction(type, lane) { input.queuedAction = { type, lane }; }
   468	  function handleAction(action) {
   469	    if (!action) return;
   470	    if (action.type === 'new') { resetRun(); game.running = true; return; }
   471	    if (action.type === 'restart') { resetRun(); game.running = true; return; }
   472	    if (action.type === 'retry') { retryNode(); return; }
   473	    if (action.type === 'row') { toggleRow(action.index); return; }
   474	    if (action.type === 'node') { selectNode(action.lane); return; }
   475	    if (action.type === 'spring') { useSpring(); return; }
   476	    if (action.type === 'lucky' || action.type === 'ration') { takeGift(action.type); return; }
   477	    if (['attack', 'art', 'defend', 'catch'].includes(action.type)) { combatAction(action.type); return; }
   478	  }
   479	  function selectNode(lane) {
   480	    if (game.screen !== 'map' || lane < 0 || lane > 2 || game.mapCol >= 4) return;
   481	    const node = game.map.find(n => n.col === game.mapCol + 1 && n.lane === lane);
   482	    if (!node) return;
   483	    clearInput();
   484	    game.mapLane = lane; game.mapCol++;
   485	    spawnBurst(nodePos(game.mapCol, lane).x, nodePos(game.mapCol, lane).y, nodeColor(node.type), 16);
   486	    setMessage(`${typeName(node.type)}: ${node.type === 'fight' ? 'something stirs' : 'step closer'}.`, 2);
   487	    resolveNode(node.type);
   488	    saveGame();
   489	  }

   153	    if (!audio) return;
   154	    try {
   155	      const now = audio.currentTime;
   156	      const osc = audio.createOscillator();

   159	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, now);

   187	  function createEnemy(typeKey, x, y) {
   188	    if (enemies.length >= MAX_ENEMIES) return null;
   189	    const t = ENEMY_TYPES[typeKey];
   190	    if (!t) return null;
   191	    const enemy = { type: typeKey, x, y, hp: t.hp, maxHp: t.hp, nextAtk: .8 + Math.random(), flash: 0, dead: false, id: Math.random() };
   192	    enemies.push(enemy);
   193	    return enemy;
   194	  }
   195	
   196	  function randomSpawnPoint() {
   197	    const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
   198	    if (side === 0) return { x: 38 + Math.random() * 314, y: 190 + Math.random() * 42 };
   199	    if (side === 1) return { x: 38 + Math.random() * 314, y: 470 + Math.random() * 40 };
   200	    if (side === 2) return { x: 28 + Math.random() * 44, y: 212 + Math.random() * 240 };
   201	    return { x: 318 + Math.random() * 44, y: 212 + Math.random() * 240 };
   202	  }
   203	
   204	  function spawnPack(count) {
   205	    const field = state.field;
   206	    const typePool = field === 0 ? ['thornling', 'thornling', 'mireling'] : ['cinderkin', 'ashwing', 'cinderkin'];
   207	    const open = enemies.filter(e => !ENEMY_TYPES[e.type].boss && !e.dead).length;
   208	    const amount = Math.min(count, 14 - open, MAX_ENEMIES - enemies.length);
   209	    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
   210	      const p = randomSpawnPoint();
   211	      createEnemy(typePool[Math.floor(Math.random() * typePool.length)], p.x, p.y);
   212	    }
   213	    if (!save.bossDown[field] && !enemies.some(e => ENEMY_TYPES[e.type].boss)) createEnemy(field === 0 ? 'boss0' : 'boss1', 195, 225);
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  function currentBoss() { return enemies.find(e => ENEMY_TYPES[e.type].boss && !e.dead) || null; }
   217	  function allGearPlus9() { return Object.values(validGear(save.gear)).every(level => level >= 9); }
   218	  function playerPower() { return 8 + save.gear.weapon * 3 + save.gear.ring * 2; }
   219	
   220	  function distance(a, b) { return Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y); }
   221	
   222	  function nearestEnemy(maxDistance = Infinity) {
   223	    let nearest = null, best = maxDistance;
   224	    for (const enemy of enemies) {
   225	      if (enemy.dead) continue;
   226	      const d = distance(state.player, enemy);
   227	      if (d < best) { best = d; nearest = enemy; }
   228	    }
   229	    return nearest;
   230	  }
   231	
   232	  function queueAction(action) {
   233	    if (queuedActions.length >= MAX_ACTIONS) queuedActions.shift();
   234	    queuedActions.push(action);
   235	  }
   236	
   237	  function hitEnemy(enemy, damage, color = '#f2bd63') {
   238	    if (!enemy || enemy.dead) return;
   239	    const type = ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type];
   240	    if (type.boss && !allGearPlus9()) {
   241	      enemy.flash = .13;
   242	      addFloater('NEEDS +9 SET', enemy.x, enemy.y - 40, '#f2bd63');
   243	      beep(120, .08, 'square', .03);
   244	      return;
   245	    }
   246	    enemy.hp -= Math.max(1, damage);
   247	    enemy.flash = .16;
   248	    burst(enemy.x, enemy.y, color, type.boss ? 7 : 4, type.boss ? 48 : 32);
   249	    if (enemy.hp <= 0) defeatEnemy(enemy);
   250	  }
   251	
   252	  function defeatEnemy(enemy) {
   253	    if (!enemy || enemy.dead) return;
   254	    enemy.dead = true;
   255	    const type = ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type];
   256	    const gold = Math.floor(type.gold[0] + Math.random() * (type.gold[1] - type.gold[0] + 1));
   257	    save.gold = Math.min(999999, save.gold + gold);
   258	    save.kills = Math.min(999999, save.kills + 1);
   259	    save.best = Math.max(save.best, save.kills);
   260	    addFloater('+' + gold + 'g', enemy.x, enemy.y - 11, '#f2bd63');
   261	    burst(enemy.x, enemy.y, type.color, type.boss ? 32 : 12, type.boss ? 120 : 75);
   262	    beep(type.boss ? 92 : 240, type.boss ? .25 : .06, type.boss ? 'sawtooth' : 'triangle', type.boss ? .08 : .035);
   263	    if (type.boss) {
   264	      save.bossDown[state.field] = true;
   265	      save.best = Math.max(save.best, save.kills);
   266	      showToast(state.field === 0 ? 'ROOTCROWN FELLED' : 'CINDERMAW FELLED', 3);
   267	      persist();
   268	      if (save.bossDown[0] && save.bossDown[1] && allGearPlus9()) {
   269	        state.screen = 'mastery'; clearInputState();
   270	      }
   271	    } else {
   272	      const dropChance = .38 + Math.min(.18, save.gear.weapon * .02);
   273	      if (Math.random() < dropChance) grantDrop(type.drops[Math.floor(Math.random() * type.drops.length)]);
   274	      persist();
   275	    }
   276	  }
   277	
   278	  function grantDrop(item) {
   279	    const key = item.includes('VINE') ? 'weapon' : item.includes('BARK') ? 'armor' : 'ring';
   280	    save.drops[key] = Math.min(50, save.drops[key] + 1);
   281	    addFloater(item + ' DROP', state.player.x, state.player.y - 28, '#7ee0b2');
   282	    burst(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#7ee0b2', 9, 42);
   283	    beep(680, .1, 'sine', .04);
   284	  }
   285	
   286	  function useSkill(skill) {
   287	    if (state.screen !== 'play' || state.forgeOpen || state.enemySheet) return;
   288	    if (state.cooldowns[skill] > 0) return;
   289	    if (skill === 'skill1') {
   290	      const target = nearestEnemy(142);
   291	      if (!target) { showToast('MOVE INTO RANGE', 1); return; }
   292	      state.cooldowns.skill1 = 4.8;
   293	      for (const enemy of enemies) if (!enemy.dead && distance(state.player, enemy) < 124) hitEnemy(enemy, 20 + save.gear.weapon * 4, '#7ee0b2');
   294	      addParticle(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#7ee0b2', { life: .34, size: 42, ring: true });
   295	      addFloater('THORN ARC', state.player.x, state.player.y - 35, '#7ee0b2');
   296	      beep(510, .12, 'triangle', .05);
   297	    } else {
   298	      const target = nearestEnemy(168);
   299	      if (!target) { showToast('MOVE INTO RANGE', 1); return; }
   300	      state.cooldowns.skill2 = 8.5;
   301	      for (const enemy of enemies) if (!enemy.dead && distance(target, enemy) < 74) hitEnemy(enemy, 40 + save.gear.ring * 5, '#f2a35e');
   302	      burst(target.x, target.y, '#f2a35e', 24, 105);
   303	      addParticle(target.x, target.y, '#f2a35e', { life: .5, size: 54, ring: true });
   304	      addFloater('EMBER BURST', target.x, target.y - 38, '#f2a35e');
   305	      beep(230, .2, 'sawtooth', .045);
   306	    }
   307	  }
   308	
   309	  function basicAttack() {
   310	    const target = nearestEnemy(128);
   311	    if (!target) return;
   312	    autoClock = .72;
   313	    hitEnemy(target, playerPower(), '#f4f0e7');
   314	    addParticle((state.player.x + target.x) / 2, (state.player.y + target.y) / 2, '#f4f0e7', { life: .18, size: 12, ring: true });
   315	    beep(165 + Math.random() * 30, .035, 'triangle', .025);
   316	  }
   317	
   318	  function update(dt) {
   319	    if (!started || orientationLandscape || state.screen !== 'play' || state.forgeOpen || state.enemySheet) return;
   320	    dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, dt));
   321	    state.cooldowns.skill1 = Math.max(0, state.cooldowns.skill1 - dt);
   322	    state.cooldowns.skill2 = Math.max(0, state.cooldowns.skill2 - dt);
   323	    state.player.hitFlash = Math.max(0, state.player.hitFlash - dt);
   324	    toastClock = Math.max(0, toastClock - dt);
   325	    autoClock -= dt;
   326	    spawnClock -= dt;
   327	    state.bossTimers[state.field] = Math.max(0, state.bossTimers[state.field] - dt);
   328	
   329	    const moveX = (keys.has('d') ? 1 : 0) - (keys.has('a') ? 1 : 0) + stick.x;
   330	    const moveY = (keys.has('s') ? 1 : 0) - (keys.has('w') ? 1 : 0) + stick.y;
   331	    const len = Math.hypot(moveX, moveY) || 1;
   332	    const speed = 128;
   333	    if (moveX || moveY) {
   334	      state.player.x = Math.min(360, Math.max(30, state.player.x + (moveX / len) * speed * dt));
   335	      state.player.y = Math.min(520, Math.max(185, state.player.y + (moveY / len) * speed * dt));
   336	    }
   337	
   338	    if (controls.skill1 !== null || keys.has('j')) queueAction('skill1');
   339	    if (controls.skill2 !== null || keys.has('k')) queueAction('skill2');
   340	    if (queuedActions.length) useSkill(queuedActions.shift());
   341	    if (autoClock <= 0) basicAttack();
   342	
   343	    for (const enemy of enemies) {
   344	      if (enemy.dead) continue;
   345	      const t = ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type];
   346	      enemy.flash = Math.max(0, enemy.flash - dt);
   347	      enemy.nextAtk -= dt;
   348	      const dx = state.player.x - enemy.x, dy = state.player.y - enemy.y;
   349	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
   350	      const reach = t.radius + 17;
   351	      if (d > reach) {
   352	        enemy.x += (dx / d) * t.speed * dt;
   353	        enemy.y += (dy / d) * t.speed * dt;
   354	      } else if (enemy.nextAtk <= 0) {
   355	        enemy.nextAtk = t.boss ? 2.4 : 1.35 + Math.random() * .7;
   356	        state.player.hp = Math.max(0, state.player.hp - t.damage);
   357	        state.player.hitFlash = .2;
   358	        addFloater('-' + t.damage, state.player.x, state.player.y - 22, '#ff7b76');
   359	        burst(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#ff7b76', 4, 28);
   360	        beep(80, .06, 'square', .025);
   361	        if (state.player.hp <= 0) die();
   362	      }
   363	    }
   364	    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (enemies[i].dead) enemies.splice(i, 1);
   365	    if (spawnClock <= 0) { spawnClock = 2.7; spawnPack(2); }
   366	    updateCollections(dt);
   367	  }
   368	
   369	  function die() {
   370	    if (state.screen !== 'play') return;
   371	    state.screen = 'dead'; clearInputState(); clearTimers();
   372	    burst(state.player.x, state.player.y, '#ff7b76', 28, 100);
   373	    persist();
   374	  }
   375	
   376	  function respawn() {
   377	    clearTimers(); clearInputState();
   378	    save.gold = Math.max(0, save.gold - 10);
   379	    persist();
   380	    state.player = { x: 195, y: 360, hp: 100, maxHp: 100, hitFlash: 0 };
   381	    state.screen = 'play'; state.enemySheet = null; state.forgeOpen = false;
   382	    enemies.length = 0; particles.length = 0; floaters.length = 0;
   383	    state.bossTimers[state.field] = save.bossDown[state.field] ? 0 : 180;
   384	    spawnPack(10); showToast('FIELD RESPAWN · 10G', 2); beep(280, .1, 'sine', .04);
   385	  }
   386	
   387	  function switchField(index) {
   388	    if (index !== 0 && index !== 1 || state.field === index) return;
   389	    clearInputState(); state.field = index; state.enemySheet = null; state.forgeOpen = false;
   390	    enemies.length = 0; particles.length = 0; floaters.length = 0; state.bossTimers[index] = save.bossDown[index] ? 0 : 180;
   391	    spawnPack(10); showToast('ENTERED ' + FIELDS[index].name, 1.5); beep(380 + index * 100, .08, 'sine', .035);
   392	  }
   393	
   394	  function enhance() {
   395	    const key = state.selectedGear, level = save.gear[key], rate = ENHANCE_RATES[level];
   396	    if (level >= 9) { showToast('MAX TIER REACHED', 1.4); return; }
   397	    const cost = enhanceCost(level);
   398	    if (save.gold < cost) { showToast('NEED ' + cost + 'G', 1.4); beep(110, .08, 'square', .025); return; }
   399	    save.gold -= cost;
   400	    if (Math.random() < rate) {
   401	      save.gear[key] = level + 1; addFloater('+' + (level + 1) + ' ' + GEAR_LABELS[key], 195, 285, '#7ee0b2');
   402	      burst(195, 320, '#7ee0b2', 16, 75); beep(720, .15, 'sine', .055); showToast('ENHANCE SUCCESS · NO RISK', 1.7);
   403	    } else {
   404	      addFloater('FAILED · TIER SAFE', 195, 285, '#f2a35e'); burst(195, 320, '#f2a35e', 7, 40); beep(150, .1, 'square', .03); showToast('GOLD SPENT · TIER SAFE', 1.7);
   405	    }
   406	    persist();
   407	  }
   408	
   409	  function enhanceCost(level) { return 18 + level * 14; }
   410	
   411	  function updateCollections(dt) {
   412	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   413	      const p = particles[i]; p.life -= dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= .97; p.vy *= .97;
   414	      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
   415	    }
   416	    for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   417	      const f = floaters[i]; f.life -= dt; f.y -= 22 * dt;
   418	      if (f.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
   419	    }
   420	    if (particles.length > MAX_PARTICLES) particles.splice(0, particles.length - MAX_PARTICLES);
   421	    if (floaters.length > MAX_FLOATERS) floaters.splice(0, floaters.length - MAX_FLOATERS);
   422	    if (enemies.length > MAX_ENEMIES) enemies.splice(0, enemies.length - MAX_ENEMIES);
   423	  }

   425	  function resize() {
   426	    const cssW = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth), cssH = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   427	    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   428	    const pixelRatio = Math.min(dpr, 960 / Math.max(cssW, cssH));
   429	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssW * pixelRatio)); canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssH * pixelRatio));
   430	    layout = { cssW, cssH, scale: Math.min(cssW / W, cssH / H), ox: (cssW - W * Math.min(cssW / W, cssH / H)) / 2, oy: (cssH - H * Math.min(cssW / W, cssH / H)) / 2, pixelRatio };
   615	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); return { x: (clientX - rect.left - layout.ox) / layout.scale, y: (clientY - rect.top - layout.oy) / layout.scale };
   616	  }
   617	
   618	  function inRect(p, x, y, w, h) { return p.x >= x && p.x <= x + w && p.y >= y && p.y <= y + h; }
   619	  function controlAt(p) {
   620	    if (inRect(p, 208, 580, 83, 90)) return 'skill1';
   621	    if (inRect(p, 292, 580, 83, 90)) return 'skill2';
   622	    if (inRect(p, 18, 575, 125, 110)) return 'stick';
   623	    return null;
   624	  }
   625	
   626	  function updateStick(p) {
   627	    const dx = p.x - 78, dy = p.y - 630, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, max = 49;
   628	    const amount = Math.min(1, len / max); stick.x = (dx / len) * amount; stick.y = (dy / len) * amount;
   629	  }

   631	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   632	    event.preventDefault();
   633	    if (!started || orientationLandscape || pointers.size >= 8) return;
   634	    const p = toLogical(event.clientX, event.clientY);
   635	    if (state.screen === 'dead') {
   636	      if (inRect(p, 62, 410, 266, 58)) respawn();
   637	      return;
   638	    }
   639	    if (state.screen === 'mastery') {
   640	      if (inRect(p, 62, 465, 266, 58)) { resetRun(); showToast('THE FIELDS ARE OPEN AGAIN', 2); }
   641	      return;
   642	    }
   643	    if (state.enemySheet) { state.enemySheet = null; return; }
   644	    if (state.forgeOpen) {
   645	      if (inRect(p, 32, 240, 326, 46)) state.selectedGear = 'weapon';
   646	      else if (inRect(p, 32, 298, 326, 46)) state.selectedGear = 'armor';
   647	      else if (inRect(p, 32, 356, 326, 46)) state.selectedGear = 'ring';
   648	      else if (inRect(p, 32, 481, 326, 45)) enhance();
   649	      else if (inRect(p, 282, 40, 94, 48)) state.forgeOpen = false;
   650	      return;
   651	    }
   652	    if (inRect(p, 14, 40, 94, 48)) { switchField(0); return; }
   653	    if (inRect(p, 107, 40, 94, 48)) { switchField(1); return; }
   654	    if (inRect(p, 282, 40, 94, 48)) { state.forgeOpen = true; clearInputState(); return; }
   655	    const control = controlAt(p);
   656	    if (control) {
   657	      if (controls[control] !== null) return;
   658	      controls[control] = event.pointerId; pointers.set(event.pointerId, control);
   659	      try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (error) { /* optional */ }
   660	      if (control === 'stick') updateStick(p); else queueAction(control); return;
   661	    }
   662	    for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   663	      const enemy = enemies[i], t = ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type];
   664	      if (!enemy.dead && Math.hypot(p.x - enemy.x, p.y - enemy.y) <= t.radius + 18) { state.enemySheet = enemy; clearInputState(); return; }
   665	    }
   666	  }
   667	
   668	  function onPointerMove(event) {
   669	    if (!pointers.has(event.pointerId)) return;
   670	    event.preventDefault(); const control = pointers.get(event.pointerId); if (control === 'stick') updateStick(toLogical(event.clientX, event.clientY));
   671	  }
   672	
   673	  function releasePointer(pointerId) {
   674	    if (!pointers.has(pointerId)) return; const control = pointers.get(pointerId); pointers.delete(pointerId); if (controls[control] === pointerId) controls[control] = null; if (control === 'stick') stick.x = stick.y = 0;
   675	  }
   676	
   677	  function onPointerUp(event) { event.preventDefault(); releasePointer(event.pointerId); }
   678	
   679	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   680	    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
   681	    if (!['w', 'a', 's', 'd', 'j', 'k'].includes(key)) return;
   682	    event.preventDefault(); if (!started || orientationLandscape || state.screen !== 'play') return;
   683	    if (!event.repeat && (key === 'j' || key === 'k')) queueAction(key === 'j' ? 'skill1' : 'skill2'); keys.add(key);
   684	  }
   685	
   686	  function onKeyUp(event) { const key = event.key.toLowerCase(); if (['w', 'a', 's', 'd', 'j', 'k'].includes(key)) { event.preventDefault(); keys.delete(key); } }
   687	
   688	  function frame(now) { const dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastTime) / 1000)); lastTime = now; update(dt); render(); rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
   689	
   690	  enterButton.addEventListener('click', () => { unlockAudio(); started = true; audioGate.style.display = 'none'; resetRun(); lastTime = performance.now(); showToast('DRIFT INTO A PACK TO BEGIN', 2.8); });
   691	  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: false }); canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false }); canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp, { passive: false }); canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp, { passive: false });
   692	  window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp, { passive: false }); window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp, { passive: false }); window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, { passive: false }); window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp, { passive: false }); window.addEventListener('blur', clearInputState); window.addEventListener('resize', resize); window.addEventListener('orientationchange', resize);
   693	  resize(); resetRun(); render(); rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   694	})();

   247	    if (screen === 'party' && (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ')) handle('done');
   248	  }

   507	  function onKey(e) {
   508	    if (!started || rotated) return;
   509	    var k = e.key;
   510	    if (IN.keys[k]) { if (k === ' ') e.preventDefault(); }
   511	    IN.keys[k] = 1;
   512	    if (state === 'fight') {
   513	      IN.keyMode = true;
   514	      var dr = 0, dc = 0;
   515	      if (k === 'ArrowLeft') dc = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowRight') dc = 1;
   516	      else if (k === 'ArrowUp') dr = -1; else if (k === 'ArrowDown') dr = 1;
   517	      if (dr || dc) {
   518	        e.preventDefault();
   519	        if (cursor.sel) {
   520	          board.trySwap(cursor.sel.r, cursor.sel.c, cursor.sel.r + dr, cursor.sel.c + dc);
   521	          cursor.r = HF.clamp(cursor.sel.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   522	          cursor.c = HF.clamp(cursor.sel.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   523	          cursor.sel = null;
   524	        } else {
   525	          cursor.r = HF.clamp(cursor.r + dr, 0, ROWS - 1);
   526	          cursor.c = HF.clamp(cursor.c + dc, 0, COLS - 1);
   527	        }
   528	      } else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   529	        e.preventDefault();
   530	        cursor.sel = cursor.sel ? null : { r: cursor.r, c: cursor.c };
   531	      } else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { startFight(); }
   532	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { HF.audio.toggle(); }
   533	      return;
   534	    }
   535	    if (state === 'shop') {
   536	      if (k === 'ArrowUp') { shopSel = (shopSel + 3) % 4; e.preventDefault(); }
   537	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown') { shopSel = (shopSel + 1) % 4; e.preventDefault(); }
   538	      else if (k === 'Enter') { buy(shopSel); }
   539	      else if (k === ' ' || k === 'f' || k === 'F') { e.preventDefault(); activate('fight'); }
   540	      else if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') { HF.audio.toggle(); }
   541	      return;
   542	    }
   543	    if (state === 'lost') {
   544	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ' || k === 'r' || k === 'R') { e.preventDefault(); startFight(); }
   545	      else if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'u' || k === 'U') { toShop(); }
   546	      return;
   547	    }
   548	    if (state === 'won') {
   549	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); (save.fight > MAXFIGHT) ? newRun() : toShop(); }
   550	      return;
   551	    }
   552	  }

   160	  function hashSeed(value) {
   161	    let h = 2166136261;
   162	    const text = String(value);
   163	    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
   164	      h ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
   165	      h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
   166	    }

   168	  }

   116	  function schedule(fn, delay) {
   117	    if (game.pendingTimers.size >= MAX_TIMERS) return 0;

   126	    return id;

   477	  function toLocal(cx, cy) {
   478	    var r = A.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   479	    return { x: (cx - r.left) / A.sc, y: (cy - r.top) / A.sc };

   481	  function hit(x, y) {
   482	    var R = U.regions();
   483	    for (var i = R.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   484	      var g = R[i];
   485	      if (g.dis) continue;
   486	      if (x >= g.x && x <= g.x + g.w && y >= g.y && y <= g.y + g.h) return g;
   487	    }
   488	    return null;
   489	  }

   491	  function onDown(e) {
   492	    if (A.paused) return;
   493	    audioUnlock();
   494	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   495	    var p = toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   496	    var g = hit(p.x, p.y);
   497	    A.ptr[pid] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, g: g, moved: false, scroll: false, s0: A.scroll };
   498	    if (!g && (A.screen === 'coll' || A.screen === 'deck')) A.ptr[pid].scroll = true;
   499	    if (g && g.id === 'deckrow') A.ptr[pid].scroll = true;
   500	    if (Object.keys(A.ptr).length > 8) { // cap pointer map
   501	      var ks = Object.keys(A.ptr);
   502	      delete A.ptr[ks[0]];
   503	    }
   504	  }
   505	  function onMove(e) {
   506	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   507	    var st = A.ptr[pid];
   508	    if (!st) return;
   509	    var p = toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   510	    var dx = p.x - st.sx, dy = p.y - st.sy;
   511	    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 8) st.moved = true;
   512	    st.x = p.x; st.y = p.y;
   513	    if (st.scroll) {
   514	      A.scroll = Math.max(0, Math.min(U.scrollMax(), st.s0 - (p.y - st.sy)));
   515	      return;
   516	    }
   517	    if (st.g && st.g.id === 'hand' && st.moved && A.screen === 'battle') {
   518	      if (!A.drag) { A.drag = { idx: st.g.data, x: p.x, y: p.y, pid: pid }; A.sel = st.g.data; A.mode = 'sel'; }
   519	    }
   520	    if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) { A.drag.x = p.x; A.drag.y = p.y; }
   521	  }
   522	  function onUp(e) {
   523	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   524	    var st = A.ptr[pid];
   525	    delete A.ptr[pid];
   526	    if (!st || A.paused) { if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) A.drag = null; return; }
   527	    if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) {
   528	      var g = hit(A.drag.x, A.drag.y);
   529	      A.drag = null;
   530	      if (g && (g.id === 'pslot' || g.id === 'pact')) {
   531	        A.sel = st.g.data;
   532	        slotTap(g.id === 'pact' ? -1 : g.data);
   533	      } else if (g && g.id === 'atk') {
   534	        A.sel = null; A.mode = null; doAction('atk', g.data);
   535	      } else { A.sel = null; A.mode = null; }
   536	      return;
   537	    }
   538	    if (st.scroll || st.moved) return;
   539	    var g2 = hit(st.x, st.y);
   540	    if (g2 && st.g && g2.id === st.g.id) doAction(g2.id, g2.data);
   541	    else if (g2) doAction(g2.id, g2.data);
   542	  }
   543	  function onCancel(e) {
   544	    var pid = e.pointerId === undefined ? 'm' : e.pointerId;
   545	    if (A.drag && A.drag.pid === pid) A.drag = null;
   546	    delete A.ptr[pid];
   547	  }

   550	  function focusables() {
   551	    var R = U.regions(), out = [];
   552	    for (var i = 0; i < R.length; i++) if (!R[i].dis) out.push(i);
   553	    return out;
   554	  }
   555	  function moveFocus(dx, dy) {
   556	    var R = U.regions(), f = focusables();
   557	    if (!f.length) return;
   558	    if (A.focus < 0 || A.focus >= R.length || R[A.focus].dis) { A.focus = f[0]; return; }
   559	    var cur = R[A.focus];
   560	    var cx = cur.x + cur.w / 2, cy = cur.y + cur.h / 2;
   561	    var best = -1, bd = 1e9;
   562	    for (var i = 0; i < f.length; i++) {
   563	      var g = R[f[i]];
   564	      if (f[i] === A.focus) continue;
   565	      var gx = g.x + g.w / 2, gy = g.y + g.h / 2;
   566	      var vx = gx - cx, vy = gy - cy;
   567	      if (dx && Math.sign(vx) !== Math.sign(dx)) continue;
   568	      if (dy && Math.sign(vy) !== Math.sign(dy)) continue;
   569	      if (dx && Math.abs(vx) < 4) continue;
   570	      if (dy && Math.abs(vy) < 4) continue;
   571	      var d = dx ? Math.abs(vx) + Math.abs(vy) * 3 : Math.abs(vy) + Math.abs(vx) * 3;
   572	      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = f[i]; }
   573	    }
   574	    if (best >= 0) A.focus = best;
   575	    else if (dy && U.scrollMax() > 0) A.scroll = Math.max(0, Math.min(U.scrollMax(), A.scroll + dy * 70));
   576	  }
   577	  function onKey(e) {
   578	    if (A.keys[e.key]) { /* held */ }
   579	    A.keys[e.key] = 1;
   580	    audioUnlock();
   581	    A.kb = true;
   582	    var k = e.key;
   583	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') { moveFocus(-1, 0); e.preventDefault(); }
   584	    else if (k === 'ArrowRight') { moveFocus(1, 0); e.preventDefault(); }
   585	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp') { moveFocus(0, -1); e.preventDefault(); }
   586	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown') { moveFocus(0, 1); e.preventDefault(); }
   587	    else if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') {
   588	      e.preventDefault();
   589	      var R = U.regions();
   590	      if (A.focus >= 0 && A.focus < R.length && !R[A.focus].dis) doAction(R[A.focus].id, R[A.focus].data);
   591	    } else if (k === 'Escape') {
   592	      e.preventDefault();
   593	      if (A.screen === 'battle') doAction('quit');
   594	      else if (A.screen !== 'map') doAction('back');
   595	    }
   596	  }
   597	  function onKeyUp(e) { delete A.keys[e.key]; }

   651	  // ------------------------------------------------------------- resize
   652	  function resize() {
   653	    var cw = root.innerWidth, ch = root.innerHeight;
   654	    var sc = Math.min(cw / W, ch / H);
   655	    A.sc = sc;
   656	    var dpr = Math.min(root.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
   657	    // cap backing store long axis at ~960
   658	    var backH = H * sc * dpr;
   659	    if (backH > 960) dpr = Math.max(0.25, dpr * (960 / backH));
   660	    A.dpr = dpr;
   661	    A.sc0 = sc;
   662	    A.canvas.width = Math.round(W * sc * dpr);
   663	    A.canvas.height = Math.round(H * sc * dpr);
   664	    A.canvas.style.width = (W * sc) + 'px';
   665	    A.canvas.style.height = (H * sc) + 'px';
   666	    checkOrient();
   667	  }

   262	  function slotXY(side, slot) {
   263	    var L = U.LAY;
   264	    var bw = (W - 24 - 16) / 3;
   265	    if (slot < 0) {
   266	      return side === 'p' ? { x: W / 2, y: L.pact.y + L.pact.h / 2 } : { x: W / 2, y: L.oact.y + L.oact.h / 2 };
   267	    }
   268	    var x = 12 + slot * (bw + 8) + bw / 2;
   269	    return { x: x, y: (side === 'p' ? L.pbench.y : L.obench.y) + 26 };
   270	  }

   272	  function consumeFx() {
   273	    var G = A.G;
   274	    if (!G) return;
   275	    while (G.fx.length) {
   276	      var f = G.fx.shift();
   277	      var p = slotXY(f.a, f.b === undefined ? -1 : f.b);
   278	      switch (f.k) {
   279	        case 'hit': burst(p.x, p.y, 14, '#ff8a5c', 200); A.shake = Math.min(14, 4 + f.b / 12); sfx('hit'); break;
   280	        case 'benchhit': burst(p.x, p.y, 8, '#ffc07a', 150); sfx('hit'); break;
   281	        case 'ko': burst(p.x, p.y, 26, '#ffd98a', 260); A.shake = 16; A.flash = 0.35; sfx('ko'); break;
   282	        case 'heal': burst(p.x, p.y, 10, '#7ddc9a', 110); sfx('heal'); break;
   283	        case 'energy': burst(p.x, p.y, 8, '#8fd0ff', 100); sfx('energy'); break;
   284	        case 'place': burst(p.x, p.y, 8, '#c8d6e3', 90); sfx('place'); break;
   285	        case 'evolve': burst(p.x, p.y, 18, '#ffe89a', 170); A.flash = 0.2; sfx('evolve'); break;
   286	        case 'swap': burst(p.x, p.y, 8, '#9fe4ff', 110); sfx('place'); break;
   287	        case 'handler': burst(W / 2, U.LAY.hand, 10, '#b39ff0', 120); sfx('tap'); break;
   288	      }
   289	    }

   305	  function applyResult() {
   306	    var G = A.G;

   312	      if (A.save.wins % 2 === 0) A.save.packs = Math.min(99, A.save.packs + 1);
   313	      sfx('win');
   314	    } else sfx('lose');
   315	    save();
   316	  }

   324	  // ------------------------------------------------------------- actions
   325	  function doAction(id, data) {
   326	    var G = A.G, S = G ? G.p : null;
   327	    switch (id) {
   328	      case 'back':
   329	        if (A.screen === 'deck') { if (A.save.deck.length !== 20) A.save.deck = autoDeck(A.save); save(); }
   330	        A.screen = 'map'; A.scroll = 0; A.focus = -1; A.hint = ''; sfx('tap'); return;
   331	      case 'fight': startBattle(data); sfx('tap'); return;
   332	      case 'deck': A.screen = 'deck'; A.scroll = 0; A.focus = -1; sfx('tap'); return;
   333	      case 'coll': A.screen = 'coll'; A.scroll = 0; A.focus = -1; sfx('tap'); return;
   334	      case 'openpack': if (A.save.packs > 0) openPack(); return;
   335	      case 'quit': A.screen = 'map'; A.G = null; clearInput(); sfx('tap'); return;
   336	
   337	      // ---- pack
   338	      case 'reveal':
   339	        if (A.pack.rev <= data) { A.pack.rev = data + 1; sfx('place'); burst(W / 2, 300, 12, '#ffd98a', 160); }
   340	        return;
   341	      case 'revealall': A.pack.rev = 5; sfx('pack'); burst(W / 2, 300, 24, '#ffd98a', 200); return;
   342	      case 'packdone':
   343	        if (A.save.packs > 0) { openPack(); }
   344	        else { A.screen = 'map'; A.pack = null; A.G = null; sfx('tap'); }
   345	        return;
   346	
   347	      // ---- collection
   348	      case 'claim':
   349	        if (A.save.credits >= D.CLAIM_COST && !(A.save.col[data] > 0)) {
   350	          A.save.credits -= D.CLAIM_COST; A.save.col[data] = 1; save();
   351	          A.hint = 'Claimed ' + C[data].n + '.';
   352	          sfx('evolve'); burst(W / 2, H / 2, 16, '#ffd98a', 180);
   353	        }
   354	        return;
   355	
   356	      // ---- deck builder
   357	      case 'dplus': {
   358	        var have = Math.min(2, A.save.col[data] || 0);
   359	        var inD = A.save.deck.filter(function (x) { return x === data; }).length;
   360	        if (inD < have && A.save.deck.length < 20) { A.save.deck.push(data); sfx('tap'); }
   361	        return;
   362	      }
   363	      case 'dminus': {
   364	        var idx = A.save.deck.lastIndexOf(data);
   365	        if (idx >= 0) { A.save.deck.splice(idx, 1); sfx('tap'); }
   366	        return;
   367	      }
   368	      case 'autodeck': A.save.deck = autoDeck(A.save); sfx('pack'); return;
   369	      case 'deckdone': save(); A.screen = 'map'; A.focus = -1; sfx('tap'); return;
   370	
   371	      // ---- battle
   372	      case 'hand': {
   373	        if (!G || G.over) return;
   374	        var cid = S.hand[data];
   375	        if (cid === undefined) return;
   376	        if (!G.started) {
   377	          // setup: only placing the active matters
   378	          A.sel = (A.sel === data ? null : data); sfx('tap'); return;
   379	        }
   380	        if (G.who !== 'p' || G.await) { sfx('bad'); return; }
   381	        if (C[cid].t === 'h' && !E.handlerNeedsTarget(C[cid].fx)) {
   382	          if (E.playHandler(G, S, data)) { A.sel = null; A.mode = null; }
   383	          else sfx('bad');
   384	          return;
   385	        }
   386	        A.sel = (A.sel === data ? null : data);
   387	        A.mode = A.sel === null ? null : 'sel';
   388	        sfx('tap');
   389	        return;
   390	      }
   391	      case 'pact': slotTap(-1); return;
   392	      case 'pslot': slotTap(data); return;
   393	      case 'atk':
   394	        if (G && G.who === 'p' && !G.over && !G.await && E.canAttack(G, G.p, data)) {
   395	          A.sel = null; A.mode = null;
   396	          E.attack(G, G.p, data);
   397	          A.aiTimer = 0.75;
   398	        } else sfx('bad');
   399	        return;
   400	      case 'energy':
   401	        A.mode = (A.mode === 'energy' ? null : 'energy'); A.sel = null; sfx('tap'); return;
   402	      case 'retreat':
   403	        A.mode = (A.mode === 'retreat' ? null : 'retreat'); A.sel = null; sfx('tap'); return;
   404	      case 'end':
   405	        if (G && G.who === 'p' && !G.over && !G.await) {
   406	          A.sel = null; A.mode = null; E.endTurn(G); A.aiTimer = 0.7; sfx('tap');
   407	        }
   408	        return;
   409	      case 'again':
   410	        applyResult();
   411	        if (G.over === 1) {
   412	          if (A.save.packs > 0) { openPack(); return; }
   413	          var next = Math.min(G.rung + 1, D.LADDER.length - 1);
   414	          if (G.rung + 1 <= A.save.rank && G.rung + 1 < D.LADDER.length) startBattle(next);
   415	          else { A.screen = 'map'; A.G = null; }
   416	        } else startBattle(G.rung);
   417	        return;
   418	      case 'tomap':
   419	        applyResult();
   420	        A.screen = 'map'; A.G = null; clearInput();
   421	        if (A.save.packs > 0) A.hint = 'You have ' + A.save.packs + ' pack(s) waiting.';
   422	        return;
   423	    }
   424	  }

   257	  function onDown(ev) {

   263	    if (G.over === 'win' || G.over === 'crown') {

   265	      return;

   273	    }

   275	  function onMove(ev) {
   276	    var d = pointers[ev.pointerId];
   277	    if (!d) return;
   278	    ev.preventDefault();
   279	    if (d.kind !== 'pin') return;
   280	    var p = toDesign(ev), dx = p[0] - d.x0, dy = p[1] - d.y0;
   281	    d.moved = Math.max(d.moved, Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy));
   282	    var pin = G.pins[d.i];
   283	    if (!pin || pin.out) { delete pointers[ev.pointerId]; return; }
   284	    if (dx * pin.anchor > 16) { pullPin(pin); delete pointers[ev.pointerId]; }
   285	  }
   286	  function onUp(ev) {
   287	    var d = pointers[ev.pointerId];
   288	    delete pointers[ev.pointerId];
   289	    if (!d) return;
   290	    ev.preventDefault();

   294	      if (b && b.id === d.b.id) pressBtn(b);
   295	    } else if (d.kind === 'pin' && d.moved < 14) {
   296	      pullPin(G.pins[d.i]);   // forgiving tap
   297	    }
   298	  }

   301	  function onKey(ev) {
   302	    var k = ev.key;
   303	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight') ev.preventDefault();
   304	    if (ev.repeat) return;
   305	    keys[k] = 1;
   306	    AU.unlock();
   307	    if (G.rotate) return;
   308	    if (G.screen === 'boot') { startLevel(nextUnsolved()); return; }
   309	    if (G.over === 'fail') { if (G.overT > 0.25) startLevel(G.level); return; }
   310	    if (G.over === 'win' || G.over === 'crown') { if (G.overT > 0.35) { G.screen = 'kingdom'; if (G.over === 'win') G.over = null; } return; }
   311	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') { startLevel(G.level); return; }
   312	    if (k === 'Escape') { G.screen = G.screen === 'kingdom' ? 'play' : 'kingdom'; resetInput(); return; }
   313	    if (G.screen === 'kingdom') {
   314	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { AU.play('tap'); startLevel(nextUnsolved()); }
   315	      return;
   316	    }
   317	    var live = [];
   318	    for (var i = 0; i < G.pins.length; i++) if (!G.pins[i].out) live.push(i);
   319	    if (!live.length) return;
   320	    if (live.indexOf(G.sel) < 0) G.sel = live[0];
   321	    if (k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowRight') G.sel = live[(live.indexOf(G.sel) + 1) % live.length];
   322	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowLeft') G.sel = live[(live.indexOf(G.sel) + live.length - 1) % live.length];
   323	    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') pullPin(G.pins[G.sel]);
   324	  }

   595

   122	    var self = this;
   123	    this.canvas = canvas;
   124	    var down = function (e) {
   125	      e.preventDefault();
   126	      var p = self.toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   127	      self.pointers[e.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, down: true, id: e.pointerId };
   128	      if (self.primaryId === null) self.primaryId = e.pointerId;
   129	      if (canvas.setPointerCapture) { try { canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (er) {} }
   130	      if (self.onDown) self.onDown(p.x, p.y, e.pointerId);
   131	    };
   132	    var move = function (e) {
   133	      e.preventDefault();
   134	      var rec = self.pointers[e.pointerId];
   135	      if (!rec) return;
   136	      var p = self.toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   137	      rec.x = p.x; rec.y = p.y;
   138	      if (self.onMove) self.onMove(p.x, p.y, e.pointerId);
   139	    };
   140	    var up = function (e) {
   141	      e.preventDefault();
   142	      var rec = self.pointers[e.pointerId];
   143	      var p = rec ? { x: rec.x, y: rec.y } : self.toLocal(e.clientX, e.clientY);
   144	      delete self.pointers[e.pointerId];
   145	      if (self.primaryId === e.pointerId) self.primaryId = null;
   146	      if (rec && self.onUp) self.onUp(p.x, p.y, e.pointerId);
   147	    };
   148	    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
   149	    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: false });
   150	    var cancel = function (e) {
   151	      e.preventDefault();
   152	      var rec = self.pointers[e.pointerId];
   153	      delete self.pointers[e.pointerId];
   154	      if (self.primaryId === e.pointerId) self.primaryId = null;
   155	      if (rec && self.onCancel) self.onCancel(e.pointerId);
   156	    };
   157	    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', up, { passive: false });
   158	    canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel, { passive: false });
   159	    canvas.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', cancel, { passive: false });
   160	    canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   161	    canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   162	    canvas.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   163	
   164	    window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   165	      var k = e.key;
   166	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight') e.preventDefault();
   167	      if (self.keys[k]) return;
   168	      self.keys[k] = true;
   169	      if (self.onKey) self.onKey(k);
   170	    });
   171	    window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete self.keys[e.key]; });
   172	    window.addEventListener('blur', function () { self.releaseAll(); });
   173	    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) self.releaseAll(); });
   174	  },
   175	  releaseAll: function () {
   176	    var ids = Object.keys(this.pointers);
   177	    for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
   178	      var rec = this.pointers[ids[i]];
   179	      delete this.pointers[ids[i]];
   180	      if (rec && this.onCancel) this.onCancel(rec.id);
   181	    }
   182	    this.primaryId = null;
   183	    this.keys = {};
   184	    this.tapQueue.length = 0;
   185	  }

   243	  function beep(frequency, duration, type) {
   244	    if (!audio) return;
   245	    try {
   246	      const now = audio.currentTime;
   247	      const osc = audio.createOscillator();
   248	      const gain = audio.createGain();
   249	      osc.type = type || 'triangle';
   250	      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   251	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
   252	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.045, now + 0.01);
   253	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
   254	      osc.connect(gain).connect(audio.destination);
   255	      osc.start(now);
   256	      osc.stop(now + duration + 0.02);
   257	    } catch (_) { /* Audio is decorative. */ }
   258	  }

    48	  function layout() {

    50	    var dpr = Math.min(2, w.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    51	    var longAxis = Math.max(W, H);

    54	    cv.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(H * dpr));
    55	    cv.style.width = W + 'px'; cv.style.height = H + 'px';
    56	    g.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    58	    L.hud = 46; L.btop = L.hud;

    60	    cell = Math.max(30, cell);

    62	    L.bw = cell * COLS; L.bh = cell * ROWS;
    63	    L.bx = Math.round((W - L.bw) / 2);
